publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Collision detection is very significant for the dual-robot coordination system. To detect the collisions occurred in the system efficiently, an accurate and efficient collision detection algorithm is proposed in this paper. The algorithm has two components: one is the modeling method for building the collision detection model, and the other one is the overlap test algorithm for the collision detection model. According to the modeling method, the 6-DOF robot manipulator is modeled as a bounding volume hierarchical tree with three levels and the dual-robot coordination system is modeled as a hierarchical tree based on the robot manipulator's hierarchical tree. Then an overlap test algorithm for the hierarchical tree is proposed. Finally, the validity of the collision detection algorithm is verified by simulation in VREP.

articleTitle: Design of robot control system for minimally invasive surgery of knee joint
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a control system for knee joint minimally invasive surgery robot is designed based on computer and motion control card. It realizes the CT image conversion and modeling of knee joint, and provides a scientific method for the modeling of surgery. A human-computer interaction interface for minimally invasive surgery of knee joint is designed, and the operation is conveniently controlled. A robot motion control card based on ARM+FPGA is designed. The control program of the speed and position of the knee joint minimally invasive surgery robot was designed, which realized the operation, such as cut in, truncation, cleaning, implantation, cleaning, hemostasis, anti-inflammatory and so on. A multi joint neural network based on central pattern generator is designed to realize the cooperative operation of 4 surgical robot arms for minimally invasive knee surgery robot. The motion control system of minimally invasive surgery robot for knee joint can solve the problem of intelligent control of the robot. It has low cost and high reliability, and has good practical application prospect and market prospect.

articleTitle: Markov Modeling Methods for Performance Analysis of IEEE 802.11 Protocol
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As the mainstream standard of WLANs, analyzing the performance of IEEE 802.11 protocol has been a research hotspot in the field of communication. In many research methods, the mathematical model based on Markov chain is one of the most popular methods for performance analysis of IEEE 802.11 DCF. This paper classifies Markov chains as one-dimension, two-dimension and three-dimension, introduces their application in analyzing the performance of 802.11 DCF respectively and summarizes their characteristic. The results proposed in this paper show that the appropriate dimension of Markov chain needs to be selected according to the complexity of the improved MAC protocol and considered communication scenarios.

articleTitle: Bus Voltage Deviation Automatic Compensation Control Based On Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Droop control is an important control method in microgrids with distributed power supply. However, the traditional droop control does not consider the influence of line impedance between inverters, and will affect system stability and power sharing. First analyze the traditional droop control due to the line impedance, will cause the traditional instability of sagging, resulting in circulation. Secondly, in order to improve the adaptability of the micro-power inverter to the line, a virtual impedance link is added on the basis of the traditional droop control. The virtual impedance is inductive at low frequencies and can well weaken the resistive component of the line impedance model. The power coupling, but will further reduce the voltage of the microgrid; Finally, based on this principle, the voltage compensation link is introduced according to the voltage drop principle of the power system, and a bus voltage automatic compensation method based on the droop control is proposed.

articleTitle: Exploring Topological Graph Passwords of Information Security by Chinese Culture
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Graphical passwords are used in the world. Several kinds of topological graphic passwords (Topsnut-GPWs) are designed by using disconnected topology graphs in this paper. Our methods for the construction of Topsnut-GPWs can be transformed into efficient algorithms, and the spaces of Topsnut-GPWs are large and complex for withstanding attacks. We show that the mathematical modulus (Hanzi-graphs) of Chinese characters for making new Topsnut-GPWs that may be easily accepted by Chinese people.

articleTitle: A Decision-Level Fusion Method Based on Convolutional Neural Networks for Remote Sensing Scene Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Scene classification is a key issue in the field of remote sensing image analysis. In recent years, a lot of scene classification methods have emerged due to the convenient acquisition of high spatial resolution remote sensing images. In the existing literature, the feature-level fusion method is widely used to improve the classification performance. In this paper, we propose a decision-level fusion method based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for remote sensing scene classification. The proposed method accomplishes the classification task through two steps. In the first step, a CNN is fine-tuned using the training samples, and the soft-max layer of the CNN is used to obtain the top-N possible classes of each test sample. In the second step, multiple linear support vector machines (SVMs) are trained using the features extracted from the fully-connected layer of a pre-trained CNN. The final class of each test sample is determined by the SVMs from the top-N possible classes obtained in the first step. Experiments on the widely used UC Merced data set and AID data set demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of knowledge sharing system based on WeChat small program
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the needs and characteristics of the development of knowledge sharing, this paper designs and realizes the solution of knowledge sharing with the rise of the sharing economy as the background and the small program as the carrier. According to functions, the knowledge sharing system can be divided into six modules: video resource module, article resource module, question answering module, credits module, auditing module and recommendation module. The system adopts the C/S (client/server) architecture as the overall architecture. The backend relies on the tencent cloud server and the platform functions was accomplished through Java, JavaScript, MySQL database and the special languages of WeChat small program: WXML and WXSS. The classical collaborative filtering algorithm is used to recommend different resources to different users. This small program meets the user's need to acquire knowledge anytime and anywhere. It effectively solves the present problems in knowledge sharing and has great significance to the further development.

articleTitle: Reflections on the Construction of Cyber Security Range in Power Information System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of the Internet in the energy field, the architecture of the power information network system is also evolving, which brings serious security problems to the power information network. To cope with the increasingly complex network security situations, strengthen the protection of power critical information infrastructure, improve network security protection level throughout the life cycles of the power industry research and development for security, security detection, offense and defense and vulnerability mining, emergency response capabilities and production control systems, management information systems, this paper proposes using network virtualization technology and cloud computing technology to build a cyber security offense and defense simulation range in the power industry. The network security range is an important infrastructure for personnel training which can provide a good management and practical environment for offensive and defensive drills and training, thereby to improve the overall information security capabilities of the power industry.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-factor Bidirectional Dynamic Identification Based on SMS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Identity authentication is the most important network security service and the network security first defense line. On the basis of expounding single factor and double factor authentication technology, this article detailed the system structure and the authentication principle of Multi-factor mutual authentication technology based on the mobile telephone sms service. The authentication technology combines communication technology with network technology, using dynamic certification code, authentication and identification language and network password. By applying this authentication technology, it can further enhance mutual authentication between the client and the server, improve the reliability and safety of authentication, safeguard the network information security.

articleTitle: On Agricultural Machinery Operation System of Beidou Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large input of material cost in traditional agriculture, strong dependency of agricultural personnel, and low efficiency of agricultural production, this paper proposes and implements a research on agricultural machinery operation system based on Beidou navigation system. The system integrates BeiDou satellite positioning technology, wireless communication technology and geographical information technology to accurately position locomotives, real-time monitoring of locomotive operation geographic information and operation trajectory through cloud platforms, calculating agricultural machinery operation area, ensuring the quality of agricultural production, and promoting modern agricultural intelligence development.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Adaptive Stabilization PID Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the large change of the mass and the nonlinear relationship between propeller speed and lift force of the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle(UA V) during the working process, it requires that the control system's parameters could be adjusted automatically to adapt to the change of the system. Consider the advantages and disadvantages of fuzzy control and PID control, an improved fuzzy adaptive stabilization PID control system is proposed. Based on the dynamic model of the control system, a control system of fuzzy adaptive PID control of the outer loop angle and PID control of the inner-loop angular speed was built. The conventional PID control, cascade-stabilized PID control and fuzzy adaptive stabilization PID control were simulated by software. And the response performance and anti-jamming performance of the three kind of control strategies was obtained, the simulation results show that the fuzzy adaptive stabilization PID control effect is better than the other two control strategies, through the parameter debugging experiment and the actual flight experiment shows plant protection quadrotor UAV using fuzzy adaptive stabilization PID control system can achieve very good control results.

articleTitle: A Fault Section Location Method Based on Energy Remainder of Generalized S-Transform for Single-phase Ground Fault of Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: After the single-phase ground fault occurs in the distribution network, a wealth of electrical transient characteristics are generated in the system. The system has the characteristics that the transient zero-sequence currents at both ends of non-fault section are similar and the difference of transient zero-sequence current at both ends of the fault section is large. In this paper, a method for fault location based on the generalized S-transform energy remainder of transient zero-sequence current is proposed. The time-frequency matrix and each band energy are obtained through the generalized S-transform of the faulty transient zero-sequence current. By calculating the energy remainder between the two ends of each section and normalizing it, the section with the largest energy remainder is the fault section. Lots of simulation experiments show that the proposed method is immune to the fault position, transition resistance and fault time. The fault section can be selected accurately and reliably.

articleTitle: Research on Influence of Three-phase Current Unbalance on Transformer Losses and the Top-oil Temperature
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The internal temperature of the transformer is a key factor that limits its load capacity and thermal aging. The top-oil temperature is closely related to transformer losses. In order to solve the problem of traditional method for calculating transformer top-oil temperature without considering three-phase current unbalance, in this paper, the influence of three-phase current unbalance on transformer losses is analyzed in detail. Based on the correlation between transformer losses and its internal temperature, the empirical calculation model of the top-oil temperature is improved to adapt it to the calculation of the top-oil temperature under three-phase current unbalance conditions. By the simulation of the 10/0.4kV oil immersed distribution transformer in different operating conditions, it is found that it is necessary to take into account the three-phase current unbalance when calculating the top-oil temperature.

articleTitle: Foot Plantar Pressure Measurement System Based on Flexible Force-Sensitive Sensor and its Clinical Application
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a foot plantar pressure measurement system was developed based on resistive sensor. It consists of three self-developed flexible force-sensitive sensors, hardware circuit and software. Each of the sensors incorporates 3600 micro-pressure-sensors on an area of 40 by 40 cm, giving a resolution of approximately 14.5 sensors per square inch. The main functions of this system are as follows: data acquisition, data transmission, data analysis, data display and personal information management. We used this system and Zebris FDM-S pressure plate to analyze dynamic plantar pressure of subjects with the knee joint injury and normal control subjects respectively. The analysis results of the two systems are consistent, which shows that this system has higher stabilization and sensitivity and also has clinical value.

articleTitle: The Optimization of FFT Algorithm Based with Parallel Computing on GPU
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: FFTW and CUFFT are used as typical FFT computing libraries based on CPU and GPU respectively. This paper tests and analyzes the performance and total consumption time of machine floating-point operation accelerated by CPU and GPU algorithm under the same data volume. The results show that CUFFT based on GPU has a better comprehensive performance than FFTW.

articleTitle: Wide-Beam Conformal Dielectric Resonator Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A conformal dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) with a wide beam is proposed. This wide-beam antenna enjoys beam widths of 178 and 142 degree in E- and H- planes, respectively. The DRA is derived from basic rectangular DRAs (RDRAs). Design procedure is explained in detail. Initially, the RDRA is deformed in the direction of its long edge so that the new DRA has a wider beam and also conformal potential. Then, the ground plane in the same direction is extended to obtain a broader beam. During the deformation, the beam width becomes wider and wider with decreasing gain. However, the resonant frequency and bandwidth vary little. This antenna can be used in navigational systems where omnidirectional or wide-beam radiation characteristics are always required. It is also a qualified candidate for conformal antennas.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Switch Migration Strategy Based on FMOPSO
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a dynamic switch migration strategy (FMOPSO-DSMS) based on fuzzy multi-objective particle swarm optimization for SDN multi-controller load imbalance problem. This strategy first converts the mapping relationship between the controller and the switch to a 0-1 matrix; then it models the SDN controller load balancing problem, and takes the controller load balancing degree, the average minimum transmission hop count, and the switch migration number as the objective. The function and the corresponding constraint conditions were designed at the same time. Finally, a fuzzy multiobjective particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to solve the above model. In the SDN simulation environment built by Mininet and Floodlight, deploy FMOPSO-DSMS for verification. The final experimental results show that compared with DSMA and M-DSMA, FMOPSO-DSMS can effectively reduce the average transmission hops and the number of switches in the network, reduce the network transmission delay and the cost of migration, while effectively implementing controller load balancing.

articleTitle: Memory compression for Recursive Flow Classification Algorithm in Network Packet Processing Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Packet classification is an indispensable yet challenging functionality of modern SDN network devices. OpenFlow organization has presented Multiple Match Tables (MMT) model, which allows multiple smaller match tables to be matched in a pipeline of stages, and is easy to implement using a set of narrower tables in each stage. But MMT still contains some complex flow tables in some case, such as packet classification. TCAM-based schemes are not only capacity-limited but also very power-hungry for such complex flow, so researchers are devote to replace TCAM by decomposed scheme. RFC (Recurisive Flow Classification), a generalization of cross-producting, has a good performance in classification speed, but the excessive memory consumption increased indispensably with the expansion of rule set. To conquer memory explosion, we propose a feasibility and scalability memory compression for RFC scheme for complex flow table of MMT. Our experiment make a comparison with the RFC scheme, the experimental results indicates that the average space compression ratio is about 8 times.

articleTitle: Investigation on Arc Dielectric Resonator Antenna and Arc Microstrip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to investigate the potential of dielectric resonator antennas (DRAs) in area of conformal antennas, an arc DRA for conformal devices is compared with a traditional conformal arc microstrip patch antenna (MPA). The two antennas are the simplest forms of their kinds: they are deformed from rectangular DRAs and rectangular MPAs, respectively. They are designed to have similar size, material, and resonant frequency so that the comparison is reasonable. In addition, they work in the most common modes and have the most basic feed mechanisms at the meantime. The results indicate that the arc DRA enjoys wider beamwidth, broader bandwidth, higher gain and better cross-polarization suppression. Therefore, arc DRAs are qualified candidate for conformal requirement. Besides, it is also shown that arc DRAs are able to work as wide-beam or omnidirectional antennas.

articleTitle: Characteristic Impedance Analysis of Transmission Lines Considering Frequency Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the frequency characteristics of characteristic impedance of transmission line and the numerical influence of conductance value on characteristic impedance are analyzed synthetically. The characteristic impedance of transmission line under different frequency is analyzed by EMTP simulation.

articleTitle: Optimization of APF Single Hysteresis SVPWM Current Tracking Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the current tracking performance of active power filter and aiming at the shortage of traditional single hysteresis SVPWM current tracking algorithm, an optimization method of current tracking control strategy for double hysteresis SVPWM is proposed for shunt active power filter. In this method, the three-phase alternating positive and negative error current vector to determine the region where the voltage space vector, compared to traditional methods, to avoid the tedious operation region where the space voltage vector is determined, while the phase voltage detection part omitted grid, Simplifying the circuit design;The method has high operation efficiency, high robustness and Superiority. It can be confirmed experimentally.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Access Control Strategy for Smart Campus Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the emphasis of campus information work is to ensure the safe operation of smart campus, and access control strategy is an effective measure to ensure access security and data security. This paper mainly introduces the security boundary of basic platform, business system and system function in the intelligent campus, defines a hybrid access control strategy based on GBAC, RBAC and HPBAC model. It puts forward the business system, menu, page and data etc., and access control is set between and within the system. The cache data structure is constructed with two objects of group and role respectively, and the priority of caching is checked in the user privileges determination algorithm, so as to realize the optimization of access control decision process. Therefore, the model has the characteristics of flexibility and reliability, and can meet the needs of large-scale distributed access control in smart campus.

articleTitle: 3D Autonomous Tracking of Buried Pipelines via a UAV in a Low Altitude
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel 3D tracking mechanism for buried oil and gas pipelines based on the tracking structure which is identified via the depth image captured by the stereo camera. Because of the geological specialty of United Arab Emirates that oil and gas pipelines are buried shallowly, then pipelines can be considered as berms visually. Through linear fitting of the nearest pixels of the depth image, the pipeline berm can be identified. Then according to the orientation and lateral difference information of the pipeline obtained, the VAV autonomous navigation and tracking can be realized. Besides, the navigation methods and variant PID controller designed previously are continuously applied in this research. Overall experiment results show this 3D autonomous tracking of the pipeline is stable, accurate and effective.

articleTitle: Target detection based on automatic threshold edge detection and template matching algorithm in GPR
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: When using ground-penetrating radar (GPR) detects targets in complex underground scene, due to the nonuniformity of underground medium, the disturbance of echo signal at the aspects of propagation path and propagation attenuation leads to the phenomenon of such as dislocation, missing, distortion characteristic of scattering curve in GPR record profile. Traditional methods of target localization based on hyperbolic vertex detection is no longer valid. In this paper, a method based on automatic threshold edge detection and template matching was proposed to reduce the influence of hyperbolic distortion and noise and improved the accuracy of vertex detection. Firstly, one-dimensional energy curves along the lateral line are recorded by GPR to determine preset number of targets. A preset range of target number was determined by recording a one-dimensional energy curve along a survey line by the GPR record profile. Secondly, the edge of GPR record profile was detected based on automatic matching threshold to obtain estimated vertex coordinates. Based on the estimated vertex coordinates, templates were established and template matching process was carried out to obtain matching target vertex; Finally, target vertices were filtered by clustering analysis and false vertices were removed, detection results of target vertex in GPR profile were obtained. Simulation and onsite GPR profile processing results show that the proposed method can effectively suppress the effects of hyperbolic deformation and noise with higher detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Gesture Interaction and Augmented Reality based Hand Rehabilitation Supplementary System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The existing systems of hand rehabilitation always design different rehabilitation medical apparatus and systems according to the patients' needs. This kind of system always contain problems such as complexity, using only single training programs, inconvenient to wear and high cost. For these reasons, this paper uses gesture recognition technology and augmented reality technology to design a simple and interactive hand rehabilitation supplementary system. The system uses a low-cost, non-contact device named Leap Motion as the input device, and Unity3D as the development engine, realizing three functional modules: conventional training, AR game training and auxiliary functions. This rehabilitation training project with different levels of difficulty increases the fun and challenge of the rehabilitation process. Users can use the system to assist the treatment activity of hand rehabilitation anytime and anywhere. The system, which has good application value, can also be used in other physical rehabilitation fields.

articleTitle: A new identity based blind signature scheme and its application
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of computational complexity brought by bilinear pairing in identity based blind signature, a new ID-based blind signature scheme is proposed combined with Elgamal algorithm, and the blind signature scheme is applied to the field of civil aviation data transmission firstly. The signer is not visible to the original message and can't restore the original message by the signed message. The use of hash function to deal with both private key and the identity information is secure under the Random Oracle Model. Based on the classical Elgamal algorithm, the problem belongs to the discrete logarithm problem. The scheme is applied to the field of civil aviation data transmission and the experimental results show that it can effectively resist key recovery attacks and signature forgery attacks. The scheme has strong anti-attack ability and effective operation ability. Compared with other schemes, it needs less module operation and exponential operation. To sum up, this scheme is better than other schemes in the civil aviation's field.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic-weighted centroid Indoor Location Algorithm based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The ultra-wideband(UWB) signal is affected by systematic measurement error and Not-Line-of-Sight(NLOS) error when it propagates in complex indoor environment, which leads to poor positioning accuracy and stability. In order to reduce the influence of error on the accuracy of positioning results, a Hyperbolic-weighted centroid algorithm based on Kalman Filter is proposed in this paper. The method is based on the time difference of arrival(TDOA) location model. The measured value of the TDOA distance difference is first filtered by Kalman Filter, and then the obtained results are used as the input of the Hyperbolic location algorithm to acquire the initial solution. For further offsetting the effect of error on positioning accuracy, a weighted centroid technique is applied. We evaluate the performance of the proposed method in both simulation and experimental results. The experimental results show that the position accuracy is effectively improved by the algorithm. When the measurement error satisfies the Gaussian distribution and the standard deviation is 0.1 m, the Root Mean Square Error(RMSE) of the location results is about 11 cm.

articleTitle: A New Substrate Integrated Antenna for Wireless Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A substrate integrated antenna for wireless power transmission (WPT) applications, based on strongly coupled magnetic resonances is proposed in this paper. The design and experiments of the substrate integrated antenna are described. As the results shows, when the distance between transmitter and receiver antennas is 1cm, the maximum efficiency of 75.8% can be obtained. As the distance between transmitter and receiver antennas increases to 15cm, the power transmission efficiency become 61%, realizing a midrange distance transmission of power. With the advantages of compactness and ease of manufacture, the proposed antenna could be integrated on electronic products for wireless charging.

articleTitle: Dissolved Oxygen Detection Based on Light-to-Frequency Conversion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the detection of dissolved oxygen(DO) concentration based on the principle of fluorescence quenching, fluorescence intensity detection generally relies on high-precision instruments, extra amplifier circuits and filter circuits at present, which make the detection cost high and the structure complex. In order to reduce the detection cost, simplify the structure of the detection system and improve the stability of the detection, a method of directly detecting the fluorescence intensity using the light-to-frequency proportional conversion characteristics of TCS3200 sensor was proposed and a DO concentration detection system was designed subsequently. The linear relationship between the output frequency of the sensor and the DO concentration was studied and established, based on which the sample DO concentration can be calculated by using the frequency value collected in the detection system accordingly. The experimental results show that the relative error (RE) between the measured DO concentration and the standard value of the sample is less than 5%, and the relative standard deviation (RSD) of the sample data is less than 2%, both of which meet the requirements of accuracy and precision respectively. At the same time, the detection system avoids complicated circuits and its structure is simple, and has the merit of strong anti-interference ability, low cost and high precision.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Coding Scheme based on License Plate Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Image compression is an important research issue in the field of image processing. The compressed image is used for visual analysis and surveillance in many appliance scenarios. Since the sink of compressed information has changed to computer algorithms, there are many researches on feature compression recently. However, the traditional coding architectures cannot recovery the original image, so it will be difficult to obtain evidence in law. In view of this situation, we propose a novel image coding method based on license plate recognition which is similar to region of interest coding. By determining the coding unit that plays a decisive role in license plate recognition, then reducing its quantization step length, so the reduction of bit rate can be achieved. The dataset is captured by surveillance cameras. Experimental results show that the proposed scheme can save average 21.44% bit rate compared with the regular JPEG, with the equivalent recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of an Improved Neural Network Algorithm in Classification of Communication Noise Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The genetic algorithm is used to improve the neural network and obtain the optimal weights and thresholds. Using the generated optimal weights and thresholds to run the neural network reduces the error norm over neural network which use random weights and thresholds. The classification of three kinds of communications noise signals was simulated by this algorithm, and the accuracy of this algorithm was proved. Experiments show that the algorithm will have an excellent application prospect in the noise signals classification in the communications field.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method for Multi-Operator and Multi-Robot Teleoperation Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the topic of evaluation method for Multi-Operator and Multi-Robot (MOMR) teleoperation systems. First, a new evaluation method for MOMR teleoperation systems was proposed, and the corresponding grouping method of terminals and robots in system and its group evaluation method we proposed was discussed. Second, ten kind of universal capabilities covering 128 functional items and 64 quantitative items were summarized for four operation mode evaluation in the process of group evaluation. Then group evaluation capabilities and items covering 11 functional items and 10 quantitative items were summed up for the comprehensive evaluation of Single-Operator Multi-Robot (SOMR) operation mode group (SOMROMG), Multi-Operator Single-Robot (MOSR) operation mode group (MOSROMG), and Multi-Operator Multi-Robot (MOMR) operation mode group (MOMROMG). Then evaluation capabilities and items covering 19 functional items and 10 quantitative items were also listed for the evaluation of intermediate service node of MOMR operation mode. Finally, through example the effectiveness of the proposed method was validated.

articleTitle: Attribute-Based Transfer Learning for Behavior Recognition with Structural Information
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Traffic behavior is closely related to the scene structure. Insufficient training samples will result in the problem of inappropriate scene modeling. An attribute-based transfer learning method for behavior recognition is put forward, which contains two main components: S-ATM Attribute Topic Model and S-CTM classifier model. S-ATM Attribute Topic Model is obtained by combined with the sources and sinks on the basis of the ATM Model, which realize modeling between behavioral properties and the underlying trajectory characteristics to learn the model parameters. Then the parameters of S-ATM Attribute Topic Model transfer to the S-CTM classifier model as attribute prior knowledge to improve the performance of target behavior classifier model. Experiments show that the proposed approach can transfer attribute priors from source categories to target categories effectively and significantly improve the recognition accuracy rate of the target behavior classifier model in zero-shot learning task.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Adaptive Coding and Modulation for Remote Sensing Satellite
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to meet the high-speed downlink data transmission requirements of medium and low-orbit remote sensing satellites, higher spectrum efficiency is achieved under limited frequency band resources. This paper proposes an adaptive coding and modulation technique aiming at the problem of waste of link margin in the traditional data transmission mode. It can realize full utilization of link margin and improve spectrum efficiency under the premise of reliable transmission. Through link calculation and simulation verification, the spectrum utilization rate of the remote sensing data transmission under adaptive mode is 1.8 times that of the traditional constant coding and modulation mode.

articleTitle: Research on Session Sharing of Distributed Application Service Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the field of traditional enterprise information system, the micro-service ideas has been introduced to decompose the large enterprise applications into high-cohesion distributed business application services. For the need of user identity and access information for these business application service access, the research on session sharing of distributed application service technology has been carried out. Through analyzing the common methods of session sharing, a session sharing technology scheme based on the cache database has been proposed. To solve the problem that the session data is redundant and the access pressure of cache database server is large, the technology for the session content to be partitioned by business application has been put forward, and a session management method based on Apache Shiro permission component has been adopted. It realizes the session storage uniformly in the cache database by business application, and at the same time, the session information is cached locally according to the business application. It effectively reduces the access flow and pressure of the cached database servers.

articleTitle: Research on Deployment of Throwing Jamming Microwave Relay Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The throwing jammer is one trend of the future development of communication countermeasure equipments. Considering the limitations of suppression against microwave relay communication by the conventional ground communication jamming, this thesis analyzes the determination model of jamming microwave relay communication, and sets up the model of deployment. Based on the typical tactics background, analysis of examples is done and the results show that this model of deployment can fulfill the task while minimizing the demand for the number of jammers by reasonable deployment.

articleTitle: Method for Movement Direction Judgment of Secret Carriers Based on Multi-frequency RFID
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aimed at the low accuracy problem in the current movement direction judgment methods of secret carriers, a method for movement direction judgment based on multifrequency RFID is presented. Firstly, the constitution, deploy and workflow are given. Second, a movement direction judgment algorithm based on T &S is proposed by use of the data about trigger area and arriving time in the access process. Last, the prototype has been tested, the movement direction judgment accuracy is 100%, and it has the eliminating abnormal access ability and the judging multiple reentry ability. Test results indicate that the proposed scheme is effective and credible.

articleTitle: Study of Sierpinski Gasket Used in Gray Image Scrambling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Gray image with sensitive information has very important military and economy value. This paper discusses the method that Sierpinski Gasket used in image scrambling according to the characteristics of gray image, carries out the scrambling process under the n-dimension Sierpinski Gasket, and analyses the safety of this method. Then, this paper validated its feasibility through experiments, and discusses the main factors which impact the effect of scrambling. The results show that this method for image scrambling has strong captivation and good safety, could provide an excellent technique to guarantee the safety of image with important information for storage and transmission.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Dynamic Satellite Signal Simulator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The principle and key technique of high dynamic Satellite Signal Simulator are introduced in this paper. Software and hardware implementation schemes are also designed. The software part is implemented by using VC++\pmb6.0 soft platforms, and the hardware signal processing circuit board is realized by FPGA. The communication of software and hardware is realized via the serial ports. The simulator has been applied in the R&D process of the satellite navigation system successfully, and it possesses the fundamental function of a simulator. Besides, the simulator can simulate the Doppler Effect Shift in the frequency of Satellite Signal. The simulator can provide a vivid high dynamic signal environment for the validations of orientation performance, signal track and capture performance of a receiver.

articleTitle: Control System Design of Evaporator Based on PCS7 and SMPT-1000
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Evaporator is widely used in chemical industry, food, pharmaceutical and environmental protection industries. In this paper, the process flow of the Evaporator is comprehensively analyzed. According to the characteristics of the controlled object, a complete control scheme for the outlet flow, liquid level, and temperature of the Evaporator is designed. Due to the large hysteresis in the temperature control of the Evaporator, the predictive control algorithm is used in this system. Finally, this paper takes the SMPT-1000 as the object, Siemens PCS7 as the control tool, and the control system configuration is designed by CFC and SFC, WinCC is used as the configuration software of the upper computer. The semi-physical simulation experiment shows that the designed process control system optimized by the predictive control algorithm is stable and has strong anti-interference ability. At the same time, the control requirements are realized, the feasibility of the control strategy and scheme designed in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Solving Power Battery Scheduling Problem Based on TSP
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the production process of the test section, the power battery needs to pass through two room temperature standing and two parameters measurement. In this process, it needs to be handled by RGV (Rail-guided vehicle) many times. Combined with the scene of a power battery manufacturer's production line, this paper aims to minimize the task time and establish a model. Through further analysis, the complex production scheduling problem is transformed into a classical TSP problem, and the genetic algorithm is used to solve the problem. Experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the operating efficiency of RGV.

articleTitle: Efficient path planning for unmanned aerial vehicle with refuelling stations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Unmanned Air vehicle (UAV) is a preferred option for the country of Rwanda to distribute blood supply to different remote hospitals in the country. However, the execution of such a persistent mission demands for an extended path planning with refuelling stations (RS) to extent flight time, which is proven a NP-hard problem. This paper proposes a novel UAV path planning (UPP) algorithm for the routing problem, which borrows the idea of the classic Greedy Perimeter Stateless Routing protocol (GPSR) to make local decisions of RS selection. Since most routing operations are made locally and do not depend on the knowledge of whole topology, the UPP algorithm can achieve a much less computation complexity than previous algorithms. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme also achieves a less end-to-end trip delay than existing methods, when the refuelling time becomes a substantial factor.

articleTitle: Supernetwork-Based Invulnerability Evaluation of Topology for Wireless Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the structural and function characteristic of wireless communication network, the types of nodes and super-edges are defined and described. The network evolving model is proposed for topology and super-edges based on complex networks and supernetwork, and the system of evaluation index is constructed, based on which simulation are processed. The simulation results indicate that can effectively and accurately reflect the networks performance along with increasing of the deleted nodes number in accordance to different node deleting strategies, i.e., random attack and intentional attack, and the proposed method is validated to be effective.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Anti-windup Compensator Design for Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it's hard for the constant coefficient compensator to effectively compensate strong nonlinear systems, a fuzzy anti-windup compensator is proposed in this paper. The error between controller's and actuator's outputs, and error derivative are used as inputs for fuzzy compensator. The error compensation coefficient is adjusted in a fuzzy manner. Applied in a permanent magnet DC motor servo system, the results show that the fuzzy compensator can reduce resources occupancy and improve dynamic characteristics significantly. The overshoot of step response reduces by 23 %, and the adjustment time (2% error band) is shortened by 0.8s than that in usual cases. Compared with the constant coefficient compensator, the fuzzy compensator performs better in transient stability and robustness, which is a feasible solution for anti-windup problem.

articleTitle: Implementation of Synchronous Clock based on the Coal Mine Exploration Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To make a high precision synchronization in transmitter and receiver when the coal mine exploration radar work in the field survey, this paper has designed a high precision synchronous clock based on complementary coordinate GPS and OCXO. The clock phase splitting algorithm is used to measure GPS output time difference between stable second pulse signal (1PPS) and local second pulse signal, and then the Kalman filtering algorithm is used to filtering time lag to get the frequency deviation controlling quantity of OCXO, eventually making high precision synchronization between stable 1PPS and local second pulse signal. The experimental results show that synchronous clock can work long time until GPS is valid, the synchronization precision of transmitter and receiver is better than 150ns. It can take local second pulse instead of stable second pulse signal (1PPS), in the case of one or two GPS receiver are invalid. The operational time of synchronous clock is more than half an hour.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Analysis Method of Sensitive Factors for Processing State Oriented to Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The fluctuation of processing state is influenced by many factors, including multi procedure, multi process parameters, multi machine and other multidimensional parameters. In order to identify the main influencing factors that affect the processing state fluctuation quickly and accurately to control the continuous stability of the machining state effectively, this paper proposed a dynamic kernel principal component analysis (DKPCA) method to analyze the sensitive factors for machining process based on the big data characteristics of processing state. Through the sequential dynamic processing of multidimensional state parameters for machining process, the average kernel matrix and the time sequence dynamic vector are constructed and designed to characterize the dynamic characteristics of the state parameters. A case is conducted to analyze the sensitive factors for machining process dynamically under the circumstance of big data and multidimensional, which verifies the validity of the proposed DKPCA for multidimensional dynamic analysis of sensitive factors. The method proposed in this paper provides theoretical support for determining the quality critical control points in the machining process to improve the product quality.

articleTitle: Design of Test Data Management System for Vehicle Powertrain Integrated Test
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the problem of data management in vehicle powertrain integrated test, and basing on the system architecture of Browser/server mode, this paper designed and developed a test data management system which is a set of test project management, resource management, data management, data processing and analysis. It can manage, process and analyze the test data effectively, and can meet the needs of test task planning, comprehensive evaluation and test report writing, which will provide powerful support for the integrated test of powertrain system.

articleTitle: Research on gesture recognition based on sEMG and inertial sensor fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Nowadays, EMG control can be applied in many fields, it uses bio-electric signals from human muscles, as well as pressure, force, and joint angle changes and other indicators, and transform the sensors into electrical signals, and then use the computer for test analysis to guide the design and modification of work tools, working methods and working environments. This method has improved characteristics in terms of efficiency, safety, health, and comfort. This study is based on the integration of surface electromyography (sEMG) and inertial sensors for data acquisition, signal processing, and classification processing, and realize gesture recognition for people. Different gestures are issued through gestures to control the actions of the turtlebot.

articleTitle: Research on the Coordinated Control of the Integrated Wind-PV-ES Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Considering the characteristics of intermittent and fluctuating characteristics such as wind power, photovoltaic and other new energy generation, the introduction of large capacity energy storage system is an important way to increase the proportion of new energy generation. As an important way to realize the distributed power supply scale utilization, micro grid provides a new idea for the new energy accepted by power grid. However, due to the diverse forms and performance of distributed generation in micro grid, the coordinated control of distributed generation is very important to fully play the potential advantages of micro grid. In this context, the power characteristics of wind power and photovoltaic are analyzed. Based on the natural complementarity between them and the characteristics of real-time charging and discharging of energy storage, a micro grid system combining wind power, photovoltaic and energy storage is constructed. At the same time, the coordinated control of distributed generation is studied.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Attention of Online Short-term Rental Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The online short-term rental platform is becoming the first choice for travel accommodation. The use of ROST content mining software to further analyze the concerns of tenants on the service quality of short rental sources by selecting the sample of tourist cities for the use of on-line commentary information for short rental housing users of domestic mainstream short-term rental platforms, and to obtain supporting facilities and housing Sources of comfort, traffic, surrounding environment, and landlord services focus on specific indicators. Finally, these indicators provide valuable business advice for short-term rental platforms and landlords. It aims to increase the satisfaction of short-term tenants and promote the development of the online short-term rental industry.

articleTitle: Study on diaphragm Fabry-Perot pressure sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The manufacture method of the diaphragm Fabry-Perot(F-P) pressure sensor was studied. The sensor formed an F-P cavity by welding the hollow fiber on the end face of the single mode fiber, and manufactured a quartz diaphragm by cutting and grinding the single mode fiber. A new fitting demodulation method is proposed, which can obtain the FP cavity's reflectivity, the diaphragm's outside reflectivity, the F-P cavity length and the diaphragm thickness at one time. It is highly practical for the parameter monitoring in the sensor manufacturing process. Experiments show that the sensor has high sensitivity and linearity, and has great potential application value in the field of fluid mechanics measurement.

articleTitle: Analytical model of squeeze film air damping for circular microplates in the free molecular regime
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the generalized Energy Transfer Model (Gen-ETM) for rectangular microplates, this paper gives an analytical expression of Gen-ETM for circular microplates in the free molecular regime. The closed form expression of the model is very easy to use, and is validated by the FEM simulation. Quality factor of the analytical model is inversely proportional to the plate radius. Compared with FEM simulation, the model is applicable to small radius circular plate.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of DAG task scheduling model based on heterogeneous multicore processor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to better solve the problem of heterogeneous multi-core processors with tasks and complex relationships to scheduling problem based on the directed acyclic graph (DAG) model, through the task replication and merge operation, designed using a parallel task tree (PTT) model. The model chooses ant colony optimization (ACO) with natural parallelism to improve the task migration to complete the replication and merge of tasks, so as to give full play to the advantages of heterogeneous multi-core processors, and schedule tasks to corresponding nuclear execution. Then the comparison and analysis of the PTT model and the DAG model in the same parameters are carried out by using the speedup ratio and the task execution time as the index. The experimental results show that the PTT model has a high speed-up ratio, shortens the task execution time, strengthens the stability, and verifies the rationality of the design.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of isually Analytic WebGISystem Based on Marine High-Definition Remote Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Marine High-Definition Remote Sensing (MHDRS) is facing a massive increase of data stream that may result in the obstacle of the real-time processing, effective decision-making and low efficiency information collection. To address these problems, this paper analyzes the visualization, SAR ship recognition and control integrate system and, based on the MHDRS data, establishes a visually analytic system to process the different sources of remote sensing data as well as their storage. The result shows that the new approach enhances the analysis and sharing with high efficiency.

articleTitle: The Remote Monitor and Control of Massive Hydraulic Fracturing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, I propose a new method about the remote monitor and control for Massive Hydraulic Fracturing (MHF). It includes data acquisition by serial port communication even if the fracturing measuring truck has not outside serial port, 3G network transmission, original MHF data synchronous processing and integration. The multithreading is used to meet the request of real-time and multitask. Adopted this method, it can solve all types of problems of the fracturing measuring trucks can't transfer fracturing data over long distance and can't integrate each other data.

articleTitle: Research on recognition algorithm for intra pulse modulation of radar signals
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the recognition of linear frequency modulation (LFM) signal and phase coded (PSK) signal, we proposed a radar Signal modulation recognition algorithm based on the combination of fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) and multiple phase differences. Through the nesting of two recognition algorithms, we have achieved the recognition of the signal from coarse to fine. FRFT is used to distinguish LFM signals from other coded signals, and multiple phase differences are used to identify regular signals and all kinds of coded signals. Simulation analysis verified that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Implementation of power monitoring data cloud platform based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale of power quality monitoring and the increasing frequency of data acquisition for power quality monitoring, a cloud platform method using Hadoop cluster and MapReduce parallel computing is proposed. The data storage is realized by using distributed database HBase, and the data of power quality data are counted by MapReduce parallel computing. Through the interaction of JavaEE and Hadoop, the power quality data storage and computer programs are compiled, debugged and run. Finally, a number of hosts are used to build the Hadoop cluster for experimental verification. The experimental results show that the base is based on the experiment. The power quality monitoring platform of Yu cloud platform has high efficiency and reliability in analyzing and processing massive data, which proves the high efficiency and superiority of cloud platform, and provides a new method for power quality monitoring.

articleTitle: The Gracefulness of Super Sun-Graphs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The knowledge about labeling property of computer network topology has practical guiding significance to computer communication network system design of functional, reliability, low communication cost. Super sun-graph is a very important generalized ring network topology. This essay presents a method of constructing super sun-graphs using n isomorphic set-ordered graceful trees T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>(iϵ [1,n]). It confirms graceful labeling of these super-graphs and proves its gracefulness.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Economic Evaluation of Regional Railway Projects in Western China Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The ongoing research establishes the economic evaluation model of the West China Regional Railway projects based on Vensim software, then the simulation analyses concerning the model are conducted. Being the infrastructure of national economy, railway has been playing a vital role in economy and social development. Therefore, the comprehensive economic evaluation comes as a necessity due to the urgent need to guarantee the accuracy and scientificity in decision-making process of railway project investing. The system dynamics as a tool is associated with local railway projects to set up the model, and one of the projects is taken as an example to perform the simulation and analysis via Vinsem platform. The paper mainly focuses on the financial evaluation analysis of the project, through the actual simulation of the project based on the model, a comprehensive and dynamic understanding of the profitability, the debt-paying ability and the economic reasonability of the project can be obtained, additionally, the sensibility of the system is detected to seek the key factors that affecting the feasibility of the model. The result tells that: The results show that: The model is feasible and effective, the most sensitive factor is freight rate and volume.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Bus Automatic Reporting Station System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, based on the traditional bus stops system, combining with the characteristics of the use of public transport vehicles and the actual operating environment, design a kind of bus stops are automatically controlled by the single chip microcomputer system, this paper introduces the system at the start of the overall design thought, after detailed research and analysis is mainly focused on the two aspects of hardware and software design of the whole system. Hardware, use AT89C51 single chip microcomputer as controller, makes the design of the hardware system simplification, the system hardware design including keyboard circuit and reset circuit, display driver circuit, display circuit, memory expansion circuit module. Application software, KeilVision4. Write the main program, using the modularization and the top-down design concept to achieve the single chip microcomputer control of the various modules, in detail the design of each part of the application. At the end of the paper, the software and hardware debugging of the whole system is briefly introduced and summarized.

articleTitle: Accidents Occur Easily Waterway Judgment Method with Potential for Safety Improvement
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of current identification method on traffic accident in waterway, in the article the full Bayesian-based potential for safety improvement method is built based on Bayesian theory. The hot-segment of accident is identified with the difference between accident number of a segment waterway and accident expectation of entire waterway. As the difference increases, the potential for safety improvement increases. The new identification method is used to identify hot-segment of accident of the Yangtze River downstream and the results are compared with those of the accident statistics method, the empirical Bayesian method and the full Bayesian method, which proves that the new identification is the best. At last, three kinds of evaluation of SCT(site consistency test),MCT(method consistency test) and TRDT(total rank differences test) are used to evaluate the four identification methods and the new identification method is further proved the best.

articleTitle: Parameters Tuning Rules Research on Nonlinear Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Parameter tuning of control variable gain is a difficult problem in the nonlinear active disturbance rejection controller. Taking the DC motor with current closed-loop as a controlled object, a parameter extraction method from known part of dynamic model is proposed, which reduces the number of adjustable parameters. The parameters tuning rules are summarized by “Separation Principle”, and the nonlinear active disturbance rejection controller is designed. The results show that the parameter extraction method from known part of controlled object is feasible. Compared with the PID controller, the nonlinear active disturbance rejection controller consumes much less energy and has better dynamic characteristics, anti-disturbance capacity and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Low power consumption and low area capacitor array for 16-bit 1-MS/s SAR ADC
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A low power consumption and low area capacitor array for 16-bit 1Ms/s successive approximation register (SAR) analogue to digital converter (ADC) is presented. The new capacitor array is divided into three segments, and the bridge capacitor is integer by redundant and weight bits. The new switching method replaced the previous method of three reference levels by divided bit capacitors into two equal sub-capacitors. Moreover, through the calculation and measurement of quantization noise and thermal noise, the proposed method gives the exact capacitor array area. The number of unit capacitor used in the proposed method is 225 of one side, and it can save 99.93% area compared with conventional 16-bit capacitor array. However, energy loss of the proposed scheme is 99.5% reduced by the three segments capacitor arrays and new switching scheme. Moreover, a dynamic latch comparator with two stages of pre-amplification structure is presented. The measured differential non-linearity (DNL) and integral non-linearity (INL) are within 0.33 and 0.1793 least significant bits, respectively, and it has 15.87 effective number of bits (ENOB).

articleTitle: The Acquisition Method of BOC Signal Based on Partial Coherent Sideband
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the single-sideband acquisition algorithm of BOC signal, there is a problem of subcarrier signal loss and signal power loss. A partial coherent sideband FFT acquisition method is proposed. Firstly, the mathematic model of BOC signal is established and the principle of algorithm research is deduced mathematically. Secondly, the performance of the algorithm is analyzed and implemented by MATLAB simulation. Simulation results show that the partial coherent sideband algorithm has higher output SNR and more stable tracking accuracy. At certain signal-to-noise ratios, the acquisition of carrier Doppler estimation and PN code phase deviations are smaller than those of the single-sideband method, and the acquisition accuracy is higher, achieving the purpose of algorithm design.

articleTitle: The Research of Micro-blog User Influence Ranking Algorithm SDD-rank
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the popularity of internet and mobile devices, the microblog as one of the new media, the microblog users' influence ranking can support the business promotion of the organizations and the individuals and also can support the government sectors to monitor the public sentiment. This thesis studies the network structure, information dissemination features and user's attributes of microblog, puts forward a SDD (Structure-Dissemination-Data) model and demonstrated the quantitative approach it. Based on SDD model and the PageRank algorithm, this thesis put forward the SDD-Rank algorithm to measure and calculate user influence from multiple angles, and optimized the calculation result in accordance with the SDD model.

articleTitle: Location Model Based on Population Distribution of Language
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the analysis of population growth and immigration rules, a model based on Logistic population growth model is established to predict the population of native speakers, the migrants and total language speakers of the 20 most languages in the next 50 years. According to the predictions, we conclude the future distribution of main languages of the world. Moreover, an evaluation system is built considering the geographical location and the power of every city. The system is helpful to decide where to open new international office in order to work effectively with the development trend of language spread.

articleTitle: The Design of Magnetic Couplings Measuring and Controlling System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Magnetic Couplings mainly transmit energy through Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction. The magnetic field gap of the disk coupling has an important effect on slip and output torque. Therefore, precise control of the air thickness plays a crucial role in changing the output speed and torque of the magnetic coupling. This article plans to adopt the control system based on STM32 with PWM to drive the brushless DC motor and measure the rotating speed and angle with multichannel sensors in real time, so as to realize the automatic control of the air gap adjusting mechanism of the magnetic couplings.

articleTitle: Research of Personalized Recommendation Algorithm based on Similarity and Diversity
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Now the general recommendation system only recommends high similarity products, and if only the similarity is likely to cause the waste of resources and the unsuccessful recommendation, for example, a user likes to use WeChat. [1] Based on the similarity, it is possible to recommend the flying letter to him, so the function of the product is too similar and will cause it. Due to the waste of resources, the difference should be considered properly in the design of recommender systems. The idea of this paper is to complete the research of product attribute similarity algorithm first, and to complete the design of recommendation mechanism based on similarity and difference. Finally, the accuracy and recall rate of various recommendation mechanisms are compared by experiments to determine their superiority.

articleTitle: A Threat Targets Ranking Method Based on Competition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: We proposed a threat targets ranking method based on competition. Using a competitive function, we set up several competitive mechanisms. By using these competitive mechanisms, we successfully give an objective threat targets ranking, and we effectively avoid the normalization problem of threat attributes. This method makes good use of the joint information of targets, which can improve the use of mutual information to give a more reasonable result. We give an example to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Response Surface Method of Support Vector Machine based on Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The common form of response surface methods affect the accuracy of reliability calculation in the experimental design because of the over dependence on the selection of experimental points. Based on the characteristics of the Least Square Support Vector Machine (LSSVM), a method to obtain the approximate designed points was designed by using an adaptive Markov Chain to simulate the samples in the failure domain and the safety domain. The improved selection method of design point could be used to select the samples adaptively at the real limit state boundary, to improve the fitting precision of the real boundary and increase the calculation precision of reliability. In this article, two cases of the multiple failure mode and the single failure mode with complex boundary are studied and compared to other methods to illustrate the advantages of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm Based on Orthogonal Design in Path Design
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on artificial colony algorithm slow convergence speed in the process of operation, easy to appear stagnation phenomenon, etc, this paper proposes a adaptive artificial colony algorithm based on orthogonal design, on the basis of artificial colony algorithm, at the same time by orthogonal design, the orthogonal discrete solution space, adaptive adjustment of step length, improve the performance of the algorithm, is more advantageous to global optimization, convergence speed had the very big enhancement. The simulation results show that the algorithm has a better global optimal search ability and the convergence speed is greatly improved. The improved artificial swarm optimization algorithm solves the problem of group path optimization and provides a unique method for path design.

articleTitle: The Design of Multi-mode Control Strategy and Switching Method for Unmanned Electric Locomotive
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low efficiency and high risk of traditional mine electric locomotive, a multi-mode control strategy and switching method for unmanned electric locomotive are proposed in this paper. According to the degree of autonomy of the electric locomotive running process, the operation of the unmanned electric locomotive is divided into four control modes: autonomous mode, semi-autonomous model, automatic mode and manual mode. Among them, the autonomous mode is the normal operation mode. The semi-autonomous mode is mainly aimed at remote control of the ore drawing process. The automatic mode and manual mode refer to the emergency standby control mode when the electric locomotive system has different faults. According to factors such as mission requirements, working conditions and system status, the control mode can be selected and switched.

articleTitle: 24 GHz Dielectric Resonator Antenna for MMW Automotive Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna (CDRA) is proposed for millimeter wave (MMW) automotive radar (AR) systems. The antenna has moderate gain and beamwidth, good cross-polarization (XP) suppression, relative wide bandwidth, and another adjacent potential band. The antenna operates at 24 GHz, leading to very small size. In order to meet the requirements of fixation and alignment, an extra fixture is co-fabricated with the substrate made of the same material. The effect of the fixture on the dielectric resonator antenna is investigated by simulation. It is found that with the fixture, which has much shorter height and lower permittivity, the dielectric resonator stays almost unchanged in terms of resonant mode, resonant frequency, Q factor, and internal field. The antenna has a gain of 6 dB, a XP suppression of more than 40 dB, and a bandwidth of 22.6% at 24 GHz.

articleTitle: A Novel Quality Scalable Stereo Video Coding Algorithm Based on Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A novel quality scalable stereo video coding algorithm based on pattern recognition was proposed in this paper. The self-organizing map (SOM) was used for scalable stereo video coding in the proposed scheme. The coarse pattern libraries and fine pattern libraries were designed for video coding of different quality layers, respectively. Meanwhile, based on the characteristic of the algorithm, this paper puts forward a prediction coding algorithm based on the index of pattern vectors. It eliminates the time redundancy effectively. Experimental results show that compared with CGS, the peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) improvement of both views reconstructed video images is about 1.l5dB and 0.41dB respectively when the coding rate is smaller than 400Kbit/s.
