In order to distinguish the physical meaning of the two indicators, first the related definition is expounded, then based on linear array model, the performance analysis and comparison about the two indicators is performed via Matlab numerical simulation. Meanwhile the effects of noise field characteristic, working frequency and array design on the two performance indicators are investigated in detail.

articleTitle: An intelligent value chain model with internet enterprises based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Information asymmetry and false information are disturbing and have been damaging investors' interests in investment management. The current studies usually only aim to evaluate the value of enterprises to reduce the degree of information falsehood, but they can't solve the problem from the origin. In this paper, we use the blockchain technologies to restructure the enterprise value system to lower the impacts of these problems, including improving value chain of enterprises with smart-contracts, defining token as an incentive method and using token to evaluate the value of enterprises. Then implementing the new value system into the internet industry to accomplish industrialization. We find that the novel value system not only saves the costs of time and wages, but also ensures the authenticity and reliability of enterprises data.

articleTitle: A Node Localization Algorithm Based on Connection Constraint for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Wireless sensor network(WSN) is important for many strategic applications. Node localization is a key research issue in wireless sensor networks. A node localization algorithm based on connection constraint is proposed in this paper. The positions of the located nodes are estimated using the multi-hop reference nodes. At the first stage, the located nodes acquire their initial positions according to the connection information of the one-hop or multi-hop reference nodes. At the second stage, every node broadcasts its initial position to the neighbor nodes and refines its position information based on multi-hop connection constraint between each other. Numerical simulation results show that this localization algorithm is accurate and robust.

articleTitle: Research on the Relation between the Number of Measurements and Signal Sparsity in Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compressed sensing theory is a new theory which acquires, encodes and decodes sparse or appropriately sparse signals. The key issue in compressed sensing is to choose a suitable number of measurements which adapts to the signal sparsity. To get a more adaptive number of measurements, we choose random signals with different sparsities as experimental samples and modify the original relation between the number of measurements and signal sparsity. Compared with the original relation, the modified relation can ideally reconstruct the original signal with smaller measurements. Then we verify that the modified relation is not only applied to random signals but also has strong applicability to periodic signals.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Hoisting System of Warehouse Based on Similarity-Contrast Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the method of indirect measurement of rope bearing-force by similarity of force and analytic method of hoisting equipment' balance degree by comparison of difference of rope pulling force, the measured data is fed back to ground analysis terminal in real time during the trial hoisting process by adding auxiliary ropes without changing the structure of original ropes; the comprehensive analysis is carried out from three dimensions of force-bearing time, force-bearing size and similarity of force-bearing velocity to provide suggestions for hoisting scheme adjustment; and during the hoisting process, real-time warning for dangerous operations reduces the risks and possible losses.

articleTitle: User Authentication Protocol Based On Chebyshev Polynomial For Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the security problem of external users access to the wireless sensor networks, a new user authentication protocol with a key exchange function under the public-key system was proposed, the protocol based on the Chebyshev polynomials over finite fields have good chaos characteristic, semi-group property and the one-way trapped characteristic. This protocol can achieve the authentication process between user and network base station or sensor nodes, and completes the initialization of session key in the process of authentication. The analysis shows that the proposed protocol can meet the needs of the wireless sensor network for security authentication, and also has a good performance in authentication time, interaction, computational complexity, and security attacks.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm of Building Object Boundary Extraction Based on Oblique Photographic Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Conventional manual or semi-automatic oblique photographic monomerization methods are currently the mainstream methods for solving the monomerization task of oblique photography, which have high accuracy and flexibility but low efficiency, so they cannot be applied on a large scale. The precise and efficient monomerization of oblique photography is a key part of the further application of oblique photography models. This paper proposes an oblique photography object model boundary extraction algorithm based on geometric statistics information, and combines with the characteristics of the model data, analyzes the geometric information of the model, removes noise by the point cloud filtering algorithm, finally, finds the scene objects by multi-scale clustering algorithm. Experiments show that compared with manual or semi-automatic methods, this algorithm can obtain a complete object model, which can greatly improve the efficiency of oblique photographic monomerization.

articleTitle: Path and Transport Mode Selection in Multimodal Transportation with Time Window
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Multimodal transportation plays a vital role in the efficiency of social economic, the path and transport mode selection in multimodal transportation contribute to the benefit of carriers and customers directly, on the basis of analyzing the transportation cost and time cost of multimodal transportation, a multi-objective model is proposed. It works on minimization of transit and transfer costs, and in order to meet the customer's demand in time, a punishment is set up. According to the characteristics of the model, a Floyd-GA algorithm is designed, through which the relative shortest path is found and the transport mode is distributed for each route. Finally, comparing the results with the traditional method, the effectiveness of the above algorithms is testified.

articleTitle: Research on the Problem of Virtual Cell Reconfiguration based on Resource Element under New Task Insertion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Facing the flexible production path caused by multifunction equipment, in order to solve the problem of virtual cell reconfiguration under new task insertion, this paper proposed a new method termed resource elements to define equipment capabilities. First, use resource elements to describe equipment capacity and parts demand. Scecondly, calculate the fitness of new parts by similarity calculation formula, and determine if the virtual cells needs to be reconfigured, a mathematical model for virtual cell reconfiguration with the least production cost, equipment load deviation and cell adjustment amplitude has been built, and the NSGA-III algorithm is introduced to solve the multi-objective function, a series of nondominated solutions are obtained. Finally, the example demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the virtual cell reconfiguration method based on resource elements under new task insertion.

articleTitle: ISAR Images Segmentation Based on Spatially Variant Mixture Multiscale Autoregressive Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: ISAR images segmentation play a key role for characteristic extraction, target recognition, and target surveillance. This paper proposes a novel segmentation method of Inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) images, which employees a spatially variant mixture multiscale autoregressive (SVMMAR) model to segment ISAR images. The estimation of parameters of the model is easily performed via least square estimation and expectation maximization algorithm (EM algorithm). Moreover, a kind of method for selecting number of classes at a coarser scale is proposed, which reduced computation amount greatly. In order to improve the performance, the method characterizes and exploits multiscale stochastic structure inherent in ISAR image. The advantage of our proposed segmentation approach is that it is not only fast, but also able to automatically estimate all the model parameters, and easy to implement. Therefore, the model can be exploited for ISAR automatic target recognition easily. All of that are demonstrated by the experimental results.

articleTitle: A Novel Analysis Scheme for Static Voltage Stability of Distribution Network with DFIG and SVC
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to study the static voltage stability(SVS) of distribution network with DFIG and SVC, the static model of DFIG and SVC is analyzed. The voltage stability index(VSI) which can reflect the degree of voltage stability of all load buses is derived in this paper, and DFIG is connected according to the best wind resources. A voltage stability analysis scheme is presented to rapidly rank the voltage stability margin of load buses, and the vulnerable bus is determined as the best locations to install SVCs. The detail of voltage collapse is studied based on the improved continuous power flow(CPFLOW) method. Simulation results show that the strategy releases the reasonable location of SVC, which can optimize the power flow distribution. Moreover, it can further improve the power supporting ability and SVS of distribution network with DFIG, which enables the system to bear severer load increasing.

articleTitle: A New Modeling Method for Production Loss during the Warming in Serial Bernoulli Production Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Production loss always exists during the warming in the practical manufacturing environments. The modeling of production loss helps design and manage the production system effectively. In this paper, a new modeling method was proposed for the modeling of production loss during the warming in serial Bernoulli production lines. This research is established based on the transient analysis of production systems, based on which the production loss is represented by the difference between the expected production performance and the actual. The feasibility of the proposed method is demonstrated through the numerical cases. Comparison with the simulation results indicate that this method is accurate. According to the analysis presented in this paper, the impact of production loss is significant and should be considered when designing short-term production systems.

articleTitle: A new semi-quantum key distribution protocol with high efficiency
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Boyer et al put forward the first semi-quantum key distribution (BKM2007), which is completely robust while one side is limited. However, its efficiency is not satisfactory. In this paper, we present a high-efficient semi-quantum key distribution. The efficiency for qubits is approximately 50% while that is approximately 25% in the BKM2007 protocol, which means that the sifted key proportion of the SQKD protocol is double as that in the BKM2007 protocol. Furthermore, the proportion of information bits in our SQKD protocol is not lower than that of the BKM2007 protocol. Analysis shows that our protocol is still robust.

articleTitle: Research on Development of Face Recognition Based on Patent Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The application patents of face recognition as data sources are studied in the paper. Mainly using statistical analysis method and social network analysis method, high-level patent analysis was carried out in many aspects, such as main national distribution, main institutions, focal research points and key patents of face recognition. The research status and competition situation of face recognition are comprehensively revealed, aiming at providing reference for researchers who are in related fields to understand the development trend of face recognition.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a Path Planning Algorithm in the Intelligent Logistics Sorting System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligence of the logistics sorting system, a new path planning algorithm is proposed, which enables AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) to sort and transport the parcels automatically. The AGV, applied in model of AGV logistics sorting system presented in this paper, could classify the parcels waiting to be sorted effectively through the input image processing of UVC (USB video class) camera and the independent weight detection. Applying passive RFID positioning technology, a path will be designed to transport the parcels to the designated unloading port. Thus the task of sorting parcels is completed. Compared to the widely used mechanical sorting system, this system makes transport routes more flexible and the sorting more efficient, meanwhile, the cost is lower with the passive RFID network to design the AGV navigation. At last, several simulated texts were well carried out on the experimental platform and the effectiveness and practicability of the system is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Multi Parameter Logic Threshold Drive Control Strategy for Distributed Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper introduces the structure and working principle of distributed hybrid vehicles, the simulation model of vehicle has been built by graphical modeling of MATLAB/Simulink. The multi parameter logic threshold optimization work region of driving control strategy based on the engine optimal work region was proposed, which considers the rational work region of battery with the boundary velocity threshold. Based on Matlab/Simulink, 0-32km/h acceleration simulation was carried out. The simulation results show that the designed multi parameter logic threshold drive control strategy can reasonably allocate the target torque of the engine and the motor. While ensuring that the engine and battery pack operate in a better working area, the power performance of the vehicle is improved.

articleTitle: Design of distance measuring and reversing system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The main work of this paper is to design and implement a set of ultrasonic ranging system which uses STC89C51 single chip microcomputer as the main control chip, uses ultrasonic ranging sensor HC - SR04 as the ranging method, and uses DS18B20 temperature sensor to correct the sound speed in the current measuring environment, displays and alarms the ranging result with LCD12864 liquid crystal display and buzzer, and supports the function of modifying the alarm distance.

articleTitle: New Algorithm for Adaptive Current Protection Setting of Fan Connected to Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: After the wind turbine is integrated into the distribution network through the inverter, the distribution network of the original one-way trend is transformed into a complicated distribution network with two-way power flow, so that the traditional current protection can not meet the safe operation of the powergrid. To solve this problem, a newalgorithm for calculating the back-side impedance and fault type coefficients is proposed based on the new type of current protection in the distribution network. It can meet the requirement that the wind turbine is connected to the distribution network and is reliable in the protection range, Within the protection of reliableaction. To solve the traditional current protection can not adapt to the system impedance changes, changes in wind power access and short circuit type changes caused by security risks. The feasibility of the new algorithm of adaptive current protection is verified by using MATLAB to build the distribution network model.

articleTitle: Influences of Track Random Irregularity on the Performance of Levitation Control System of Medium-speed Maglev Train
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the operation of Changsha maglev express, the track irregularity is a great adverse impact of driving the maglev train; it will directly cause the abnormal fluctuation of levitation clearance and current, and will influence the levitation control system operation. This paper modeled a levitation system considering track irregularity; it is analyzing the performance of levitation control system, under various track irregularity conditions, at different speeds. It can be used to optimize the parameters of the levitation control system for medium speed maglev train, and provide the formulation of track construction standards.

articleTitle: Soc Estimation of Vanadium Redox Flow Battery Based on OCV-DKF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: SOC(State of Charge) of VRB(Vanadium redox flow battery) is an important parameter for evaluating battery performance and estimating battery capacity, it is also a key basis for management and control of energy storage systems. In order to improve the estimation accuracy of SOC, a complex algorithm based on OCV(Open Circuit Voltage) and DKF(Double Kalman Filter) is proposed. After theoretical analysis and process derivation, a real-time charge/discharge simulation platform for 5kW/30 kWh VRB energy storage system was set up. The SOC was online estimated by using OCV-SOC curve and DKF algorithm. The results was compared with EKF(Extended Kalman Filter) algorithm and Ah method. Experiments show that the DKF algorithm has a better estimation effect and can stabilize the SOC estimation error within 1.5%.

articleTitle: Economical Optimal Operation of Multi-energy System Considering Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Considering the influence on operation of multienergy system from the uncertainty of source-load and analyzing the randomness and fuzziness of renewable energy and loads of cooling, heating and power. The distribution of renewable energy and loads of cooling, heating and power is built through 2-stage Fourier fitting. Then, fuzzing the fitting parameters distribution in order to get build the random-fuzzy model. According to the definition of expectation, optimistic value, and pessimistic value, the expectation and fluctuation limit based on confidence level is calculated in order to verify the efficiency of model. Through the particle swarm optimization, the scheduling result of CCHP system based on economic is calculated. And the influence of optimization result from uncertainty is analyzed. The result confirms that the random-fuzzy model is efficient and particle.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Compensation Characteristics of DSTATCOM under Unbalanced Load
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper introduces a Distribution Static Synchronous Compensator(DSTATCOM) used in three-phase three-wire system. Reactive harmonic detecting method of directly controlling source current is adopted. The fundamental principles of DSTATCOM of this controlling method are presented and the compensation features of unbalanced load is analyzed. The validity of this kind of DSTATCOM and compensation features of unbalanced load are proved by Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: A Dependence-First Clustering Based Partitioning Algorithm for Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Cipher Logic Array
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the special structure of Reconfigurable Computation Block (RCB) of Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Cipher Logic Array (CGCRA), it's necessary to partition data flow graph (DFG) transformed from block cipher algorithms, this paper proposed a dependence-first clustering based partitioning algorithm (DFCBP). The algorithm considers not only the number constraint of nodes but also the type constraint of nodes, to minimize the number of partition clusters and inter-cluster communication edges, node priority in ready list will be updated each partition based on priority function Nodepriority. In addition, partition quality function Costcluster is designed to evaluate performance of task partitioning algorithms. Experimental results show that, compared with existing clustering based partitioning (CBP) and level sensitive cluster based partitioning (LSCBP) algorithms, DFCBP can obtain the least number of partition clusters and inter-cluster communication overheads, about 4.6% and 10.7% average least reduction respectively, meanwhile, comprehensive partition quality is best, in favor for subsequent placement and routing.

articleTitle: Terahertz Essential Devices Technique Research Based on Quantum Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Since entering 2000, with the wireless applications and technologies great fast increase, the need for spectral resource is much huge. It is becoming key point that the wireless frequency steps toward higher terahertz frequency band in the academic research aspect. The paper conducts a comparison and discussion on the properties of THz frequency band with other band; Then analyzes the essential conditions on construction quantum transmission system; Afterward, concentrates on the important devices techniques analysis for the emission and detection aspects in THz system; Later, provides the relative experimental development progress; At last, summaries a main technique and application trend of quantum transmission in coming year. All of these studies have useful academic reference value and application significance in the quantum communication field to the specialists later research.

articleTitle: Research on Outlet Schemes of Indoor Substations Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Limited urban land resources turn the floor area into an issue with more and more attention during the construction process of substations. Compactness and miniaturization have become the developing direction of urban indoor substations in the future. It is found out from the limiting factor of substation area that the outlet method is directly correlated with it. Based on the common outlet schemes, a new outlet method, positive and negative triangle outlet, is proposed. In order to highlight the advantages of positive and negative triangle outlet compared to normal outlet schemes, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is adopted to quantitatively evaluate the weights of each outlet scheme under four criteria, including electric power environmental protection, installation and operation difficulty, costs for electrical distribution transformation and area, and their sub-indexes and determine the optimal outlet scheme that meets the requirements. It is feasible to establish the outlet model of indoor substations through AHP based on the actual project situations. The algorithm can realize the quantification of qualitative indexes and determine the optimal outlet scheme so as to provide certain reference for choice of outlet schemes for urban indoor substations.

articleTitle: Testing Research on Auxiliary Circuit Oscillation Characteristic Parameters for High Voltage DC Transfer Switch
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to achieve the safety and reliability running of high voltage DC transfer switch, the field testing system of auxiliary circuit oscillation characteristics are researched in this paper. The type, structure principle and transfer mathematics model of high voltage DC transfer switch are analyzed, proposed the testing principle and method, completed the capacitor and current attenuation characteristics testing for four type DC switch, calculated the characteristic parameters of auxiliary circuit (such as the attenuation period, oscillation frequency, loop inductance, damping resistance, etc.), which based on the characteristic requirement of DC switch in a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 800\mathrm{kV}$</tex> converter station. The test results show that the oscillation characteristic parameters of four type DC switch auxiliary circuits can meet the requirements of HVDC transmission system, and also proved the validity and correctness of the testing method and system. It can provides the basis for the field testing application in the UHV converter station.

articleTitle: Study on Decision Making of Travel Mode Based on Fuzzy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to study the choice of urban residents' travel mode, the travel mode satisfaction evaluation model for convenience, distance, time, comfort and cost was proposed by using fuzzy methods. Combining the travel needs for different income families, the fuzzy membership model for residents' travel requirements was constructed, and a satisfactory travel pattern for urban residents was draw by using fuzzy planning. The illustration shows that it is appropriate to use fuzzy means to study the law of residents' travel. And the choice of travel mode for residents with different income and travel needs is different. The model can be used for traffic planning and transportation policy making.

articleTitle: The Path Modeling and Evaluation Analysis of Jamming
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The paper quantitatively studies the flight path problem of the jammer, which has a strong practical significance for evaluating the jamming effect, optimizing the jamming path and saving jamming resources. First, this paper studied the effective suppression range of the jammer under suppression jamming conditions, and then established two typical mathematical models of the jammer flight path within this range: the racetrack and the “8”- shaped. On this basis, the effective time utilization ratio and the average jamming power are proposed. Finally, we could say that the “8”- shaped path could produce more permanent jamming time to the radar via simulation experiments, and verify the correctness of mathematical modeling and the reliability of the evaluation method.

articleTitle: A Fast and Adaptive Algorithm for Air Compound Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: There are many difficulties in air target tracking, includes: 1) air targets are quick maneuvered; 2) air targets have such two characteristics as combination and complexity, one target will split some other targets; 3) multi-target trajectories are diverse, dense and sparse targets coexist; 4) it is easily affected by obstructions, interference and so on. In this paper, a fast and adaptive algorithm for air compound targets tracking is proposed, which is used to solve the fast tracking of multiple compound targets in the air. The compound target processor is constructed, which can solve problems of multiple targets separation, multiple dense targets tracking, targets occlusion loss measurement and so on. Experimental result is shown that the algorithm has good tracking accuracy and tracking performance in tracking dense and sparse air multi-target simultaneously.

articleTitle: Design of Multichannel High-speed Synchronous Data Acquisition System Based on Multi-FPGA and Distributed Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Multichannel high-speed Synchronous acquisition for real-time signals has been developed in modern science. The design architecture proposed this paper consists of three components: sampling board, top module and upper monitor. FPGA as controller is used in the sampling board and top module, with adopting distributed control strategy for multi-FPGA. Double-layer transmission protocol designed this paper is constructed for data transmission among sampling board and top module. DDR2 as storage is equipped with in top module, and USB 3.0 is applied for data transmission between DDR2 and upper monitor. This architecture makes the DAS has high time and space accuracy and is helpful for arc plasma analysis applied in experiments. A detailed description of the experiment result is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Software Simulation Technology of New Generation Smart Substation Secondary System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the new generation smart substations, how to carry out a reasonable assessment and design defect warning for the whole substation before construction is one of the important topics of attention. This paper proposes the software simulation technology for new generation smart substation secondary system. The software simulation technology can simulate the communication behavior of MMS/GOOSE and the universal event response mechanism. The simulation system can achieve the single device simulation verification, the bay operation simulation check and the whole station operation simulation check of the new generation smart substation secondary system. By simulating the action state of the secondary system, the correctness and rationality of the SCD file can be verified, and the reasonableness evaluation and the design defect warning of the substation before construction can be carried out. It greatly simplifies the complexity of the device and system debugging, and improves the efficiency of the integrated debugging of the smart substation automation system.

articleTitle: An Improved Adaptive ET-PHD Algorithm for Newborn Target Intensity
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the case of unknown new target intensity, the traditional extended target probability hypothesis density (ET-PHD) filtering algorithm has a poor tracking effect. In this paper, an ET-PHD filtering algorithm based on measurement driven adaptive new target intensity is proposed. The new target intensity function is adaptively generated by the measured values obtained each time. The survival target and the new target are propagating in the prediction and updating stages and implemented under the Gauss mixture framework. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has a great advantage over the target number estimation and the OSPA distance compared with the traditional ET-GM-PHD filtering algorithm and improves the tracking performance of the extended target PHD filter.

Author Keywords: extended target probability hypothesis density filtering

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Inversion Control for a Hypersonic Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A dynamic neural adaptive inversion control is designed for flexible hypersonic vehicles with the characters of nonlinearity, strong couplings and parameters uncertainties. Firstly, an inverse controller is designed for hypersonic vehicle longitudinal mode, engine throttle setting and elevator declination as control inputs, then introduce adaptive signals as inverse control signal components. Secondly, the dynamic neural is used to reconstruct the inverse error and the stability and robustness of the system's influence on the uncertainty are guaranteed while ensuring the approximation performance. Finally, the controller stability is analyzed. Simulation is conducted under trimmed cruise conditions. The effectiveness and feasibility of the control method are verified by the results of simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of a New Digital Hydraulic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new digital hydraulic transformer was designed, whose pressure transformation ratio can be changed discretely according to natural numbers pattern through combinations of piston area in multistage hydraulic cylinders. Taking one of the realization forms as an example, design and realization methods were given. Compared with the digital hydraulic transformer designed by Elton Daniel Bishop, the new digital hydraulic transformer makes full use of operation states of hydraulic cylinders, and the same number of hydraulic cylinders can be used to construct more pressure transformation ratio which makes the pressure change smoother. The utilization ratio of hydraulic cylinders and the output fluctuation of hydraulic control units are analyzed, and the more the number of hydraulic cylinders is, the more obvious its advantage.

articleTitle: Research on Filtering Method of Monopulse Radar Angular Glint Suppression
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Monopulse radars increase the detection capability and distance resolution, but also make the angular glint become obvious. This will cause large angle measurement and angle tracking error, and the quality of terminal guidance will be seriously affected without effective suppression. On the basis of not changing the radar system, this paper carries out experiments on two kinds of signal processing methods with good application in engineering, and further optimizes the better method with an extended Kalman filter. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has a good suppression effect on angular glint, and the algorithm is relatively simple, which is worthy of application in engineering and provides a possibility for further improving the guidance accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of handwritten digit recognition system based on template method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the basic principles of handwritten digit recognition are introduced, including the basic principles and methods of digital image preprocessing and feature extraction using template method. Secondly, the implementation steps of handwritten digits recognition are introduced. Finally, the experimental results, analysis and conclusions are obtained. Experimental results show that this method has a high recognition rate and a good noise immunity.

articleTitle: Target Clustering Algorithm Based on Similarity Matrix in Radar Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, the problem of target clustering for radar detection still has some problems, such as low operating efficiency and low accuracy. In this paper, a target clustering algorithm based on similarity matrix is proposed, which has some significant advantages, including easy implementation, high efficiency, applicability. According to the distribution characteristics of radar detection target, this algorithm defines the similarity calculation method between target attributes and constructs the similarity matrix and achieves the target matrix clustering by row-column change criterion and judging criterion. This algorithm designed the maintenance rules to implement dynamic maintenance of the cluster structure in case of the change of cluster structure. In the end, the algorithm test case verifies the correctness of the algorithm, validity and applicability of the proposed algorithm by SPSS.

articleTitle: Flash Faults Analysis of Signal Lamp of Circuit Breaker on Affusion Electrical Machinery
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The reason for the signal lamp of affusion electrical machine breaker gleaming in the station of the oil field is summarized in this paper. The faults are analyzed which are caused because of the connection between the affusion electrical machine in the station and power equipment in the transformer substation and leaving behind hidden trouble in the project. The improved measure is proposed and the noted matter in the running process are also given.

articleTitle: Cooperative CSMA/CA: A MAC Protocol for Cooperative Wireless PMP/Mesh Hybrid Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To take full advantage of wireless mesh networks and cooperative transmission simultaneously, a cooperative PMP/Mesh topology is presented in this paper. Firstly, a hierarchy cooperative mesh topology is presented. Secondly, cooperative CSMA/CA, a modified medium - access-control protocol is proposed to support cooperative PMP and relay links in PMP/Mesh hybrid access networks. Simulation results show that the cooperative CSMA/CA can support cooperative PMP/Mesh hybrid access networks effectively.

articleTitle: Cross Polarization in Large-scale Rectangular Waveguide Slot Array Antenna with Parallel Metallic Plates
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A part of constructed large-scale waveguide slot array antenna ultilized in Surface Monitor Radar(SMR) is proposed in this thesis, to which slotted rectangular waveguide with parallel metallic plates in this narrow-beam antenna is applied in order to restrain cross-polarization and obtain relative pure linear polarization so that excellent radiation performance is guaranteed. However, it is figured that the size of the parallel metallic plates can affect cross-polarization at centain frequency range we concern visibly, especially in such a large-scale array antenna, and vast slots graved in waveguide produce acceptable linear polarization but lead to severe cross polarization. Some tips to control cross polarization will be raised and datas about simulation and actual measurement will be shown in this article.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Taylor Network Optimal Control for Dynamic Positioning of Offshore Oil Drilling Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: There is a large amount of petroleum stored in the ocean. With the rapid decline of terrestrial oil reserves, it is of greatly practical significance to research into offshore oil extraction technology. A multi-dimensional Taylor network (MTN) optimal control scheme for dynamic positioning of offshore oil drilling platforms under wind, wave, and flow disturbances was proposed, which requires neither controlled object model nor disturbance measurement. Firstly, a three-degree-of-freedom nonlinear mathematical model and an environmental disturbance model for the drilling platform are established. Then PID optimal controller, backstepping optimal controller (needing the precise controlled object model and disturbance measurement) and MTN optimal controller are designed. Finally, Matlab simulation platform is built to simulate the models. The results show that the control effect of MTN optimal controller is the best under the same conditions.

articleTitle: Finite-time Distributed Event-triggered Consensus Control for Leader-following General Linear Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the finite-time containment consensus problem for multi-agent systems with general linear dynamics. Finite time consensus can reach consensus faster and have better disturbance rejection properties compared with conventional asymptotic consensus. Hence, we propose a distributed, independent and asynchronous event-triggered control protocol with leaders. We demonstrate that each follower agent can achieve consensus to the convex hull spanned by the leaders' agents in a certain time regardless of the initial condition under this event-triggered control strategy.

articleTitle: An Efficient Near-Field Parallel Subarray Beamforming for Portable 3D Imaging Sonar
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In complex water environment, the portable 3D imaging sonar is one of the main techniques for flexible underwater tasks, especially in the near field. In the literature, an efficient digital beamforming called parallel subarray (PS) has been introduced for portable 3D sonar working in the far field. This paper proposes an extension of the PS beamforming algorithm that enables to process the multi-frequency signals acquired by the cross array from a scene in the near field. The proposed algorithm achieves two stage parallel beamforming and applies an optimized approximation delay for the near-field beam pattern in the two stage beamforming. Then, the architecture of the algorithm performed on the field programmable gate array (FPGA) is illustrated. The near-field beam pattern of the algorithm is similar to that of the direct method while computational requirement is the lowest compared to other existing methods. To test the validity of the algorithm, a real system was devised and employed in the lake. The results showed that the proposed algorithm could generate satisfactory 3D underwater images.

articleTitle: Adaptive Robust High-degree Cubature Filter Based On Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Target tracking system has strong-nonlinearity with non-Gaussian noise, thus making traditional Cubature Kalman Filter have low tracking accuracy due to sensitivity to non-Gaussian noise. Considering that the High-degree CKF and Maximum Correntropy Kalman Filter can conquer the nonlinearity of system and non-Gaussianity of measurement noise and system noise respectively, the measurement update process of HCKF is transformed to statistical linear regression equation based on the combination of Maximum Correntropy Criterion and HCKF, and adjust the kernel width adaptively, which solves the nonlinearity and non-Gaussianity problem. Simulation proves that the proposed robust generalized high-degree cubature filter is better than traditional CKF and simple MCKF both in tracing accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimizing Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication on GPUs via Index Compression
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Sparse matrix-vector multiplication (SpMV) as one of the most significant scientific kernels has been widely used in many scientific disciplines. In practical applications, large-scale spare matrices are usually used for calculation. During these years, Graphic Processing Unit (GPU) has become a powerful platform for high-performance computing, and optimizing SpMV on GPU based systems for efficient performance is the principal interest in many researches. In this paper, we proposed a new method to optimize SpMV on GPUs via index compression. Our index compression method can reduce the index value of the access space. The memory space for recording each column index is significantly reduced from two bytes to one byte, which outperforms the previous work on access performance. The main contributions we make are as follows: (1) Only one byte for each column index is required, which can significantly reduce the working set of the column index and further improve the cache hit ration. (2) Our method can be applied to any kind of matrices, while the previous work can only apply to subset of the matrices. Computational experiments on problems according to the previous work reveal that the best performance improvement ration for ours is up to about 1.5.

articleTitle: Joint Delay and Angle Estimation Algorithm with Low-Complexity in Multipath Environments
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Joint estimation of delay and angle in multipath environments is a key link in wireless positioning. A joint delay and angle estimation at low complexity based on propagator method of the extended subspace is presented. The propagator method is used to estimate the extended noise subspace of the received signal, and the parameters are automatically paired. The algorithm not only effectively reduces the computational complexity, but also accomplishes the high precision estimation when the number of paths exceeds the number of antennas. The validity and feasibility of the proposed algorithm are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: An improved fast self-healing feeder automation system
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability and intelligence of the distributed intelligent feeder automation system with fast self-healing performance, this paper summed up a fault allocation, isolation and restoration principle which adaptive to the open-loop distribution system and closed-loop distribution system. Firstly, the intelligent switch with the fault current which in the allocated fault area should be tripped quickly. Then, three-phase once auto-reclosing will be started, if the transient fault happened in the transmission line, the switch will be reclosed successfully and the distribution network recovered; otherwise the switch will not be reclosed and send the “trip order” message to the neighbor switch which in the allocated fault area, this method can distinguish between transient fault and permanent fault, and reduce the action times of the switch by any possibility. At last, examples are given to illustrate this improved distributed intelligent feeder automation system. It is shown that meaningful fault allocation is achieved even in the case of uncertain fault diagnosis of distribution grids.

articleTitle: A Method for Morphological Reconstruction of Long Board Structure based on Segmented Calibration of Resistance Strain Gauges
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Researches on the morphological sensing and reconstruction methods for key long board structure of aerospace vehicles are of great significance to the safe and reliable operation of these spacecraft. Therefore, a method for morphological reconstruction of flexible long board structure based on the segmentation calibration of resistance strain gauges is proposed in this paper. The morphological reconstruction algorithm of long board structure based on strain information is introduced at first. Then, a long board model morphology visualization experiment platform is constructed, and an optimized arrangement and segmented calibration method for the resistance strain gauges array is explained. Finally, the verification of real-time sensing and reconstruction experiments of the long board structure is performed. The results show that the morphological perception and reconstruction effect of long board structure experimental model is expected, which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Portable CNC Torque Wrench Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a constant torque wrench controller, which uses an embedded system controlled, with the method of multiple indexes. The torque error is regulated by the self-calibration module in a range within ±1.5 %. The current is controllable up to hundreds of amperes with the protection module set to ensure safety. The torque settings and wrench work information can be traced for convenience of usage.

articleTitle: Motion control of the self-walking hydrostatic driving tracked tractor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The hydrostatic driving tracked tractor was widely applied in the modern agriculture for its high adaptability to the working environment. By analyzing the motion of hydrostatic driving tracked tractor and combing the model of tracked tractor and the hydrostatic driving pump-motor with the rotational velocity adjustment control scheme, the paper design the control system of hydrostatic driving tracked tractor. In response to the motion of steering and straight-line driving, taking the mass-center velocity and rotational angular velocity of the tracked tractor as the expected inputs, meanwhile, using Matlab/Simulink toolbox to build and verify the hydrostatic driving tracked tractor system. The simulated result shows that, under the control of fuzzy PID controller, the hydrostatic driving tracked tractor was able to steer and drive along the straight line while reached the target of self-walking.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Cylindrical Helical Antenna based on Liquid Metal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A novel technique of fluidic metal frequency reconfigurable antenna with adjustable shape was presented. The gallium indium liquid alloy (EGaIn) is wrapped in a highly stretchable elastomer with a cylindrical helical antenna as the prototype. The interfacial tension of EGaIn is increased (or reduced) by electrochemistry at EGaIn surface formed (or destroyed) oxide layer, and the capillary force is used to drive the EGaIn flow in the microfluidic channel. The antenna is continuously adjusted by DC low voltage to control the length of the radiation unit and realize the change of the resonant frequency of the antenna. The antenna is designed and simulated by ANSYS software, and a good input impedance matching is obtained. And the antenna can work in the frequency range of 0.75~1.25GHz with a gain of 5dB.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Risk of Network Assets and Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The research technology in these areas has been relatively mature and technological progress has been improved. Bottleneck. Today's mainstream vulnerability scanning systems, when scanning vulnerabilities on very large or complex networks, consume a lot of time and bandwidth costs, but they scan a large number of vulnerabilities that have very low availability. Establishing a full-asset full-vulnerability scan task, while ensuring the accuracy of vulnerability scans to a certain degree, is often not worth the effort compared to the costly cost. For this reason, this paper seeks to screen and classify vulnerability scanning tasks before they are created, so that selective and targeted vulnerability scanning tasks can be performed.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Analysis of Wall Bushing Typical Partial Discharge Fault in Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: There are many reasons for the partial discharge in switchgear, so to achieve the safety and reliability operation of switchgear is more important. The internal partial discharge of wall bushing in switchgear are researched by employing the transient earth voltage detection method, ultrasonic detection method and ultra high frequency detection method based on the partial discharge case. Based on the related testing data, the amplitude, type and reason of partial discharge are discussed, and the location of partial discharge are accomplished by using the method of the acoustic-electric location method. The signal of partial discharge of wall bushing disappears after the treatment. The study shows that it can provide a reference basis for the practical measurement and accurate location for the internal partial discharge fault of wall bushing in the switchgear.

articleTitle: State Estimation of Innovation Graph for PMU Power Grid Observation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The observability of topology structure of state estimation based on innovation graph method is studied. The equivalent method of unobservable network is given. The influence of equivalent process on the state estimation of innovation graph is analyzed, and the applicable conditions of identifying bad data, topological errors and parameter errors by innovation graph method are analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Aviation Power Supply Test Information Management and Reporting Automatic Generation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the traditional test of aviation power supply, it takes a lot of time and energy to manually record and process test data and issue relevant test reports. According to the actual production situation of the aviation power supply test, based on. Net platform of the C# language support for Word - API, combined with SQL Server 2017 database, developed a set of aviation power supply test template design and management, the automation of test data recording and processing, automatic generation of test reports and other functions in the integration of aviation power supply test data processing system. Combined with the practical application, the implementation effect of the system is analyzed, and the feasibility and stability of the system are verified.

articleTitle: EPICS based beam energy measurement system for proton LINAC
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Beam energy is a key property to determine the accelerator performance. A real-time and non-destructive method should be used for the energy measurement. In this paper, an energy measurement system based on Experimental physics and industrial control systems (EIPCS) is designed and developed for a proton LINAC. The original signals are from beam position monitor, which give us the beam phase information through its electronics. An algorithm from beam energy to phase is deduced. Based on EPICS, the client completes the data acquisition, the IOC achieves beam energy measurement algorithms, and last a whole energy measurement OPI performed by CSS.

articleTitle: Space Load Forecasting Considering Distributed Energy and Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compared with the traditional load forecasting, the spatial load forecasting pays more attention to the load distribution in a certain local area or space, so it can better determine the selection and spatial layout of the electrical equipment, which plays an important role in the planning of the urban power grid. The rapid development of distributed energy and electric vehicles has broken the original law of urban load development, and makes the urban spatial load distribution more complex. The original load forecasting method based time series may bring large error to the prediction results, which is not conducive to the economy and reliability of urban power grid planning. Because the least squares support vector machine has strong nonlinear mapping ability, this paper establishes a LS-SVM based spatial load forecasting model for distributed and electric vehicle charging load based on the analysis of the core influence factors of various kinds of loads. Finally, a practical example in a certain area of central China shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Synchronization of Stochastic Memory Neural Networks with Time-varying Delays via Feedback control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper investigated the exponential synchronization of SMNN with time-varying delays. Controllers without and with time delays are applied for the exponential synchronization of the SMNN system. Combining the theories of differential inclusions and set valued maps, corresponding sufficient conditions of exponential synchronization are obtained by using Lyapunov function, mean-value inequality and Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. Finally, numerical simulations are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed theoretical results.

articleTitle: QBC-Softmax Algorithm for E-nose Data Processing Based on Different Informativeness Evaluations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An electronic nose is an intelligent system for recognizing various gases, which consists of a gas sensor array and patter recognition algorithms. In general, getting a well-performing model requires a large number of labeled samples. However, labeled samples are always difficult, time-consuming or expensive to obtain. In fact, it is far easier to collect unlabeled samples than labeled ones. In this paper, one of the active learning algorithms, an improved query by committee algorithm for the softmax classifier, is applied to E-nose to reduce the size of samples that needs to be labeled. Firstly, three informativeness evaluations (Jensen-Shannon divergence, Hellinger divergence and Kellback-Leibler divergence) are applied to compute the divergence degree among the committee members' vote results for query samples. Secondly, a pool-based sampling strategy is adopted to pick out the informative query samples, which considers the average divergence degree of the whole query samples as the threshold. The results have shown that the proposed method performed better than the random selection method. Specially, when the size of the initial training set is small, Hellinger divergence has the best performance. The Jensen-Shannon divergence and Kellback-Leibler divergence perform better with the increasing of size of the train set.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization Algorithm of Urban Road Recognition System based on DM6437
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the robustness and realtime performance of vehicle safety assistant driving system for identifying the front driving environment, an optimized algorithm for road image processing and lane detection is proposed. Aiming at the characteristic structure of road image, we use static partition and image processing in the region of interest. After the grayscale processing, the optimized median filtering algorithm is used to remove the noise. In the process of lane detection and fitting, the Hough algorithm is improved based on the characteristics of lane lines. When Kalman filtering is used to track lane lines, Hough transform and least square method are used to identify lane lines. Finally, the algorithm is transplanted to the DM6437 hardware platform, and the software code is optimized by combining the architecture features of the embedded system. The actual experimental results verify the real-time performance and robustness of the optimized algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on no-load current and low-side entrance capacitor of transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, through the no-load test data of 1000kV transformer, it is found that the no-load current is capacitive, contrary to the conclusion that the transformer is equivalent to the inductive load of the power supply when it is noload. In this paper, the causes of this phenomenon are analyzed, and the low-side entrance capacitor is introduced, and the corresponding calculation method is given.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Location Algorithm for UHVDC Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The fault location methods of UHVDC transmission lines can be divided into traveling-wave-based algorithm and fault-analysis-based algorithm according to the principle. This paper presents a novel fault location algorithm, which first uses the fault analysis method to obtain the current distribution along the DC line, and then obtains the characteristic curve of the traveling waves head propagation by detecting the first mutation time of the current distribution along the line, finally calculates the fault location by using the principle of traveling-wave-based fault location algorithm. Compared with the existing fault location algorithms for UHVDC transmission lines, although the calculation process of the fault location algorithm in this paper is more complex, its reliability, anti-interference ability and resistance to transient resistance are significantly improved, it retains the advantages of travelling wave fault location featuring high positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Object detection based on Online hard examples mining with residual network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to detect objects more correctly in pictures, an object detection algorithm based on the Online hard example mining with residual network is put forward, which takes Faster R-CNN as a benchmark. The working method of Faster R-CNN based on deep learning is portrayed, and the drawback and improvement ways of the algorithm are analyzed. More specifically, a residual network is used to replace the original ZF or VGG network to obtain more effective deep convolution feature maps. Besides, in order to strengthen the generalization capacity of the learning network model, the network parameters with hard examples are regenerated during training to make the network training more effectively. Finally, results of the experiments on Pascal VOC2007, Pascal VOC2007+VOC2012 and BIT datasets indicate that compared with Faster R-CNN, our method improves detection accuracy by 3.5%, 7.1%, 6.4% severally on the three datasets.

articleTitle: A Solution on Tibetan Speech Synthesis Based on HMM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Speech synthesis is mainly utilized to solve the problem of transforming text information to speech information. For the Tibetan speech synthesis, this paper proposes a complete solution on speech synthesis adapting the rules of the Tibetan language. In the proposed method, the key technologies on the front and back ends of the synthesis are respectively elaborated, including speech corpus selecting, Tibetan-Latin transliterating, word segmentation, text analyzing, prosodic labeling, vocoder technology, speech modeling, and problem-set design, etc. The experiment results illustrate that the test system of Tibetan speech synthesis using the proposed methods can obtain good performances.

articleTitle: Equalization Charge-discharge Control Strategy for Series-connected Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries Based on LC Oscillation Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Research on series-connection vanadium redox flow batteries (S-VRBs) energy storage technology, an equalization scheme based on LC oscillation circuit is proposed. The inductor and capacitor are used to store energy and the state of charge (SOC) is used as an equalization criterion. The energy is transferred from the highest voltage VRB to the lowest voltage VRB. We build a simulation model of LC oscillation circuit in MATLAB/SUMLINK to verify the feasibility of the equalization scheme; and the VRB with different parameters is connected in series for charging and discharging equalization experiments. Simulations show that the LC oscillator circuit equalization control strategy can achieve VRB charge and discharge equalization, and the equalization speed is fast.

articleTitle: A Study on Moving Object Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, the research of target tracking technology has become a key project in the field of vision research. This paper presents a new type of moving object detection algorithm. The algorithm is based on particle filter algorithm, the inter-frame difference method is added to realize the target tracking and the detection of motion state, and the resampling is used to solve the particle degradation problem. The accuracy of the algorithm for realizing the detection of moving targets is verified.

articleTitle: Robust Virtual Network Mapping Algorithm with Optimal Shared-path Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Network virtualization has been proposed as a promising way for running multiple customized virtual networks (VNs) on a shared infrastructure. However, how to provide reliable VN against substrate infrastructure failures has become an increasingly important issue. Meanwhile the substrate network resource cost should be minimized under VN reliability guarantees to maximize the revenue for the Infrastructure Providers (InPs). In this paper, we present a novel heuristic VN mapping algorithm called RVNM, which includes a node mapping scheme based on substrate node reliability awareness and a link mapping scheme based on shared-path protection. Simulation results show that algorithm can improve virtual node robustness without reserving protection resource and gain near optimal network bandwidth usage compared to the previous algorithms.

articleTitle: Term Extraction in Chinese Patent Claim
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of natural language processing technology, its application of patents is more and more extensive. Patent terms extraction technology is widely used in patent analysis, patent layout and patent maps. In this paper, a method of extracting terminology based on linguistics and statistics is proposed. This method counts the high-frequency of term part-of-speech rules of patent claims, the term extraction is based on high-frequency rules, and an algorithm based on Jaccard's similarity coefficient and the longest common subsequence method is proposed to filter and rank the terms and eventually obtain a patent glossary. Experiments show that this method can effectively extract domain terms and improve the extraction of low-frequency terms.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Sentence Similarity Calculation Method Based on Multiple Features
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Chinese sentence similarity calculation is widely used in the field of natural language processing, and the similarity calculation method is also varied. This paper introduces the similarity calculation method based on shallow Information, based on the similarity of part of speech, and also analyzes their calculation principles and calculation methods. Their advantages and disadvantages are given. At the same time, it puts forward the idea of using deep learning thinking to automatically learn the essential information of data from large-scale text data. Using the word2vec model, sentence processing is reduced to word vectors. It also proposes a method for calculating the similarity of shallow features, parts of speech features, and features of word vectors. The experimental results show that compared with the conventional method, the accuracy of the algorithm in calculating the sentence similarity is higher.

Author Keywords: shallow information part of speech features

articleTitle: A Study based on a bank of Kalman Filters design for Gas Turbine Accessory Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel method integrating system identification of experimental data from hydraulic actuator rig with Kalman filters for fault detection and isolation of a gas turbine accessory. Application of experimental data from hydraulic actuator rig for fault detection and isolation (FDI) of a gas turbine accessory which is of great interest to industry is proposed. The hydraulic actuator rig is designed to simulate different gas turbine accessory fault. The faults that typically occur in practice injected into real hardware subsystems to record the precise response. Through using this very realistic data the fault models are then established. Then these models are incorporated into the gas turbine engine simulation. In order to realize this, the transfer function based on the experimental data from the rig has been setup and integrated into the diagnostic algorithms for the aircraft gas turbine engine. Integration of actuator fault diagnostic algorithms was investigated and the injected faults can be detected successfully. The approach proposed in this paper can be used for online fault detection and isolation accurately, which is of practical significance for engine system.

articleTitle: Online Identification of Flux Linkage of PMSM with Unbalanced Stator Resistance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with unbalanced stator resistance, a method for online identification of rotor flux linkage based on model reference adaptive control (MRAC) theory is proposed. This method designs the self-adaptive law based on the Popov hyper-stability theory, which ensures the convergence of the identification results under specific conditions. The simulation results show the balanced state of the stator resistance, the motor parameters identified in the unbalanced state can also converge near the true value in a short time, and the error is small.

articleTitle: Flexible Dual-Frequency Circularly Polarized Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A flexible dual-frequency circularly polarized antenna with a flexible material polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) as the dielectric substrate and metallic copper as the radiation patch is proposed, which has the characteristics of being easy to conform to the curved surface. The antenna uses a double layer of dielectric substrate, and uses two layers of metal patches to achieve dual frequency resonance. The feed uses a dual coaxial mode to form circular polarization radiation, and opening a cross slot on the upper radiation patch reduces the antenna size. The performance of the electromagnetic simulation software Ansoft HFSS is simulated and optimized. The simulation results show that the antenna can work in the S band of 2.5GHz and 3.5GHz, the gain is more than 3dB, and has good radiation directivity. The antenna is planned to be processed based on Micro-Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS) processing technology. Compared with the conventional dual-frequency circularly polarized antenna, the antenna is made of flexible material as the medium substrate, which can adapt to mechanical stress such as tensile and bending. It has a good application prospect and provides a reference for the integration of antenna and electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Partial Discharge Detection Robot in Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The partial discharge detection of switchgear can only depend on manual operation at present, and there exist many problems such as large workload, low detection efficiency and poor detection quality. This paper proposed a robot for partial discharge detection of switchgears can solve those above-mentioned problems. Based on the actual problems in the field, the device is developed, meanwhile the article discussed the design of the robot overall scheme, function and key technology of each module in detail, finally applied to field test. It has significance of engineering practice.

articleTitle: Design of High Precision Capacitance Displacement Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper designs a capacitive displacement sensor with small size, high accuracy and good stability. Firstly, the single pole variable distance capacitance displacement measurement method used in the sensor is theoretically analyzed; then, the sensor's probe structure is designed in detail, and the related capacitance value detection and processing circuit of the sensor is completed, and the data is processed through the upper computer program. Finally, the capacitive displacement sensor was calibrated. The experimental results show that the measuring range of the sensor is 10 ~ 100μm, the linearity is better than 0.2%, the resolution of the sensor is 0.21μm, and the repeatability of the sensor is about 0.15μm.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized Microstrip UHF RFID Reader Antenna with the Impedance Match Easily Advantage
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A novel square patch RFID reader antenna for UHF band with the impedance match easily advantage is presented in this article. To achieve the circularly polarized (CP) radiation in the target band, the single-feed configurations based on rectangle truncated corners square patch are adopted by this antenna. An annular gap is embedded between the feed point and the square patch to simplify the input impedance matching of the proposed antenna. By adjusting the gap width and inner circle radius to optimize the capacitive reactance of the annular gap, the inductive reactance introduced by the SMA feed probe can be counteracted easily. Moreover, the independence optimization advantage between CP radiation, input reactance matching and input resistance matching are realized by the annular gap. The impedance bandwidth (RL<;-20dB) and axial ratio (AR<;3dB) bandwidth are 870-978 MHz and 900-930 MHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Remote Reproduction of UTC(NTSC) and its Realization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: National time service center (NTSC) is responsible for the generation, maintenance and dissemination of national standard time in China. It has established national standard time UTC (NTSC) synchronized with UTC, and kept the deviation between UTC (NTSC) and UTC is less than 10 ns. In order to allow more remote users acquired the high precision time and frequency signal traceable to UTC, this paper presents a time comparison method applicable for UTC (NTCS) remote reproduction, the time comparison method proposed herein has achieved UTC (NTSC) remote reproduction system in engineering. It has solved the problem that the method of standard satellite common view exits measuring dead time, and couldn't output real-time comparison results. The paper discuss the principle and implement method for remote high precision reproduction UTC(NTSC) system, in additional, the application requirements, the technology of improve precision, and strategy of enhanced reliability are introduced mainly too. In the case of take high-stability crystal oscillator as the signal source, a recent experiment demonstrated that the time offset of reproduction time is less than 10ns compared with UTC(NTSC), frequency accuracy and hourly stability is better than lE-13 and lE-12 respectively.

articleTitle: Inspection of IC wafer Defects Based on Image Registration
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An automatic integrated circuit (IC) wafer inspection system based on image registration has been developed. This inspection system addresses the task of detection the key defects on the surface of IC wafer. It introduces the method of Speeded Up Robust Features (SURF) image registration.
