The algorithm is used to achieve the alignment of space position between the standard image and the detected image. Defect feature extraction and analysis techniques are studied regarding the characteristics of detected images of IC wafer. The contour extraction with pattern recognition was applied to classify the defects. This method classify the type of defects based on the number in the Boundary Contour and material increase or decrease. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through some samples of IC wafer.

articleTitle: The Empirical Study on the Film's Network Exposure Effectiveness based on Several DEA Models
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of measuring the effect of the film's network exposure is transformed into the problem of production input, and then the DEA analysis method is used to analyze the film's network exposure effectiveness. Using the CCR model of DEA, CCR dual model, BBC model, worst CCR model and SE_DEA model, and the relative efficiency of the film' s network exposure was calculated. Then based on network exposure data and box office data of some movies in 2017, the film's network exposure effectiveness is discussed.

articleTitle: Innovative Social Governance Mode of Information Sharing Platform in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The establishment of information sharing platforms is the innovative mode in current social governance in the era of big data. Therefore, this is an interdisciplinary study based on big data and conducted among research on data information processing, theory of public governance and public policy, statistics as well as electronic government affairs. Drawing on the experience of foreign governance on information sharing platform, and trying to innovate governance philosophy as well as data analysis and assessment, a social governance mode of information sharing platform, which are suitable to our current national conditions, will be built to promote the efficiency of public management and social governance and produce a more powerful outcome.

articleTitle: Research on Tibetan Web Standard Text Data Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Through analyzing the characteristics of Tibetan network data information and Tibetan network data information, this paper designs the Tibetan network URL, Tibetan network Berkeley, DB, Tibetan network preprocessing, Tibetan network coding conversion algorithm, and finally establishes the Tibetan network standard text information database. This model provides users with internet Tibetan text object resources obtained by multiple channels, and then realize the Tibetan automatic judgement and identification and extraction. Eventually, it converts object resources from different format sources into plain Tibetan text files for analysis and processing.

articleTitle: Research on Vulnerability Classification Method Based on DMO-PSO-SVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Network vulnerabilities are very important for network security. How to standardize and reasonably classify vulnerabilities is the basic work of current network security related research. At present, various types of vulnerability classification algorithms often require long training time and test time, and are easy to fall into local optimum. Therefore, this paper proposes a new DMO-PSO-SVM algorithm for the classification of vulnerabilities. This algorithm introduces an improved Particle Swarm algorithm to optimize its parameters based on Support Vector Machine. The use of dual mutation operators avoids the occurrence of local optimal conditions, including edge mutation operator and global mutation operator. Experiments show that the method proposed in this paper significantly improves the accuracy of classification of vulnerabilities and reduces the classification time.

articleTitle: A Location-Aided Connectivity and Connection Time-Based Clustering Algorithm for HAP-Based Vehicle Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The current railway transit information transformation system depends heavily on perfect landside communication facilities, which will face challenges in the region where landside communication infrastructure is underdeveloped. In this paper, we introduce two kinds of high altitude platforms(HAPs), aerostat and unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) to construct HAP-based vehicle ad hoc network, which is a promising solution to supplement to the undeveloped landside communication infrastructure. A location-aided connectivity and connection time-based clustering algorithm(LCCT-CA), which takes connectivity and connection time into account, is proposed for the network. Simulation results show that the algorithm perform better than traditional algorithms, especially in terms of rapid networking and reliability.

articleTitle: Performace Oriented Edge Computing of Geospatial Information with 3D Scenery
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The connotation of cloud computing is the integration of data in micro or small devices to conduct high-performance processing. However, with the proliferation of Internet Plus and Internet of Things, cloud computing is in the dilemma of dealing with individual and customized needs with colossal quantity. Since variation exists in hardware performance facing different needs. GIS, is a typical complex multi-layered graphic application with various requirements of hardware performances and its multi-scale 3D graphical processing is a typical challenge for computing capacity. The study of Performance-Oriented Edge Computing is our main work on selection of computing resources at the edge when encountering large-scale computing like 3D scenery through service and distribution of Geospatial Information to better coordination of computing resources at the edge.

articleTitle: The Simulation Analysis of Control System of Pure Electric Pick-up Truck Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Motor and its control system is one of the key technologies of pure electric pick-up vehicles. Efficient motor control system can improve dynamic quality and economical efficiency of vehicles and reduce noise and vibration as well as improve the endurance mileage of the vehicle. Base on the basic principle of electric vehicle interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) vector control technology, this paper presents the motor control strategy MTPA (Max Torque Per Ampere), which is used under the basic speed and the weak magnetic, which is used beyond the basic speed, and the paper designs the PI controllers of current loop, speed loop controller using traditional method for engineering. Point at the problem about the coupling of d, q axis current, we use voltage feedforward compensation. Accelerated simulation test of the electric pick-up truck was conducted combined with vector control content and the motor load established. Correctness of this motor control system principle we designed is verified by the experimental results, laid the theoretical basis for the entity control.

articleTitle: Static Voltage Stability Analysis Based on the Combination of Dynamic Continuous Power Flow and Adaptive Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method based on the combination of Dynamic Continuation Power Flow (DCPF) and Adaptive Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization (ACPSO) to analyze the static voltage stability of the system. The method regards the combination of regulating voltage and controlling variables as particles and the system static voltage stability margin as the fitness value. The maximal adaptation value is the objective function. To solve the problem that there is deficiency in unbalanced power processing when continuous power flowcalculates the particle's fitness value, the dynamic power flow algorithm is introduced into the model of calculating fitness value. According to the principle of Primary Frequency Control, the unbalanced power of the system has been distributed and the DCPF model has been established, to calculate the corresponding fitness value of each particle. The chaos algorithm is introduced into the adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm to form ACPSO, which is used to search for the optimal particle and calculate the maximum fitness value. By analyzing the relationship between particles and their fitness values, we find a way to improve the system's static voltage stability margin and examples verifythe effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Reactive Optimization Model with Flexible Objectives for Power Systems Containing Infeasible Voltage-Violated Buses
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The paper proposes a reactive optimization model with flexible objectives for power systems containing voltage-violated buses. For this infeasibility problem, concepts of weak substations and non-weak area are proposed, and the reactive optimization model with flexible objectives is established. This model was composed of the controlled voltage sub-model for weak substations and the reactive optimization sub-model for non-weak area. The objectives were the minimum deviation voltage for infeasible voltage-violated buses and the minimum real power loss respectively. The set of constraints are based on the conventional reactive optimization constraints for the feasible voltage buses, and the dynamically updating voltage security boundary for infeasible voltage-violated buses. And considering these two objectives are interactive and successive, this paper correspondingly proposes a strategy of chronological population-reproducing successively for solving this proposed two sub-models in the hybrid parallel cooperative co-evolutionary algorithm (HPCCEA). This hybrid algorithm contains evolution algorithm (EA) and interior point method (IPM). Finally, a 63-bus power system is used for simulating and verifying that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Passive Clock Synchronization for TDOA-based UWB Indoor Positioning Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of estimating the parameters of the quadratic clock model to achieve clock synchronization for time difference of arrival (TDOA)-based ultra wideband (UWB) indoor positioning systems. It is assumed that a reference node with a master clock is available and as a result, we are able to synchronize an arbitrary number of receiving nodes in a passive manner using wireless connections. A practical algorithm for identifying the quadratic clock model parameters is proposed by tailoring and enhancing an existing solution. In particular, the clock synchronization is accomplished in two steps, where in the first step, the clock drift is estimated while the clock offset and skew are found in the second step. Both processing steps utilize the closed-form weighted least squares (WLS) optimization only. Method for simplifying the evaluation of the weighting matrices is introduced and is shown to be capable of reducing the computational time greatly. Simulation results show that the newly developed clock parameters estimation technique is approximately efficient in the sense that it can attain the Cramér-Rao lower bound (CRLB) performance. Experiments using data from a real TDOA-based UWB indoor localization system further confirm the advantage of using the quadratic clock model over the simplified linear clock model in maintaining long-term synchronization.

articleTitle: On Space and Design of Topological Graphic Passwords For Information Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Graphical passwords are already used in a wide range of scientific areas, especially, dynamic networks. OR code is a successful example. We estimate the spaces of topological graphic passwords (Topsnut-GPWs) that can be use conveniently and have higher level security in information networks by mean of topological structures and colorings/labellings of graph theory. We show that a type of special trees, called caterpillars, can be used to design the Topsnut-GPWs, since caterpillars admit many graph labellings and deduce lobsters having some graph labellings. And we discuss harmonious labellings and provide a new type of harmonious labellings. We point that it is easy for converting Topsnut-GPWs into text-based passwords, but not in turn in general.

articleTitle: Primary Frequency Regulation Control of Wind Turbines Based on Variable Power Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to a large number of grid-connected wind turbines don't have the ability to respond to system frequency changes, problems on frequency stability of power system have become increasingly prominent. At present, the primary frequency regulation of wind turbines is mostly based on the method of additional frequency regulation control to change the reference value of electromagnetic power, so as to realize that wind turbines can participate in the system frequency regulation. However, the method of additional frequency regulation control does not t consider the conflict of power increment between the power tracking controller and the frequency regulation controller, which lead to the power increment required for the primary frequency regulation can't reach the target value. Based on this issue, the paper combines the original power tracking technology of wind turbines with the existing frequency regulation technology, and change the signal of frequency deviation by the power tracking curve of the wind turbine, which realize the inertial response and primary frequency regulation of the unit through the fast active power control of the wind turbine. That the purpose of frequency regulation is realized and the power tracking curve is changed, by converting the active output required for the frequency regulation control into the increment load reduction. The simulation results show that, based on the control method in the paper, the double-fed wind turbine can fully achieve the target increment needed for primary frequency regulation, which makes the wind turbines more reliable and effective to participate in system of frequency regulation.

articleTitle: Big-Data-Based Modeling of Electricity Consumption Behavior
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Big data is envisioned as a game changer capable of revolutionizing the way businesses operate in sectors. The purpose of this paper is to present a big-data-based framework for dealing with electricity consumption behavior. This paper conducts an analysis of methodologies in the extraction of electro-information and drawbacks in modeling power consumption behavior through traditional peak-trough pricing. Then, the paper comes up with a fresh thinking on integration of multiple-dimensional, big data platforms, and conducts a penetrating study of pattern identification, relational analysis and deeds of using electricity. The paper designs a data-driven approach on the basis of two huge data manipulation techniques, batch process and flow process, and puts forward an algorithm concerning stochastic matrix relevance, which goes for the relationship between electricity spending and its determinants. Also, empirical evidence is presented concerning verifying robustness and validity of the proposed approach, suggesting that the framework is feasible in performing further electrical data analytics. The paper concludes with pointing out implications for governmental policy formulation, business expansion of power companies and guiding behavior of electricity use as well as quantitative methods for researching related issues.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Smart Phone and Vehicle Positioning Analysis Model Based on SNN Density ST-OPTICS Algorithm in HOV Lanes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the long-term infrastructure construction of traditional Chinese HOV lane detection methods and the large investment, the monitoring mainly concentrates in the scope of equipment deployment. Nevertheless, there are still many monitoring blind spots. Based on the ST-OPTICS algorithm of SNN density, a model of mobile smart phone and vehicle positioning analysis and detection was established, which could effectively estimate the number of actual passengers on board a vehicle to a certain extent and provide a new type of vehicle real-time monitoring in HOV lanes. Through the collection of running vehicles on mobile roads and GPS and base station positioning data of mobile smart phones, the original data were preprocessed to obtain a feasible data set, then maps were matched according to their latitude and longitude and other information, and the clustering algorithm was used to classify and establish a positioning analysis model. The passenger metrics of each cluster was calculated, and the data set meeting the conditions based on the HOV was employed as the basis for vehicle and mobile positioning analysis model. Experiments showed that the application of the model in the HOV lane could effectively assist the detection of HOV lane vehicles and the better detection accuracy.

articleTitle: A class of mixed logical system and using in energy-saving control of central air conditioning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a class of hybrid system that is based on the mixed logical dynamical (MLD) system, which contains a new framework and switching law. The framework involves a logical variable, continuous variable, and auxiliary variable, some mixed integer/logical inequalities are inferred here. By discussing non-zero switching point, some new contain relations between logical expresses and inequalities are obtained. Hence, a universal state-dependent switching law is constructed, which is the control strategy of the system. Combining the switching law, framework and constraints, universal MLD inequalities can be set. The inequalities are suitable for basic modelling and controlling of many fields of hybrid dynamic processes. Subsequently, this class of MLD system is used in energy-saving control of central air conditioning by utilizing pumps of water system, which satisfies the demands of controlling and energy-saving. As an example, the switching situation and the energy-saving effect of the system are simulated.

articleTitle: Spiking neural network with synaptic plasticity for recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The spiking neural network referred to the third generation of neural network simulates the mechanisms of neurons and networks in brain. It has the distributed computational mechanism and robust information processing way like the nervous system. This paper describes that a spiking neural network with the synaptic plasticity recognizes the input scenes. The Digital spiking silicon neuron (DSSN), a mathematical structure-based qualitative model, is used to reproduce the various behaviors of neurons. We also designed the synapse model in our spiking neural network to precisely describe the dynamics of the transmitter release and the postsynaptic current generation. There are three layers in our network. The spiking neurons in layer 1 and 2 with special receptive fields perform the edge detection and orientation selection, respectively. The synaptic plasticity is realized in synaptic connections between spiking neurons in layer 2 and the output layer. The changing of connection is based on the Hebbian learning rule which supposes that the time difference of two spikes modifies the value of connection. We evaluated our spiking neural network with the task of image recognition. The spiking neurons in the output layer fire with the high frequency in response to their relevant input scenes. The simulation results show that our spiking neural network can successfully recognize the input scenes learned before. The recognition is robust against various distortions.

articleTitle: Entertainer Evaluation System Research Based on Index Model and Text Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the entertainment industry, the value of entertainers has received unprecedented attention. In view of the market's demand for the entertainer evaluation system, this paper adopts big data analysis and mining techniques to propose an entertainer evaluation system based on the index model and text analysis. The entertainer index evaluation model consisting of basic index and comprehensive index adopts a combining method of subjectively and objectively index weighing method, which solving the incommensurability problem between different indexes. In text analysis part, the emotional dictionary is built on the basis of the micro-blog commentary data of the Internet, and then word cloud is drawn according to the word frequency. Furthermore, the distribution of emotional tendencies is obtained through sentiment analysis, thus achieving an all-round evaluation system for entertainers. This paper also selects some entertainer examples to conduct experiments, demonstrating the effectiveness of the evaluation results.

articleTitle: A Frequency-Hopping Communication System Based On Multiple Parallel Hopping
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As one of the important communication technologies used in military domain, frequency-hopping (FH) was designed by switching the channel it used quickly in a pseudo random way to avoid being detected as well as escaping the jamming. However, traditional FH systems are being challenged by growing menaces as the electronic technologies developing rapidly. In order to improve the anti-jamming capability especially for the follower jamming, a novel multiple parallel frequency-hopping (MPFH) communication system was proposed in the paper. The MPFH system was designed to transmit information by using multiple hopping channels simultaneously, so the frequency hopping pattern was greatly puzzled for the jammers by expanding the random dimensionality from traditionally one-dimension to high-dimensions. Finally, anti-jamming ability to the follower jamming was simulated and proved for the novel MPFH system.

articleTitle: Fast mileage deviation correction method for track dynamic inspection system based on data fusion technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new mileage deviation correction method for track dynamic inspection data of high-speed comprehensive inspection train using data fusion technology was proposed and investigated to improve the accuracy of mileage information and the efficiency of deviation correction method. The mileage deviation of track geometric inspection data was corrected using inspected curvature information combined with actual mileage and curvature information. The mileage deviation of axle box acceleration inspection data was corrected using mileage-corrected track geometric inspection data combined with uncorrected velocity information of axle box acceleration inspection data. A 5-points iteration method was proposed and investigated to improve the computational efficiency of mileage deviation correction. Computational and analytic result of measured data demonstrated that 5-points iteration method not only ensured the accuracy of mileage deviation correction, but also significantly saved the computation time for over 80%. Field verifying of actual wave corrugation case indicated that the corrected mileage information of track dynamic inspection data was very close to the actual information, the error being less than 10 m.

articleTitle: Research on Relative Supporting Height Estimation of Complex Mobile Roof Support Machinery Based on Multi-sensor Kalman Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to maximize the roof supporting quality and minimize roof fall risk, the roof supporting height was reviewed in this contribution. The concept of relative supporting height (RSH) was proposed base on massive related literature reviews, and a novel estimation approach based on D-H matrix through multisensor Kalman filter was provided to estimate RSH. Moreover, the architecture of proposed estimation approach was presented, local orientation estimator was described and multi-sensor Kalman filter was implemented. Finally, the experiment was elaborated using complex mobile roof support machinery (hydraulic support). The experiment results were analyzed and the estimated errors of fused approach and non-fused approach were compared. The comparison indicated that the proposed approach possesses excellent performance on RSH estimation in complex environment.

articleTitle: Fault Estimation in Finite Frequency Domain for Uncertain Systems with Sensor Fault
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of sensor failure fault estimation for continuous linear uncertain systems with sensor failure fault, which belongs to multiplicative faults, and this problem has not been well investigated in the literature. With the aid of generalised KYP lemma, three finite frequency performance indexes are given to measure the robustness of the estimation errors, which help to track the sensor fault parameters. Then, sufficient conditions based on linear matrix inequalities which guarantee the robustness of the estimation errors are subsequently derived. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is proved by numerical example.

articleTitle: Design of Testing System for Automotive Power Electronic Unit Based on Energy-Consuming Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For qualifying the reliability and enhancing the performance of automotive power electronic unit (PEU), a testing system based on energy-consuming platform is developed, which adopts advanced sensing and automatic control technologies to simulate the real working environment of PEU. The system mainly includes high and low voltage energy supply units, electronic load unit, dummy load units, hydraulic water cooling unit, test console unit, temperature control unit and main control unit, and experiments are implemented on the system for PEU products. Meanwhile, system capability index CGK and GR&R are 1.912 and 2.74% separately calculated by measurement system analysis (MSA) method used data obtained from a large number of tests, which indicates that the accuracy, stability and repeatability of testing system are excellent. All analysis results demonstrate that the system meets the performance indicator requirement of testing, and can provide accurate test data for the development of PEU.

articleTitle: An Improved Watermarking Algorithm Robust to Camcorder Recording Based on DT-CWT
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To reduce blocking effects in dark and smooth regions, to improve the correct rate of the extracted watermark sequence when frame dropping happens and the video has lots of short shots for existing single-shot watermarking algorithm, and to block against camcorder recording. The watermark sequence is first divided into different subsequences in this paper. By combining the Watson vision model based on Antonini9-7 Wavelet transform and Adaptive embedding intensity coefficient, the watermark subsequence is embedded into the 4th level DT-CWT (Dual Tree Complex Wavelet Transform) low frequency component of the whole frame. To improve the correct rate of the extracted watermark sequence, we use the luminance trend of Y component to extract the time synchronization subsequence and watermark subsequence, and use the maximum election statistics to restore the watermark. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can reduce blocking effects, improve the correct rate of the extracted watermark sequence, and is also robust to camcorder recording.

articleTitle: The Development and Key Technologies of Smart Distribution Network Planning Converging High Penetration Level of EVs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As an effective way to solve energy problems and achieve sustainable development, electric vehicles (EVs) present broad application prospects. Without the help of effective distribution network planning and design methods, the development of EVs is impossible. However, due to the massive access of EVs, the planning and design of distribution network is quite different from the traditional power system. This paper presents the key steps of smart distribution network planning converging high penetration level of EVs on the technique side, reviews latest developments in the field of modelling methods, solving algorithms and evaluation methods, and emphatically discusses the coupling between the EVs' charging behavior and the planning of distribution network, as well as the main comprehensive evaluation methods. The future research direction of smart distribution network with high-penetration level of EVs is proposed.

articleTitle: Paper Design of Circulation Process Model for Sharing Circulating Packaging of the Express Delivery Industry Based on Lease Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on Circular Economy theory, the sharing system about circulating packaging (SSCP) of the express delivery industry is put forward with the sharing circulating packaging (SCP) as the research object, to promote the green development of Chinese express delivery industry. The structure of the SSCP of the express delivery industry and the main work that needs to be done to construct the system were briefly described. According to the different operation modes of the SCP of the express delivery industry based on lease mode, the different circulation processes are designed and the corresponding models are set up to achieve the recycling of the SCP.

articleTitle: Intelligence Compatibility Test of Web Services-based Power Business
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a compatibility test method of web application in power industry based on image feature similarity to ensure the normal operation of Web application in different terminal environments. Aiming at some shortcomings of the existing image similarity evaluation method, the proposed method not only solves the mistakes caused by manual inspection, but also improves the test accuracy and reduce test costs. Experimental results show that the proposed method is able to effectively improve the browser compatibility test level.

articleTitle: A 16-BIT 200KS/S Multi-channel SAR ADC in 55nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: More and more analog and mixed-signal (AMS) blocks are integrated into system on chip (SoC) platform due to intense market competition. In this paper, we present a 16-bit successive approximation register (SAR) analog-to-digital converter (ADC) IP that is much smaller and less power cost than other recently reported SAR ADCs. In addition, we use several techniques to improve area and power. This work has multi input channels with programming input scale. A high accuracy reference voltage and low noise comparator proposed in this design. We also design on-chip calibration and oversampling digital filter to achieve a higher SNR.

articleTitle: A Unified Root Algorithm in Bignum Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In bignum arithmetic, the cube root and higher-order root operations are conventionally treated as elementary functions, meaning that for them, correct rounding is not required, usually even without an error bound. In this paper we provide a unified algorithm RootRem to find the (arbitrary-ordered) root of bignums. This algorithm first finds the reciprocal root by using Newton iteration, and then obtains the root through a reciprocal operation. It has guaranteed correct rounding in all cases. RootRem(2), which is to find the square root, is currently found to be less efficient than the existing algorithm SqrtRem proposed by Brent and Zimmermann. However, RootRem(p) with p ≥ 3 fill an important theoretical gap and are major improvements over the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Car Steward Controlled by Brain Waves
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new and intelligent kind of car steward system was designed based on brain waves control. The system was composed of head-mounted sensors and car steward. When drivers were tired in different levels, analysis of brain waves signals could suggest difference. Brain waves could be divided into five different waves, δ wave, θ wave, a wave, beta brain wave and gamma wave. According to scalp electrodes, brain waves of drivers could be obtained and transmitted to processor. Levels of tiredness could be concluded relying on the driver's brain waves.

articleTitle: New Feature Extraction Algorithm for Distribution Network Running Signals Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a feature extraction method for transient information in distribution network is presented. The method is based on wavelet gray moment and is simulated by Matlab. This method can effectively extract the typical fault of various distribution networks and the operating conditions of complex working conditions, such as short circuit, broken line, grounding, closing inrush and lightning strike. Finally, the proposed method is verified by actual sampling data, which proves that the method has practical effect and application prospect.

articleTitle: Joint optimization of Maintenance Force and Spare Parts Provision for k-out-of-n System in Wartime
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To deal with the response delay problem of the spare part provision for equipment in wartime, a maintenance strategy is proposed considering the properties of k-out-of-n system and finite maintenance capacity. A mathematical model for the joint optimization of maintenance decision-making and spare parts provision is developed to maximize the system availability and minimize the maintenance cost simultaneously. The marginal benefit method is adopted to solve the proposed model, and the optimal declaration time of spare parts, as well as the optimal maintenance force configuration scheme is obtained.

articleTitle: Graph Module-$k$ Odd-elegant Labelling Towards Topological Graphical Passwords
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Passwords are still dominated by simple structure, and there is a significant increase of using only numbers as passwords. the progress of password security over the previous decade, which shows that most passwords could be easily guessed or cracked. Here we attempt to using a new type of graphical passwords (Topsnut-GPWs) has been designed by technique of graph theory, called module-k odd-elegant labelling. We show examples for testing our methods which can be easily find some network models that admit our new labelling and transformed into effective algorithms.

articleTitle: Hardware design of short wave radio based on Software Radio
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The realization of hardware circuit is the most effective way to test theory. Due to space and technical emphasis, the receiving part is the focal point of this system. This system is based on the frequency band pass sampling of the software radio, and uses a dedicated digital up / down converter chip. The system is designed to realize analog / down conversion, sampling, digital / down conversion, signal processing, analog input / output, coding conversion / reduction and so on. The corresponding key parts are demonstrated and implemented here.

articleTitle: A Secure Dual-Core Processor Design for Embedded Terminal Device
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Embedded terminal devices are widely used in security-critical systems such as financial payments, and the security of their confidential data is becoming a concern for people. This paper presents a design method of embedded secure dual-core processor for smart terminal devices. The method uses a combination of physical security design and logical security design to protect the confidential data. In the physical security design, a physical isolation between the two cores is implemented through the interconnection network and the dual-core communication module, so that the confidential data runs in a closed environment completely isolated from the actual application to prevent the possibility of the confidential data being drawn at the application development terminal. In the logical security design, using the advantages of dual core, a combination of software and hardware is adopted to implement two-core cooperative encryption to prevent side-channel attacks from leaking confidential data. The proposed processor has very little hardware overhead and performance penalty.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Frequency Hopping Communication System Based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the introduction of Frequency Hopping(FH) Communication system and its mathematic model, a simulation model was built using the Simulink. In the simulation model, the core components of FH system, including FH sequence generator frequency synthesizer, Transmitter and Receiver System were designed and implemented. Simulation results demonstrate that the model is correct and effective. The performance of FH system in various conditions could be analyzed and evaluated through the bit error rate curve of the proposed model, such as anti interference environment and anti multi-path fading channels.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Coverage Testing System Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the testing efficiency of radio and television signal and improve the measuring conditions of coverage test, we designed a coverage testing system. The system can capture field strength data quickly and accurately and obtain the GPS information of the test points in real time. Considering the great impact of the field strength and geographic information on the results of wireless coverage test, a storage format which can combine the information of the two is designed. Then the field strength is displayed on the map. The system has the advantages of simple operation, small volume, low power consumption, and no need for additional modification of test vehicle.

articleTitle: Improving the Frequency Switching of Phase-locked Loop Using Pre-control Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method using a pre-controller to improve the frequency switching of phase-locked loop. Based on the basic nonlinear phase model, the transient response of the second-order phase-locked loop is studied, and simulations have been taken. The results show that the pre-controller technique can effectively decrease the frequency switching time of the loop.

articleTitle: Study on target optimization method of cement raw material ingredients
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The link of Cement raw material batching is particularly important in the process of cement production, ensure that the oxide content in the raw ingredients into the kiln to maintain stable conditions, improve the efficiency and quality of clinker burning has a decisive role. In domestic cement plant, the link of raw material ingredients more use value of three control methods, while the rate value target set by the laboratory on the basis of clinker quality. There are problems such as long lag time, slow adjustment and low accuracy. In this paper, we first to Building a homogenized library model, and then the least square method is used to model the rotary kiln firing system under a typical working condition to predict the clinker rate of the raw material fired in the kiln, so as to optimize the target of the raw material batching rate. The algorithm is proved to be useful in field production.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Feature Extraction of Weld Groove based on Laser Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The extraction of weld groove geometry feature information is the premise of weld tracking technology. The existing seam feature information extraction technology has a good effect on thin plate, but its extraction accuracy is low when dealing with thick plate and deep weld groove. Based on the point scanning laser sensor, a method of image information preprocessing and feature extraction for thick plate is proposed, and the related algorithms are optimized. Aiming at the common right angle and oblique inflection point in the weld groove, the slope extreme value method and the oblique intercept method are used to extract the weld seam feature points respectively. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by experiments.

Author Keywords: extract the weld seam feature points

articleTitle: Research on Edge Extraction Technique of the Image Border of Welding Pool Based on Mathematical Morphology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aimed at the problem of the serious loss of marginal information when it is conducted with binaryzation in the edge extracting of weld pool image by using the method of mathematical morphology, one kind of improved plan is purposed in this paper. We can use local adaptive binarization method to carry out binaryzation, and then apply the median filtering to build connected region at the same time, use search fill algorithm to obtain the final binary image. We can use the method of mathematical morphology to select structural element with suitable shape and size and apply edge detection operator which is used four kinds of basic operation combinations of morphology to carry out edge detection for binary image. The simulation results show that this method can more accurately extract the image edge of welding pool on the basis of protecting marginal information of welding pool commendably.

articleTitle: The Design of Vehicle Headlights Switching System Based on Support Vector Machine(SVM)
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article aims at proposing a design of an intelligent switching system for vehicle headlights based on Support Vector Machine (SVM) due to the fact that the improper use of the vehicle headlights leads to some of the traffic accidents. Firstly, the system uses the AR0130 image sensor to capture road images. Second, the system classifies the image to identify whether there is a streetlight, whether there is an oncoming vehicle and whether it is too close to the front vehicle in the absence of a streetlight with the application of Raspberry Pi 3 based on SVM. Then the corresponding correct indication of the headlights switching is given by the control of relays, reducing the driver's distraction greatly. Experimental results prove that the system has high practicality and accuracy for the switching of vehicle headlights.

articleTitle: Method for Comparative Analysis of Bullet Marks Based on the Multi-dimensional Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents the method for comparative analysis of 3D bullet mark data and proposes the technology of realizing accurate comparative analysis by extracting multidimensional features of bullet data. In our approach, the first step is to denoise the data, and then extract multidimensional feature, finally we make the comparison of coarse level to fine level. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Broadcast signal coverage drive test system based on SNMP protocol
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern information technology and communications industry, traditional broadcasting is experiencing this reform following digitization, networking, and mobile portability. Therefore, ensuring the coverage and stability of wireless broadcast signals is one of the keys to the reform of terrestrial digital broadcasting signals. Therefore, the measured data provided by the coverage test of wireless broadcast signals has important reference value for its coverage planning, implementation and post-maintenance. It plays an important role in the horizontal and vertical development of wireless broadcasting. The drive test is an important way used to test the quality of broadcast signals and plays a very important role in the optimization of wireless networks. This article introduces a transmission test system based on SNMP protocol and programed by Java. It can quickly measure FM signal field strength, multipath and other information, and combine these values with an external GPS to save the values to the local text file. The broadcast signal audio is downloaded and saved to the local disk. The whole DT system operates simply and the power consumption is low. It also has the characteristics that the DT system has small volume, and is very friendly to drive testers.

articleTitle: Analysis of Buried Cable Signal in Three-dimensional Complicated Soil Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A method of feature recognition and extraction of transmitted electromagnetic wave echo signals is proposed. The method firstly removes the background noise by means of the mean value method, then uses the thresholding method to segment the image to obtain the region of interest for the hyperbolic feature image. Then, the feature points of the maximum energy value at each horizontal position in the feature image are extracted, and the curve is fitted by the least square method, finally, by calculating the underground electromagnetic wave velocity and hyperbolic vertex, get underground cable target depth coordinates. In addition, the echo signal under three-dimensional soil structure is simulated based on the finite difference time-domain numerical method. The identification and extraction of the cable echo signal under the uniform soil structure, layered soil structure and complex soil structure verify the accuracy of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Approach of linkage policy decision based on security vulnerability situation and multi factors fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet, the occurrence of information security events is having been more and more frequent, and the impact of the events is becoming more and more serious. The linkage policy decision facing the alert of security events is widely concerned, and it's also a difficult problem. In this paper, a multi factor linkage policy decision model is proposed. First, base on the given network configuration, system setting, and vulnerability information, the network attack graph is generated by MulVAL multi-stage and multi-step security analyzer. Then, the combination of attack graph and alert information to generate candidate linkage policy is further integrated. The attack chain after the enforcement of the assumed linkage policy is given, and the security risk of the system is calculated based on the popularity, ease and influence of the vulnerability. Finally, a reasonable security linkage policy is given in combination with the enforcement of the linkage policy and the impact on the security risk of the system. The experimental test results show that the method can analyze the influence of security policy from the overall system, and provide a feasible and effective security linkage policy for security administrators, which makes the administrator get rid of the problem of the decision of the linkage response policy of security events.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Camera Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Design and development of camera simulation system, combining the technical and functional features of camera system, people use Unity3D technology and C# language to develop a virtual simulation system with interactivity. Actually, it means that by using virtual reality technology, we design a virtual camera to simulate real camera which can zoom, focus, adjust the aperture, and display the contents of the external camera. This paper focus on the study of virtual reality technology theory and the practice of simulation system development based on Unity3D, show the process of creating the camera model by 3ds max and importing to Unity3D, then realize some functions.

articleTitle: Residential Lighting System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper introduces a general residential lighting system of various components. Mainly have a machine of the upper part and lower part and hardware part. PC using kingview 6.55 composition control and monitor screen, as well as complete and the next bit machine communication function. Under a machine adopts PLC control, PLC from PC to accept the command output. Hardware part adopted by controlling thyristor conduction cycle method of the light bulb brightness control circuit. The upper computer part includes the control and monitoring screen of the lower computer, and the report interface of various data can control and monitor the lighting switches in the residential area in real time. Using PLC communication and output safe and reliable, the lower computer ensures the reliability of the system to a certain extent. The part of the hardware circuit adopts the mechanism of controlling the brightness through the photoresistor, so that the illumination brightness can change with the change of the natural light intensity, which plays the role of energy saving and brightness adjustment.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of the intelligent detector of electrical apparatus
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The intelligent detector of electrical apparatus can automatically identify different electrical appliances and displays their working states. It can learn by itself. According to the specific design requirements, the optimal designing scheme has been worked out. The corresponding hardware circuit is designed according to the scheme, and the software is realized. Finally, the intelligent detector is debugged and realized and the test results meet the requirements of the design.

articleTitle: Automatic Water Sample Distribution System for USV Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A set of automatic water sample filtration and distribution system is proposed for the marine monitoring needs on Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) in this paper. The devices of the system were selected for different specific functions. In order to determine the reliability of the system because of the limited amount of seawater and space size available on USV, the pressure losses and time-consuming calculations were performed. And the water residuals after empting and flushing processes in the system were calculated and analyzed using the Nusselt equation and the Taylor model. The tube design and implementation logic of the system are described in this paper. Finally, the situation of physical structures and tests are introduced.

articleTitle: Visualizing IED Interaction in Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative method for IED interaction analysis in the IEC61850 based smart substation. By parsing the data from the substation SCD configuration file to extract the data model needed for graphical dynamic analysis, the solution acquires the real-time communication data of substation according to the SMV, GOOSE and MMS messages. Using Java graphing technology, the solution interprets the information in a visual way of expression to generate time-sequentially progressive display automatically. Such graphical representation forms a complete record of the actions, and provides a simple and clear analyzing view of a complex and difficult to understand process.

articleTitle: Study on direct torque control system of three-level inverter permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The basic principle of direct torque control is analyzed, and the application of NPC three-level inverter in direct torque control is studied. on the basis of composite vector, an optimization method of composite vector is proposed, which can effectively suppress the fluctuation of NPC three-level DC side midpoint potential. finally, an independent functional module is established in Matlab/Simulink, and the simulation model of permanent magnet synchronous motor direct torque control system is built. Simulation results show that this method is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Analysis of a Linear Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A linear motor is a device that converts electrical energy directly into linear motion mechanical energy. This device is of interest and has many applications. A linear motor that does not have a hampered middle of the rotation mechanism has a significantly enhanced linear motion performance. The performance of a linear motor depends on its energy consumption. Reduction of energy consumption can be used to improve the working efficiency, output characteristics, and operation stability of linear motors. In this study, Ansoft Maxwell software is used to simulate the energy consumption of a linear motor. Analysis of a prototype linear motor driven by an electromagnetic drive revealed its energy consumption. At the same time, the distribution and influence factor of cooper and iron loss are also be revealed. It can provide reference for improving the working performance of linear motors.

articleTitle: Analysis of Abnormal Discharge of 220kV Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Partial discharge testing is a key test to test the quality of transformer. When partial discharge quantity exceeds the relevant standard, insulation oil analysis and ultrasonic location detection can effectively find fault location. Then, when the partial discharge is small and the discharge time is short, the above two methods cannot effectively determine the fault location. Based on a case of 220 kV transformer partial discharge exceeding the standard, the neutral support method is used to determine the fault location effectively, and the conclusion of the accident analysis is verified by checking the hanging cover of the transformer. It provides an effective test method for the later stage field test analysis.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of an Oil-contained Water Sampling Device for Unmanned Surface Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An automatic water sampling device with novel structure that is used to collect oil-contained water samples in polluted sea area is presented in this paper. Different from other water sampling device, this one was carried by an unmanned surface vehicle and can finish tasks automatically. Also, this device overcomes the swing of the unmanned surface vehicle on the voyage, and accomplishes multi-sampling in definite depth and stores samples in constant temperature. Through the feasibility analysis and experimental verification, this device can adapt to the swing of the unmanned surface vehicle in some specific sea conditions and complete the collecting work of samples.

articleTitle: Composite attitude control for flexible spacecrafts with input saturation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: We propose a new composite anti-disturbance control approach with guaranteed input saturation. Such a composite control has two hierarchical loops. The vibrations of flexible appendalges are formulated as one type of disturbances with bounded derivative, for which the disturbance-observer-based controller is designed to compensate in the feed-forward loop. Other disturbances originated from space environment, measurement, actuator and un-modeled dynamics, are merged into the second type of disturbance described by a norm bounded variable. H ∞ state-feedback controller is designed to attenuate the merged disturbance. The input saturation of the actuator is also taken into account in the controller design. The concerned problem is simplfied into a robust control problem via solution of linear matrix inequalities. Numerical simulations and comparisons show that by combining the disturbance observer with H ∞ control, the pointing accuracy of flexible spacecrafts can be improved.

articleTitle: Design of pure electric freight car system based on orthogonal optimization method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The pure electric minivan is different from electric car. In order to achieve goals of optimum power performances, combined with certain van, we use the orthogonal optimization algorithm to optimize the design parameters. Then, establish simulation models and operate tasks calculation of the transmission ratio in Cruise. Simulation results show that: the design of optimum transmission ratio met requirements of power performances. This paper has practical guiding significances on providing a new way of electric minivan match and simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Double Cross Algorithm of Improved TV Image Inpainting Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Currently, the numerical solution of most variation inpainting models only uses four neighborhood information of damaged pixel. Due to the less reference information provided, the inpainting accuracy is low. This paper presents double cross algorithm based on improved Total Variation (TV) model. The algorithm uses eight neighborhood information of damaged pixel. Firstly, it divides the eight neighborhood pixels into two groups. Secondly, each group uses four neighborhood pixels to compute the pixel value of damaged pixel. Finally, the weighted mean of these two pixel values is the final inpainting pixel value. The experiments show that the new algorithm significantly improves the inpainting accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Large Passenger Flow Warning System for Urban Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous of new rail transit line, the situation of large passenger flow impact is extremely severe. It is urgent to monitor the status of urban rail transit in real time and ensure the safe and efficient operation of rail transit. This paper analyzes various problems brought by the current large passenger flow impact on the rail transit network in Beijing. Based on the characteristics of the Internet of Things technology, such as sence, transmission, Intelligence, and application, the idea of building a IOT system for the prevention and pre-warning of large passenger flows in rail transit was proposed. This paper establishes a network passenger flow distribution model based on the improved logit model, which realizes accurate judgment and intelligent analysis of large passenger flow in rail transit, and uses passenger flow model data to automatically and intelligently display track events and risk prediction and intelligent pre-warning capabilities. Based on the Internet of Things technology, this paper builds a rail transit passenger flow prevention and pre-warning IOT system with rail operation, supervision and service. The construction and successful application of the platform can provide accurate data support for the daily operation of companies, government management department and the emergency evacuation command under the incident, which plays an exemplary role in the application of the Internet of Things technology in traffic safety prevention.

articleTitle: Aluminum alloy defects testing using Magneto-acousto-electrial
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we report our theoretical and experimental investigations on a new nondestructive testing method referred to as magneto-acousto-electrical nondestructive testing (MAE- NDT). This method offers an alternative to detecting the flaws in aluminum alloy material invisible or not suitable to the other nondestructive testing methods. Firstly, this present paper demonstrates the feasibility of this new method by considering a simple1-D model. Then, in the experimental part, the experimental setup and methods were developed and the some detected signals were presented. The promising experimental results and theoretical derivation suggest the feasibility of the proposed MAE-NDT approach.

articleTitle: Multi-Dimensional Taylor Network Optimal Control of Torpedo Running
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The control system of torpedo is a non-linear and strongly coupled system. This paper first presents a torpedo model without disturbance, and then the principle of automatic control system of torpedo, as well as the MTN (multi-dimensional Taylor network) optimal control not requiring controlled object models. In the end, the simulation results of the pitch angle, yaw angle and depth control using PID, SMC (sliding mode control needing the precise torpedo mechanism model) and MTN respectively under the same simplex optimal method show that the MTN optimal controller has the best control effect of the above three kinds of controllers.

articleTitle: Parametric Modeling of Geometric Errors for CNC Machine Tools Based on Chebyshev Polynomial
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to establish the mathematical model of rotary axes geometric error of machine tool quickly and accurately, a parameterized modeling method based on Chebyshev polynomial is proposed in this paper. First, the rotation angle of the rotation axis of the machine tool is converted into a Chebyshev variable, and then the Chebyshev variable is substituted into Chebyshev polynomials of different orders. Second, The corresponding coefficients are obtained by multiple linear regression based on Chebyshev basis function values and Chebyshev variables. Finally, the transformation relationship between the rotation angle of the rotation axis and the Chebyshev variable is substituted into the mathematical model of the basic geometric error term. Compared to other methods, the modeling process is simple and easy to program. This paper takes the two rotary axes of VMC65m as an example to obtain the geometric error distribution of the working space of the machine tool, which provides a theoretical basis for the design and error compensation of the machine tool.

articleTitle: Weather Auto-inductive and Multifunctional Device
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Conventional automatic clothes hangers in real practice all fail to free from manpower that they still need to be controlled by human and they have no integrated functions. In this paper, a weather auto-inductive and multifunctional clothes hanger is proposed and designed, and its prototype is finally designed and produced in software and hardware to prove the adaptability of this paper, which has met the goal to realize the full automatic self-control based on the changing weather and brings a lot conveniences to people in high-speed developing society nowadays.

articleTitle: Study on Propagation Characteristics of Elastic Waves in Coal Measure Strata with Small Faults
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The coal seam and surrounding rock around the small fault are equivalent to the fracture anisotropy medium, and the equivalent medium model of the coal measure strata with small fault is established. Based on this, the anisotropic elastic wave equation of fracture was deduced by using Husdon fracture medium theory and the method of finite element numerical simulation was used. Rick wavelet selected as the source. The simulation of the propagation of elastic waves in the coal measure strata with small faults is carried out by using COMSOL finite element software. The influence of small faults on elastic wave propagation in coal seam is analyzed. It is concluded that as the frequency of the source increases, the displacement ratio of the two particles gradually decreases, that is, the vibration amplitude of the particles tends to be gentle. With the increase of the small fault interval, the energy ratio of the elastic wave in the coal seam before and after the small fault decreases approximately linearly.

articleTitle: Design of USBTMC dirver based on Program-controlled Vector Network Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: USBTMC is the unified standard for the test and measurement application of USB interface device. In order to provide a standard USB interface for program-controlled vector network analyzer, instruments driver based on USBTMC specification is designed. First, the universal automatic test system based on SCPI and VISA is discussed. VISA is a standard for I/O interface software and SCPI is standard commands for programmable instruments. Then the design and implementation of USBTMC driver are introduced. Finally, an automatic test program is written to verify the efficiency and practicality of the design.

articleTitle: Space Information Support Warfare Model Based on Metcalf-Lanchester‘s Equation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to effectively estimate the influence of space information support to operation progress, improve the Lanchester combat equation and establish Metcalf-Lanchester combat model under the space information support. Through the improvement of space information support equipment, developping different support plan, then carry out simulation and analyze the impact of different equipment on operation results. The result of simulation illustrate that the model can reflect the influence of space information support.

articleTitle: More Robust Object Tracking via Semi-supervised Metric Learning and Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel object tracking method via semi-supervised metric learning and edge detection. Firstly, we construct the object appearance model by extracting sparse codes features on different layers to exploit local information and holistic information. To utilize unlabeled samples information, the semi-supervised metric learning is introduced to measure candidates. In addition, based on ranking results from the learned metric classifier, we adopt an edge detection to alleviate the error accumulation. Both the proposed tracker and several selected trackers are tested on some challenging videos, where the target objects undergo pose change, illumination and occlusion. The experimental results demonstrate that the better performance of the proposed tracker compared with state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Trusted Immune Technology of Perceptual Layer of Big Data Platform of Work Safety
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Recently, all kinds of work safety accidents are occurring frequently. The key reason is that the existing security system has serious loopholes, passive defense mechanisms such as intrusion detection, which is difficult to prevent the IOT nodes and networks effectively. This paper proposes a method of trusted immunity on perception layer. The trusted immune node and trusted immune network achieve the trusted immunity. Initiatively measuring technology solves the problem of behavior trust. Simulations of the passive and initiative defense mechanisms indicate that method of trusted immune significantly improves the system security.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Analysis of Heavy Metal Contamination Assessment in Daxia River Basin
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the heavy metal content of the Daxia River Basin, the pollutant carrying capacity and pollution assessment were calculated. A simulation coverage rate parameter was introduced to construct an uncertainty analysis method for a complete watershed model. Applying the geoaccumulation index method assessed the status of heavy metal pollution of the Daxia River Basin. The results show that the average annual pollutant carrying capacity of Pb, Cr, Cd, As, and Cu are 6.4099 t/a, 25.6762 t/a, 4.8257 t/a, 5.9850 t/a, and 43.7648 t/a, which indicates that the Daxia River Basin does not exceed the standard. Nine river sections have a very strong pollutant carrying capacity, and six river sections have a strong pollutant carrying capacity, and one river section has a neutral pollutant carrying capacity. Based on correlation analysis, the fully-mixed model under steady-state conditions is reasonable for the pollution assessment in small and medium river basins.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Ship Power System Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A fault diagnosis method for ship power system based on optimized particle swarm neural network is proposed. The optimization ability of particle swarm optimization is improved by particle dynamic optimization management and cross strategy. The threshold and weight of neural network are optimized by improved particle swarm optimization. The advantages of the algorithm is strong global search and fast convergence. It shows better speed and accuracy in the case of ship generator fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation of Products based on Concept Similarity of Node Depth
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of product diversification, the characteristics of users' demands nowadays reflect diversity and difficult to locate accurately. Nowadays, simple recommendation does not solve the contradiction between product diversity and user needs, and this contradiction has an increasing trend. Technology of personalized recommendation will be the key to solve the contradiction. By analyzing the attribute structure of the products, the attribute is divided into three different layers: content structure, operation and function, and the representation method of tree structure is designed. The structure model can express the attribute structure of products clearly.

articleTitle: Study on energy absorption scheme of rail transit
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the braking and starting of rail transit, the braking energy recovery scheme was studied. The advantages and disadvantages of four energy absorption schemes were analyzed and compared, and one of the most promising energy absorption schemes was proposed. This energy absorption scheme has the advantages of bi-directional energy flow, convenient voltage regulation, fast dynamic response and adaptive orbit pressure variation. This program by a variety of two-way multi-level converter, the city rail train to achieve the absorption of braking energy, start-up to add energy. The program of the control system to improve urban rail transit reliability and traction performance, while achieving regenerative braking power absorption.

articleTitle: Research on Static Var Generator Based on Accurate Linearization and Multi-Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the static var generator (SVG), the traditional PI feedforward decoupling control algorithm is not fully decoupled at active and reactive currents, the robustness of the system is poor and the PI parameter setting is difficult. The accurate linearization of state feedback is used to transform the mathematical model of the static var generator to achieve full decoupling of the active and reactive currents. Sliding mode variable structure controller is used to design the voltage outer loop and the current inner loop to enhance the system stability and reduce the complexity of parameter design. In order to improve the motion quality of the sliding mode, weaken the chattering, and enhance the stability of the current loop, the saturation function is used as the reaching law of sliding mode motion, and the integral sliding surface as the switching surface.

articleTitle: A cooperative controller based on embedded Soft PLC technologyof tobacco primary processing equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to conquers the disadvantages of bad compatibility and extensibility, and low performance cost ratio of traditional PLC, and to make a breakthrough in the encrypted PLC program and the difficulty of secondary development on the new tobacco primary processing equipment. We import embedded soft PLC technology to tobacco primary processing equipment, on the basis of analyzing the advantages of the embedded soft PLC technology and system structure, we draft the test plan and research methods, and analyze the research results, which indicate that the embedded soft PLC development system, in coordination with traditional PLC, can provide intuitive, convenient and efficient programming environment for users and realize the accurate control of tobacco primary processing advanced function.

articleTitle: Research on new method of path detection for new type power communication optical cable
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The principle of Sagnac interference is introduced, and the phase modulation technology of optical signal is analyzed. A method of fiber optic cable path detection is proposed. By analyzing the shape change of fiber caused by external force, the phase of the interference signal is changed, and the external force is transformed into the corresponding data of LED display. In the experiment, we select the maximum value of the LED display intensity data on one side of the five points of a power cable to determine the specific location of the buried communication cable. The simulation experiment shows that the detection method has high positioning accuracy and has great practical value for the maintenance work of the optical fiber cable later.

articleTitle: Application Of Ant Colony Algorithm In Crawler
