publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Internet is almost endless, sharing almost the most advanced knowledge in the human development. According to incomplete statistics, there are more than 1 million Internet pages every day, and the growth rate is huge. How can we quickly retrieve what we need in a complex network environment? This is increasingly becoming a concern for individual users. In 1998, Sergey Brin and Lawrence Page of Stanford University proposed the PageRank algorithm, which can quickly retrieve and locate the knowledge or content we need. The algorithm has also been successfully applied to Google search engines and has achieved great success in commercial applications. The ant colony algorithm is a kind of probabilistic algorithm used to find the optimal path in the graph, and the pheromone is calculated by optimizing the number of times the web page search keyword in the PageRank algorithm is clicked by the updated ant colony algorithm, and the weight of the page is used (The PR value) is iteratively revised and returns a new ranking result that can ultimately improve rankings, optimize search, and increase precision.

articleTitle: Investigations on a measurement algorithm of the slab surface temperature based on linear array CCD
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to accurately measure the slab temperature in continuous casting secondary cooling zone and thus realize the closed-loop control, an accurate measurement system of slab surface temperature based on the linear array charge-coupled device (CCD) of a peripheral component interconnect (PCI) data acquisition card is designed, and its overall hardware scheme is given. The polynomial interpolation method is used to detect the sub-pixel edge of the acquired image to achieve accurate measurement at the sub-pixel level. The noise of the CCD image is also analyzed, and a sub-band filtering algorithm based on wavelet transform is proposed to remove the CCD noise. The filtering effect is obvious.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of High Precision Sigma-Delta Modulator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of low-frequency and low-voltage seismic signal acquisition from analog signal to digital signal, a Σ-Δ modulator for Σ-Δ ADC is designed in this paper. Using the PWM principle, the second-order integral modulation is adopted and the clock signal of the FPGA is used to realize the delta modulation technology of Σ-Δ modulator and the oversampling rate control, and the quantization noise is sufficiently attenuated. Finally, by controlling the frequency of the clock output frequency of 32kHz, 64kHz, 128kHz and other low-frequency low-noise 1 bit data stream, to achieve the Σ-Δ modulation.

articleTitle: Parallel Structure of All Digital Timing Synchronization and Realization of FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the parallel implementation of high-speed and broadband transmission system, and proposes a low-complexity parallel structure, which is the integration of frequency domain timing synchronization and sample points shift. The study is on the basis of AVR Algorithm, which is able to satisfy different modulations. Different from the traditional feedback type all digital timing synchronization structure, the paper divides feedback timing adjustment into integer and fractional parts. The Algorithm of time domain sampling adjustment and frequency domain timing correction is designed and implemented on FPGA platform, and the simulation result verifies that the performance of this algorithm has 1dB gap compared with theoretical value in high-order modulation.

articleTitle: An approach for measuring and separating error of machine tool based on KGM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the complexity of machining parts and high precision requirements, the precision of machine tools is becoming more and more strict. This paper mainly discusses the error source and compensation of the contour error of NC machine tool. A KGM system is used to measure the machine tool movement, which mainly include a plane grating. A simplified method is presented to separate the contour error which is caused by machine tool manufacture, fabrication and control system. And then we can analyze the main error factors causing the contour error of the machine tool. Finally, the error is compensated and the contour error change is shown visually compared before in the process of machine tool movement.

articleTitle: Research on Undesirable text Recognition based on Combination kernel function
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the specific application of undesirable text information identification, combining traditional kernel function the paper structured a new combination kernel. This combination kernel builds model for independent characteristics using the linear kernel function, and combined by polynomial kernel function and linear kernel function. Balancing collinear information of individual characteristics and the single characteristic vocabulary and the multiple characteristic vocabulary to determine undesirable properties of the document, it can accurately distinguish some boundary samples. And the recognition accuracy rate is greater than other kernel functions for the application of undesirable text information filtering. Especially the Rcall value achieved satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Grid Current Control of Microgrid with Cascaded Micro Source Inverters Based on Dynamic Phasors Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to research grid connected operation performance of microgrid with cascaded micro source inverters, the dynamic phasors model of cascaded inverters link is established firstly. Then, the quasi-PR controller in two-phase stationary reference frame and PI controller in synchronization rotating reference frame are used respectively to control the grid current of system. And detailed comparation and analysis are made to the two control methods mentioned above, from the aspect of steady-state error, response speed and grid current quality. Finally, the quasi-PR controller in two-phase stationary reference frame is applied to control the grid current of the microgrid that each phase contains ten cascaded micro source inverters and simulated by MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results show that the current of system has high power quality and fast response under different operating conditions.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Feature Recognition of Frequency Hopping Based on High Order Cumulant Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Transient signal analysis plays an important role in the fingerprint feature extraction of radio stations and is an effective way to realize the frequency-hopping (FH) signal sorting and identification. However, due to the subtle differences in fingerprint characteristics of individual radios, they are severely affected by noise. In order to decrease the influence of environmental noise on the fingerprint features extraction of FH radio stations. In this paper, the envelope fractal feature of the instantaneous signal of the FH radio station is taken as the fingerprinting feature of the radio station. The high-order cumulant estimation “insensitive” to the noise is used to suppress the noise. By constructing the high-order cumulant detection function to extract the boot signal envelope and using the envelope fractal feature to cluster the signal extraction results, fingerprinting characteristics of FH radio stations can be identified. Experimental results show that the fractal feature of the FH signal extracted by this method can effectively suppress the noise impact, at the same time as a FH signal network sorting and identification of a reliable fingerprint features.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation on User Interest Modeling based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Interest model of user is the basic part of personalized recommendation. It represents the interests of users and is the basic guarantee for successful recommendation. The quality of user model is directly related to the recommendation precision of personalized recommendation system. The user model is the main source of personalized recommendation system for personalized recommendation. The ability of user interest model to reflect the user's real preference is the key to the personalized recommendation system. In various industries, the establishment of user models has a positive effect on operators' successful recommendation of products to enhance competitiveness. The combination of user interest modeling based on genetic algorithm and the combination of tree-based product models shows good performance and recommendation effect. Finally, it is proved that the recommendation mechanism based on the behavior and function similarity based on the difference of content is better than the recommendation algorithm based on product similarity and other recommendation mechanisms that add product differentiation.

articleTitle: Astronomical Data Application Research Based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: MapReduce as an abstract distributed computing programming model could solve the issues of parallel computing, such as load balancing, network storage, data distribution, resource allocation, fault tolerance. This makes it easy for people to manipulate large scale cluster systems without considering hardware details. The paper discusses completely how to apply MapReduce. In the construction of the experimental platform, this paper successfully designs and implements the cone search service based on MapReduce, The final result proves that the astronomical data application method based on MapReduce greatly improves the processing capacity.

articleTitle: The Coordinate System Design and Implementation of the Spacecraft's Attitude Simulation based on Five Axis Turntable
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The simulation turntable is an important device for the hardware-in-the-loop simulation of satellites or other spacecraft. It can simulate the movement attitude of the spacecraft in space such as roll, pitch, and yaw, and is widely applied in electromagnetic countermeasure, space shooting and other fields. This paper takes the on-orbit service spacecraft as the research object, studies the coordinate system transformation and implementation problems of ground simulation of spacecraft attitude based on the five-axis turntable, designs the coordinate system conversion process and verifies the effectiveness of the conversion process. The coordinate system conversion method studied in this paper can effectively realize the ground simulation of spacecraft attitude on the five-axis turntable, providing theoretical guidance and effective methods for solving the problems of attitude simulation in on-orbit service tasks, having more important guiding values for simulating experiments in the field of aerospace engineering such as rendezvous and docking.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Based Inter-Objects' Dynamic Relation Discovery and Service Recommendation in Interior Space
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: There are usually some dynamic relations between objects in interior space, which are often the true portrayal for human behavior, therefore translating inter-objects' dynamic relations into service sequence is imperative to serve people. At present, service accuracy improvement is mainly depended on collecting the related contexts from the interactions between human individuals and real-world objects to calculate inter-objects' dynamic correlation degrees for human individuals. But, a possibly correlated individual group appeared in the same interior space outside the targeted human individual is not account yet. To solve this problem, a three-phase method is proposed in this paper: (1) Simply abstract all objects into corresponding agents in order to eliminate the objects' nonuniformity and provide better services for human individuals; (2) Construct inter-objects' dynamic relation sequence from the existing context information due to the fact that most of the individuals' indoor behaviors are similar; (3) Evaluate the dynamic correlation degrees between the object-categories by mathematical expectation, so that more universal and accurate indoor services can be found and provided to wider population.

articleTitle: Target Detection for Remote Sensing Image Based on Multiple ERP Components
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Target detection technique based on event-related potential (ERP) has become a new method to solve the problems of small target detection with complex background in remote-sensing images. Multiple ERP components reflect different stages of the visual information processing, previous studies usually used features of single ERP component to detecting targets. In this paper, a target detection model was built based on multiple ERP components evoked in rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) of remote-sensing images. Experimental results showed that combing the spatiotemporal features of multiple ERP components could improve the detection accuracy, where the mean AUC could reach 89%.

articleTitle: A Software Managemente Method for the LUT
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The software management of the process has played an important role during the software development of the Lunar based Ultraviolet Telescope. Full requirement analysis, practical management plan, clear division of development stage, stage of software life cycle model selection, effective configuration management control, which is an unprecedented management method suitable for the development of optical load software. The final operation results of the lunar based optical telescope show that the method is applicable and effective, and provides reference and reference for China's space load software management.

articleTitle: A Method for Avoiding Track Coalescence in Clutter Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the multi-target and clutter environment, the correlation between measurement and the corresponding target source will becomes complicated. When the track of motion of two targets are close to each other, their track will be cross-merged with the tracking distance gradually increasing. At that time, two tracks will cross over and the two targets will no longer be separated and be tracked into one target. We usually reduce the impact of such problems from two aspects[1] [2]. One is to increase the aspiration of the target measurement and its own track, and the other is to reduce the impact of other measurement and their track. Based on this, this paper uses a simple and effective method to increase the impact of the target measurement and itself track so as to solve cross-merging of tracks effectively. Simulation results show that this method can reduce the tracking error greatly and solve the track crossing problem effectively.

articleTitle: Concurrent Learning-based Fault Estimation for a Class of Over-actuated Systems with Loss of Effectiveness Actuator Faults
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Dealing with the fault estimation problem of a class of over-actuated systems in the presence of loss of effectiveness actuator faults, we propose a concurrent learning-based fault estimation method. In this method, the persistence of excitation condition required by the existing literature is relaxed via concurrent learning technique. Furthermore, bounded external disturbance is eliminated by constructing the estimation error information with a series of filtered system variables. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on the Strategy of Neutral Point Potential Control of Three-level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Taking the three-level inverter as the research object, the topology of the main circuit and the space vector voltage modulation algorithm in the 60° coordinate system are introduced. In order to reduce the harm caused by the midpoint potential imbalance, a closed-loop midpoint voltage and current detection method was proposed. By detecting the potential difference and current direction of the two capacitors on the DC side, balanced modulation was implemented in the software algorithm to achieve real-time suppression of potential imbalance. The principle of the balance control algorithm is easy to understand and it is difficult to achieve. It has been verified in simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Dynamic Allocation of Spares Quota in Convertor Station Based on Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The dynamic allocation for multiple spares in convertor station is of great significance for ensuring the stable operation of devices in convertor station. The least square method is widely utilized in parameter estimation such as mathematics, physics and economic prediction, etc. The dynamic allocation for spares quota in convertor station based on least square method is proposed; and quota of multiple spares in convertor station is correlated to actual quantity demanded. With the previous failure means and failure value of the next year of equipment in convertor station as the research object, the simulation mathematical model is established to test and verify that the dynamic adjustment quota ratio for spares in convertor station based on least square method is practical, and it can effectively solve the problems such as actual quantity demanded of spares if multiple convertor stations.

articleTitle: Development of Rail Transit Bidirectional Multilevel Converter Measurement and Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For rail traffic bidirectional multi-level PWM converter, designed a new type of measurement and control system. The paper details the system hardware circuit and software implementation. The experimental results of field experiments show that the system has realized the rapid operation of bidirectional multi-level converter and made the operation of urban rail transit train better control performance, reliability and traction performance, and has better popularization value of engineering application.

articleTitle: Design of a Route Planning Method for Inspecting Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to inspecting the distribution network largely depending on the personal experience of the inspectors, a route planning method is designed to improve the efficiency of distribution network inspection. First, the problem of route planning is defined, and then the road network data is rebuilt by integrating the position data of the tower on the basis of the existing road network data. Next, the path planning method based on road network layering and partitioning is used to get the planning result of distribution network inspection route. Finally, the method designed in this paper is validated through a simulation test.

articleTitle: Non-cooperative Target Imaging based on Joint CSI-ISAR method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Moving targets appear blurred and misplaced in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images due to the uncompensated target motion. The aim of this work is to combine clutter suppression interference (CSI) and ISAR processing in order to obtain well focused images of non-cooperative moving targets. In this work, the scheme consists of two main processing steps. The first step accomplishes clutter mitigation by exploiting CSI. The second step performs ISAR processing to obtain well-focused images of non-cooperative moving targets. Simulation as well as real data results prove the effectiveness of the processing chain.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Feature Extraction and Recognition of Echo Signal of Underground Cable
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new method for feature extraction and recognition of echo signal of underground cable is proposed. By this method, we use preprocessing to remove the direct coupled wave, set the threshold to segment the image, search the maximum energy of each horizontal position to extract hyperbolic characteristic points, and then use the least squares method for hyperbolic fitting. Based on this method, we can quickly recognize hyperbolic characteristics, extract the information of hyperbolic vertex, calculate the propagation velocity of electromagnetic wave in underground medium by weighted velocity method, and finally acquire the buried depth of underground cable. Based on finite difference time-domain method, the numerical simulation of the cable model under the soil is carried out. The method is applied to the forward analysis to verify the accuracy of the method, which provides the necessary information for the image modeling of the underground cable.

articleTitle: Research on Parallelization of Logsf Feature Selection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the advent of the large data age, it is becoming more and more important to reduce the dimension of data. As a common means of data reduction preprocessing, feature selection has attracted more and more attention in recent years. At present, it is mainly based on the traditional feature selection algorithm, but the traditional method has been unable to meet the requirements of massive high-dimensional data processing. So, this paper studies the Logsf feature selection algorithm based on local learning, and improves the shortcomings of the existing algorithm. Then, by using the Mapreduce framework in the Hadoop platform, the improved Logsf feature selection algorithm is designed and implemented in parallel. Finally, the experimental results show that the improved Logsf feature selection algorithm for parallel processing is superior to the existing Logsf feature selection algorithm in the accuracy and the speedup. It fully shows that the characteristics of the parallel Logsf algorithm has a good reliability in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on the error correction method of the shaft angle encoder's sudden change
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Shaft angle encoder is an important part of the antenna servo system. The encoder demodulated range, pitch angle jump seriously affect the safety of antenna This paper briefly introduces the working principle of the antenna shaft encoder, analyzes the encoder code value jump, designed the last error correction, zero calibration of the two methods, which provides effective reference for solving this kind of problem.

Author Keywords: combination with coarse and fine channel

articleTitle: Auditory Space Perception Influenced by Visual Spatial Information
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: It is well known that there are many situations where auditory and visual perception cannot be regarded as independent processes. This article aims to explore whether the subjective perception of the auditory spatial size is affected by visual spatial information. Static pictures which reflect different spatial size were used as visual spatial stimuli, and audio signals with different reverberation time were used as auditory spatial stimuli in subjective experiments. Results of visual-auditory mode and auditory-only mode were discussed and compared. Experimental results showed that visual spatial information had significant effect on auditory space perception, especially in judging the medium size of the auditory space. Further analysis indicated that the judgments of auditory spatial size perception were induced by the visual stimuli when judging the large size and small size of the auditory space. What's more, the influence of the subjects' gender and listening experience were analyzed, it was found that there was no significant difference.

articleTitle: Breeding Data Service Platform Based on the New Architecture of Cloud Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rise of information and communication technologies such as big data and Internet of things, traditional breeding data management methods have been unable to cope with the demand of large-scale breeding. Aiming at the present situation, a new breeding data service structure based on cloud technology is put forward, and a breeding data service platform is constructed. The platform with the Django Web framework, Python modeling language for the back-end operation, MongoDB for the database, uses cloud storage data center model and the user-oriented multi-level service structure, providing data storage and data analysis services for breeders. The platform provides the feasible architecture scheme for the breeding units to carry out the corresponding service, realizes the sharing of breeding data resources, and advances the process of Internet + agricultural informatization construction.

articleTitle: Polynomial fuzzy control of Multi-scroll Chen chaotic system via sum-of-squares approach
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation results considering the use of polynomial fuzzy control for stabilization of multi-scroll Chen chaotic system. The chaotic system is represented in the polynomial fuzzy model form and less conservation stability conditions are proposed. The controller here designed is obtained by solving the sum-of-squares constraints via SOSTOOLS. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed controller design method.

articleTitle: SISO System Model Identification and Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on system identification and self-adaptive neural network for a class of SISO systems with system identification. In the case of system with noise and other external disturbances, the least squares method is first used for the SISO system, and conduct online modeling. On this basis, the observer is used to observe the nonlinear function. In order to ensure the stability of the observer and the diagnosis system, the stability of the closed-loop system under bounded noise interference and system uncertainty is given.

articleTitle: Power System Cleanliness Evaluation Based on Weighted Entropy and Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to speed up the construction of clean energy demonstration province in Zhejiang Province, this paper proposes a weighted entropy model for evaluating the cleanliness of power grids from the view of energy saving and cleanliness. The fuzzy mathematics and weighted entropy method are used to model each factor of interest, and five main evaluation indexes of energy saving and emission reduction are developed. The potential containment boundary is set up and the modularization of many kinds of external factors is solved reasonably. This paper provides a grid selection and comparison model based on the attribute of energy saving and emission reduction of regional power grid, which is used to evaluate and compare the cleanliness of a regional power grid.

articleTitle: Design of Bipolar Independent Adjustable Pulse of MAO Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low power efficiency and high energy consumption in power technology of micro-arc oxidation, a bipolar individually adjustable pulse power system based on the processor STM32F427IIH6 is proposed, and the hardware circuit design is completed. The main circuit adopts the design way of positive and negative individually adjustable circuit; the STM32F427IIH6 processor in the control circuit is responsible for the information detection and data processing of the voltage and current acquisition data, and controls the output of PWM signal in real time by PID adjustment to drive the main circuit rectification and inverter circuit, the purpose is to realize double closed-loop intelligent control. After an actual analysis, the system has the design effects of fast response, high control accuracy, and stable output of positive and negative pulse.

articleTitle: Low-power smart home node design based on STM32L433
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This design proposes a low-power node solution based on the Global System for Mobile communication (GSM) wireless sensor network, which aims to solve the problem that the environment does not meet the general node deployment conditions. This program uses STMicroelectronics' STM32L433 ultra-low-power chip as the main control chip to reduce power consumption. The communication adopts the GSM module for communication. The DHT11 is used as the greenhouse acquisition module and the Mipex-02 is used as the smoke sensor. This design is based on GPRS technology, embedded technology, cloud service technology, and jointly build a set of smart home systems. In this paper, the main control ultra-low-power operation is realized by controlling the chip dormancy, and the data acquisition and upload cycle can be set, and then the communication module can be awakened periodically, and an ultra-low power smart home node design is realized.

Author Keywords: Internet of Things Smart Home Low Power GPRS STM32

articleTitle: Multi Feature Small Sample Object Recognition Method based on DTW Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the process of small sample object identification, the use of single feature or multi-featured one-dimensional data classification methods has the disadvantages of low accuracy and large amount of sample data. A multi-feature-based small sample recognition method based on DTW algorithm is proposed. Selecting four kinds of object features and using dynamic time warping (DTW) algorithm to regularize the feature of the selected object boundary chain code, to obtain the same dimension of the chain code data for the similarity calculation. Finally, using the Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN) to perform the object recognition training on the four normalized features separately and in different combinations, the features with strong correlations for object type identification are screened out. Compared with K-nearest neighbor algorithm (KNN) recognition results, the method can reduce the data dimension from 11025 to 18, and the recognition accuracy rate is up to 93.9%.

articleTitle: Optimization Methods of Motion Control System at the Inflection Point
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Motion control system has complex features, especially the motion planning problems of the system. Motion control system inevitably causes mechanical vibration when it moves to inflection point in high-speed interpolation process. In this paper, different mathematical models of the inflection point are set up. Outer arc method and inner arc method are put forward to optimize the interpolation algorithm at inflection point. And the advantages and disadvantages of the two methods are analyzed. Combining motion control with intelligent control, the selection of the key length at the inflection point based on fuzzy control theory. Finally, to verify the effectiveness of the methods, an open motion control platform was built, the interpolation algorithm is encapsulated in function block, which accords with the motion control standard proposed by PLCopen.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-wide band High Isolation and Low Insertion Loss SPDT Switch
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Microwave switches are the basic components in microwave control circuits. They are mainly used to control the switching and switching of microwave channels. They have been widely used in the fields of electronic testing and measurement., wireless communication, radar, electronic monitoring and confrontation. In this paper, based on ADRF5021 microwave switch chip, through reasonable circuit layout, impedance matching design and structure design, a ultra-wideband single-pole double-throw(SPDT) switch is realized in the frequency range of 100KHz-22GHz with isolation greater than 90dB., insertion loss less than 5.5dB., and port return loss better than 10dB.

articleTitle: A new multi-moving object tracking method based on CRC RLS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a novel technique for classification, sparse representation has shown promising performance on multi-object tracking. However, l l-norm is used in traditional SRC to solve NP problem, which make it unsuitable for tracking in real-time. A new multi-object tracking method based on collaborative representation regularized least square is proposed. 12-norm is adopted to improve the classification accuracy slightly and reduce the computational complexity. The experimental results demonstrate that CRC _ RLS is up to 20-357 times faster than SRC without sacrificing recognition rate.

articleTitle: Thermoelastic damping analysis of double clamped microbeams with exponentially tapered thickness
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For microbeam resonators operated in vacuum, thermoelastic damping (TED) has been theoretically and experimentally verified as a fundamental mechanism of energy loss. Especially, the upper limitation of quality factor of resonators is determined by thermoelastic damping. There are two classical models developed by Zener and Lifshits and Roukes (LR) for evaluating TED. However, the classical models are imprecise to calculate TED values of non-uniform microbeams. In this study, a modified TED model for non-uniform microbeams with exponentially tapered thickness is proposed basing on Zener's theory. The constraint boundary condition of doubly clamped usually encountered in MEMS field is taken into account. The modal parameters of non-uniform beams considered in this work are solved by the modified Adomian decomposition method. Results show that TED values of the present model agree well with those of the finite element method (FEM) model. At low frequencies, TED values of exponentially tapered microbeams are lower than those of uniform microbeams. Additionally, the value of Debye peak of exponentially tapered microbeams is approximately 0.474Δ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</sub> that is lower than 0.5Δ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">E</sub> of the uniform microbeam.

articleTitle: Research on auxiliary transportation system of double-electric trolley in mine
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to find an effective solution for vehicle pollution and long slope transportation in underground coal mine, double-electric trolley auxiliary transportation system in mine is put forward. The system is composed of power supply system, overhead line system, charging station, collector and double-electric trolley. It has three operation modes: quick charging, online and mixing. In this paper, the key technical indexes of each subsystem are put forward, and three operation modes are expounded in detail. Finally, three key technologies and the corresponding solutions of the auxiliary transportation system are proposed, including power capacity and supply arm matching technology, overhead line change line technology, power battery selection and matching technology, to provide technical support for the future realization of trolley auxiliary transportation system.

articleTitle: Electronic Table Card Based on Full Color LED Screen
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Nowadays, the table cards appeared in the meetings are mostly made of paper or copper. They usually lack of beauty and just used once, which not only is a waste of resource but also does bad to environmental protecting. Then an electronic table card that can be reused and easily set is needed. In this design, IAP15W4K58S4 is chosen as the main control chip of the whole system, and MBI5124 is used to drive the full-color 32*64LED screen, and the battery management module and communication module are needed as well. The font and color of characters on the screen can be easily set by a computer or smartphone.

articleTitle: Parameter identification of synchronous condenser based on Grid Searching Method of Initial Values
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The accuracy of the parameters of the synchronous condenser will impact on the stability analysis of the UHV DC system. This paper presents a joint identification strategy based on Grid Searching Method of Initial Values (GSIV) with multiple transient disturbances in power system. The identification results of this strategy satisfy the output curves of multiple disturbances at the same time. Therefore, the results have higher credibility. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional single disturbance identification strategy, this identification strategy has higher accuracy. The identification result is less affected by the initial value of the parameters and is more stable.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Reconstruction of Coal-rock Microscopic Image using Pattern Density Function and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction is of great significance to the research of spatial structure and physical properties of porous media. In this paper, we propose a kind of new 3D reconstruction algorithm of coal-rock microscopic image by combing pattern density function and genetic algorithm. One single 2D microscopic image is used as training image (TI) and pattern density function is used as constraint condition of genetic algorithm, and 3D structure of coal-rock is reconstructed by genetic algorithm. Our experimental results suggest that reconstructed results are similar with real structure at both physical and visual properties.

articleTitle: A congestion control strategy for opportunistic network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The forwarding-based routing algorithm in the opportunistic network will cause a large amount of data to flow to important nodes, resulting in unbalanced load on the nodes. Eventually, congestion will occur on those important nodes and data will be dropped. Aiming at this problem, a congestion control strategy based on node identity transformation is proposed. Based on its own degree of congestion, nodes choose to accept only, forward only, or accept and forward data. And according to different levels of congestion, different message processing methods are selected. Simulation results show that the congestion control strategy can effectively reduce the node's congestion, reduce the number of message copies in the network, and improve the efficiency of data delivery.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technologies of 3DGIS for Wisdom Forest Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the increasingly prominent environmental problems caused by the high degree of industrialization and urbanization, the requirements of landscaping and ecological construction have been constantly raised. GIS technology plays a leading role in the field of forest landscape display. With the continuous improvement of 3D GIS technology, the application of 3D GIS in Wisdom Forest Platform system has become the main trend of forest information management. This topic systematically studies the current situation of Wisdom forest management and the development trend of 3D GIS, and puts forward a new mode of application of 3D GIS in Wisdom forest management. Based on the actual survey, on-the-spot survey and the existing data, the forest 3D model is further constructed after obtaining the data. The main research is based on ArcGIS Engine10.2 platform and Visual Studio 2012 programming environment for the development and of 3D landscape system.

articleTitle: Research on Bottom Drag Prevention for an Unmanned Deepwater Collection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For reducing the risk of marine monitoring crew and avoiding the occurrence of the bottom drag event of water collector, this paper focuses on an unmanned deepwater collection based on the deck of unmanned surface vehicle(USV). From analysis of the water flow model given by Acoustic Doppler Current Profilers(ADCP), a depth prediction model was proposed. So that the control strategies was further developed and the closed-loop control systems were well designed. The deepwater collection mechanism controlled by this system can ensure that the distance between the collector and seabed is more than two meters while in the descending task. It This system can be used utilized in island surveys, marine monitoring and hydrology studies.

articleTitle: Design of a Batch Sampling Device for Cigarettes Based on PLC Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the cigarette production industry, the automatic cigarette sampling device varies. This paper introduces a new batch sampling device based on PLC technology, which involves mainly the system's mechanical structure, its operating principle, the PLC program control flow and so on. Sampling by the device is completely mechanical, which means it's easy to operate and is with good stability, safety and reliability. Meanwhile, it does not interfere with or damage the sample flow. So it can be used for non-destructive batch sampling of rod-like products such as large flow of cigarettes in high-speed production environment, which greatly reduces the labour intensity of quality checkers by improving the automation of cigarette testing, resulting in great industrial application value.

articleTitle: A Digital Self-Calibration Technique for 16-bit SARADC
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a new digital calibration algorithm is proposed to reduce the circuit area by means of reusing the digital circuit while ensuring the accuracy of the calibration capacitor array. The algorithm is applied to a 16-bit 200KS/s 4 channels sar adc, fabricated in EMC 55-nm process. The simulation result shows that the ENOB of the SAR ADC is raised from 10.85 bits to 15.25 bits, and the SNDR is from 67.07dB increased to 93.54dB. SFDR increased from 70.66dB to 110.6dB. DNL remained at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\pm 0.8\mathrm{LSB}}$</tex>, and INL remained at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\pm 1\mathrm{LSB}}$</tex> after the calibration algorithm is adopted.

articleTitle: Elastic Optical Networks for Future Internet and New Defragment Scheme by Extending the Maximal Unoccupied Spectrum Blocks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Elastic Optical Networks (EON) is a widely accepted promising solution for future Internet, which can allocate and release lightpaths with flexible frequency assignment granularity. Defragmentation strategy is one of most important technologies in EON. In this paper, we investigate the states of spectrum defragment strategies, and propose an improved defragmentation scheme to alleviate spectrum fragmentation in dynamic network environments by extending the maximal unoccupied spectrum blocks. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulations show that the proposed scheme can effectively reduce the degree of fragmentation of the network and extend the maximal unoccupied spectrum blocks.

articleTitle: Aviation Flight Security Assurance Evaluation System Based on Panboolean Algebra
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The quality of aviation security communications directly affects the quality of flight and even the safety of flight. An assessment of the communications security of each flight provides a powerful reference for follow-up support. According to the reality of aviation security protection, taking the protection of communication in a flight schedule as the research object, the main factors affecting the protection are fully considered, A system evaluation mathematics evaluation model was established by means of the Pan-Boolean algebra method with more intuitive laws in the principle of automatic control. The example shows that the evaluation made by the method of the Pan-Boolean algebra can provide the commander with objective and fair data evaluation, and it also provides data support for the next step of communication security personnel, so as to better ensure the foundation of flight.

articleTitle: A Heuristic Algorithm for Satellite Transmission Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Satellite transmission scheduling problem (STSP) is an important part of satellite mission planning and one of the bottlenecks in satellite development. This paper established a mathematical model for the STSP problem. After that, we proposed an effective heuristic scheduling algorithm (HSA) and task scheduling algorithm (TSA) based on the characteristics of the problem. In addition, in the TSA, a greedy task scheduling method is adopted to ensure that the task arrangement is more compact in order to obtain a better solution. We verified the effectiveness of HSA and TSA algorithms under different task scales and proved that this algorithm can solve the STSP problem well. HSA and TSA all have good performance in terms of total revenue, number of tasks completed, and time utilization.

articleTitle: MRUC Method for FPGA Configuration
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Missile-borne experiments usually take place in various environments. As a core device on real-time signal processing board, FPGA needs to be configured with different data depend on the conditions as well as supporting remote data transmission and online configuration. However, traditional FPGA configuration methods cannot meet the application demands of the new experiment, therefore MRUC method emerges. In this paper, the basic principle of MRUC method is introduced. The method which solves the problems in real experiments realizes FPGA multi-data configuration, supports remote data transmission, data updating and FPGA online configuration.

articleTitle: Application of Infrared Imaging Processing in the Monitoring of Temperature in Lees Airing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The traditional lees airing system of Chinese Strong Aromatic Spirits has the problems of inaccurate, incomplete and uneven temperature monitoring of the lees face. Therefore, a real-time monitoring method of lees temperature based on infrared thermal imaging technology is proposed in this paper. In this paper, the infrared temperature image of lees was collected by infrared sensors. The temperature distribution of distiller's grains thermal image was analyzed, and the temperature change curve of lees surface was plotted. The infrared image mixed processing algorithm was used to calculate the probability of uniform distribution of lees temperature. The compliance rate of the two areas of the airing bed reached 58.49% and 84.32%, respectively. Experiments show that the application of infrared thermal imaging technology can accurately determine the spreader's effectiveness. Finally, according to the monitoring effect, this paper proposes an improvement plan for the air-dryer.

articleTitle: A New Design of the Near Zero Refractive Index Metamaterials Loaded with the Radome
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a new type of artificial composite material, metamaterial can achieve arbitrary permittivity in principle and has great potential in the field of radome. Based on the metamaterial theory, a new type of near zero refractive index metamaterial (ZRM) is designed and its electromagnetic properties are studied in this paper. And the ZRM radome is integrated with the microstrip antenna designed in the X band. The simulation and measured results show that the gain of antenna increases by 2.75dBi without changing the characteristics of the antenna passband, and the directivity of the antenna is improved.

articleTitle: Torque ripple reduction of four-phase SRM based on DTC method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Switched reluctance motor (SRM) has attracted attention of the motor industry due to its simple structure, high reliability and low cost. However, the inherent shortcoming of SRM, principally the torque ripple, limited its development. In this paper, the direct torque control (DTC) method for four-phase SRM will be researched. The relationship between space flux vector and voltage vector will be analyzed, and the switch on-off state principle will be established. The DTC control strategy is simulated by using Simulink, compared with the widely used traditional strategy -current chopper control (CCC). The simulation shows that DTC for four-phase (8/6) SRM can reduce the torque ripple with 73% compared to the traditional strategy.

articleTitle: Disturbance Observer-Based Sliding Mode Control for DC-DC Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the pulse-width modulation DC-DC Boost converter under the influence of input voltage and load resistance uncertainty, the sliding mode control law is designed based on the disturbance observer so that the output voltage of the converter can follow the reference voltage. Using the proposed method, disturbance observer combined with the linear sliding surface, the goal of asymptotic stability of the output voltage is achieved under the disturbance. Through rigorous theoretical analysis, the stability of the closed-loop system has been proved. MATLAB simulation validates the effectiveness of the control method. Compared with the existing integral sliding mode control method, the proposed method has better control performance.

articleTitle: The Rapid and Coordinated Charging Strategy for Private Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the rapid and coordinated charging of private electric vehicles, two coordinated charging strategies were formulated under the rapid charging mode. One is to establish a coordinated charging strategy that minimizes the total charging time of electric vehicles, the minimum of power standard deviation and the peak-valley difference of distribution networks. The multi-objective function is normalized to a single-target solution by weighted summation method. The other is to use the total charging time of electric vehicles as a constraint to achieve peak clipping and filling of the distribution network. Taking the collected traffic data of weekdays and holidays in Lanzhou City as an example, two kinds of coordinated optimization schemes were simulated and analyzed on weekdays and holidays conditions respectively, and the genetic algorithm was used to solve the problem. The results show that the total charging time is the smallest when charging is uncoordinated charging, and peak clipping and filling effect of the distribution network is the worst; when electric vehicles do not consider the time target for coordinated charging, peak clipping and filling effect of the distribution network is the best and the total charging time is the longest; when electric vehicles contain the time target for coordinated charging, peak clipping and filling effect of the distribution network is intermediate.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Power Flow Entropy Index of Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to meet the optimization of power distribution throughout the country, China will build an UHV AC/DC hybrid power grid with UHV AC and DC backbone grids and coordinated development of power grids at all levels. This paper is based on the characteristics of the complex system of power system, and the entropy theory is applicable to analyze the nature of the orderliness of complex systems. The entropy index is applied to the evaluation system of power system operation status, and the existing entropy index is summarized and analyzed. The weighted power flow entropy weighted by the regional average load rate corrected by the mean squared coefficient is used as the mathematical representation of the self-organized criticality of the power system. Finally, a comparative analysis of the example results shows that the index can accurately and effectively reflect the degree of order distribution of the system power flow.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Double Closed-loop SPWM Inverter Based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new dual closed-loop SPWM inverter control method based on fuzzy neural network is proposed. The method establishes the fuzzy reasoning rules by analyzing the effect of PI controller proportion coefficient and integral coefficient. The fuzzy neural network controller is designed for automatically adjust the parameters of PI controller. Double closed-loop control is introduced at the same time, in which the proportional control is used in the current inner ring, and fuzzy neural network control adopted on voltage outer loop. The performance of the proposed method is compared with fuzzy adaptive PI double closed-loop control. Single phase inverter power supply system simulation experiments show that, inverter power supply system controlled by PI double-closed loop control based on fuzzy neural network, has a lower voltage THD value, better steady-state and dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Self-balancing car based on ARDUINO UNO R3
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper uses a simple two-wheel self-balancing car as the design platform., the gesture sensing system with MPU6050 serves as the main sensor. The data of two sensors are filtered and fused by discrete Kalman Filter. ARDUINO is a nuclear control processor to complete the processes of data collection, analysis, processing and body control. PID control algorithm is adopted to realize two wheels which are self-balancing and use mobile APP to connect with Bluetooth in order to send commands to control the car's movement. The experimental results show that the performance of the system meets requirements of this design.

articleTitle: The Research of Dynamic Spectrum Allocation Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the existing literatures, the spectrum price function of the primary users (PUs) is not considered to be affected by the spectrum supply and demand relationship between the primary and secondary users (SUs) in the model of dynamic spectrum allocation. In this paper, an improved dynamic spectrum allocation model (Improved-DSA) was proposed, in which SUs update their spectrum request dynamically by obtaining the spectrum price information of PUs and their own historical game strategy information. In addition, SUs' competition factor is introduced to analyze the effects of SUs' competition on SUs' Nash equilibrium and SUs' dynamic game stability. Finally, static game and dynamic game were be use d to analyze the competitive behavior of SUs, and simulation results reveal that the strategies of SUs will converge to the Nash equilibrium faster.

articleTitle: A VCP-based Congestion Control Algorithm in Named Data Networking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With further research on Named Data Networking (NDN), congestion control is one of the most key modules of NDN system. Since content can be retrieved from multiple sources and through multiple paths, traditional implicit-feedback congestion control mechanism based on retransmission time out (RTO) estimate is not applicable for NDN architecture. Based on the theory of Variable-Structure Congestion Control Protocol (VCP), an improved Explicit Congestion Control Algorithm was proposed in the paper to address this problem. With proposed algorithm, intermediate router computes a `load factor' which indicates the level of network congestion, and adds it in Data packets which return back to client, so that the client can actively adjust its request- sending rate according to the load factor. The simulation implemented on the ns3-based NDN simulator (ndnSIM) shows that: compared with traditional Additive Increase Multiplicative Decrease (AIMD) algorithm, the proposed algorithm can significantly enhance the efficiency and stability of data transmission.

articleTitle: Coarse Alignment Technique Based on SVD Method for SINS on Swing Base
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A method of coarse alignment with better precision is proposed to solve the swing base alignment problem. This method is based on the Wahba problem and based on the principle of the singular value decomposition (SVD). Firstly, the principle of the Wahba problem is expounded. The relationship between the Wahba problem and the SVD method is discussed. Secondly, a coarse alignment method of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) based on SVD method is designed. Finally, the coarse alignment method is verified by simulation test and compared with the TRIAD algorithm and optimal TRIAD algorithm. In the Monte-Carlo simulations 500 simple results suggest that the azimuth precision of coarse alignment based on the SVD method is above than that of coarse alignment based on the TRIAD algorithms. It can improve the azimuth precision from 2.5 degrees to less than 1 degree. On the basis of this, the precision alignment can be easy to achieve.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of Railway Catenary Based on Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the image-based detection of catenary anomalies, detection of bird's nest anomalies is a typical situation. However, the image data containing the nests is only a small portion of total data, which makes nest detection a typical problem of imbalanced data classification. For using machine learning algorithm to solve imbalanced data classification, the learning ability of data features is of much importance. The generative adversarial networks (GANs) can learn prosperous data features from unlabeled data, which has been widely confirmed and applied. In this paper, GANs is used to detect the bird's nest anomalies, which achieved a higher accuracy compared with the traditional method based on feature extraction.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Financial Approval System Based on jBPM Engine
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: on the basis of analyzing and explaining the concept of workflow, this paper analyzes the open source workflow engine jBPM (Java Business Process Management) from the perspectives of architecture, database table structure, authority management and so on. Combining the financial approval process of the enterprise, a prototype of financial approval management system is developed, and the main design ideas and key technologies to be realized are expounded in details. The trial application of the system shows that the jBPM workflow engine has obvious advantages in such aspects as business process customization, automatic management process control, scalability and security. It can meet flexible and changeable needs of the business process, and does improve the efficiency of financial approval, which has guiding significance in engineering practices.

articleTitle: Research on Sentiment Classification for Tang Poetry based on TF-IDF and FP-Growth
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Ancient poetry is an excellent traditional culture through chronic historical accumulation in China. One of the most critical issues in studying poetries is how to effectively understand the quintessence and emotions contained in them. This paper presents a novel emotion automatic annotation strategy particularly answer this question. First, we use the Valence-Arousal space model to realize the continuity of the ancient poetry's emotional expression based on traditional classifications of ancient poetries. Second, we propose an emotional characteristics extracting algorithm which makes both use of TF-IDF's good support for feature extraction and FP-growth algorithm's speciality in mining relationships between words. Finally, back propagation neural network is used as a classifier to automatic label the ancient poetry emotion. The correctness, stability and practicability of the proposed strategy are proved with both theoretical analysis and experimental simulations. The evaluation results show that the proposed strategy can achieve automatic annotation of emotions under acceptable accuracy.

articleTitle: A Parameter Estimation Algorithm for Frequency-Hopping Signals with a Stable Noise
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that most frequency-hopping parameters estimation methods based on Gaussian white noise are currently under the stable distributed noise background, the performance is drastically reduced. In this paper, two fractional low-order STFT with different window functions are firstly applied to the frequency-hopping signal to obtain two sets of time-frequency data. Then, two sets of time-frequency data are multiplied to obtain a new time-frequency representation, and finally based on time-frequency analysis. Frequency-hopping parameter estimation method realizes estimation of frequency-hopping parameters. Simulation experiments show that the proposed method effectively suppresses the a stable distribution noise. When α <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">=0.8</sub>, GSNR ≥1dB; a <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">=1.5</sub>, GSNR ≥0dB, an accurate estimation of the frequency-hopping period can be achieved. At the time of α <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">=1.5</sub>, the maximum relative error of the estimation time of the algorithm is 3% lower than the STFT, 1.6% lower than the fractional low-order STFT, and the estimated hopping-frequency is more accurate.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Ant Colony Routing in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is an important part of modern information technology. If the sensor nodes distributed on the edge need to interact with the outside, they must have reasonable routes., It should be fully considered that the device is limited in terms of resources when designing a route, such as bandwidth and energy. In this paper, we developed a mosquitto-based program with the MQTT protocol, using improvement ant colony algorithm based on resource constraint to implement route planning in IoT. By comprehensively considering resource constraints and updating the global pheromone strategy, the device can avoid excessive attention the local information and achieve dynamic optimization. On the other hand, we achieve load balancing purposes by measuring the remaining energy of the device. Experiments on a network based on the MQTT protocol show that this model can improve the performance of IoT.

articleTitle: A Compact filter based on Substrate Integrated Coaxial Line Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A compact filter based on substrate integrated coaxial line technology(SICL) and implemented with spur stepped impedance resonator(SSIR) is proposed. Unlike previous filter structure.the resonant unit of this filter is introduced by electromagnetic coupling, which generates two transmission zeros outside the band, improving the out-of-band rejection ratio of the filter. The filter is designed at the center frequency of 9GHz with the bandwidth Of 1.5 GHz, which can be used for the resonant unit of a millimeter-wave radar oscillator.

Author Keywords: substrate integrated coaxial line (SICL); compact filter

articleTitle: Radar Anti-jamming Technology based on Waveform Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Concerning the difficulty in guarantee the ability of the radar in the complex antagonism environment without prior information and the radar itself passively against the interference of the receiver after the jamming signal enters the radar receiver. An interference suppression approach based on waveform watermarking technology is presented(A method of interference suppression based on waveform watermarking technology is proposed.). First of all, the influence of modulation parameters on the time domain waveform and spectrum of MPPSK signal is analyzed, then a radar waveform watermarking technique using MPPSK modulated waveform as medium frequency carrier is presented. On this basis, the interference suppression method based on two pulse cancellation is proposed, and the effect of inhibiting performance to SNR(Signal to Noise Ratio) and modulation parameters are analyzed by computer simulation. The simulation results show that using the ultra narrow band spectrum characteristics of 2PPSK, it can be embedded as a watermark to transmitted radar signals. The method has good anti-jamming effect at SNR ≥10dE, and can achieve the extraction of target distance information, but it needs accurate phase compensation between adjacent pulses.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of Axial-Flux Eddy Current Coupler
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Ahstract-A procedure for design optimization of the axial-flux eddy current coupler is proposed in this paper. The equivalent circuit model of eddy current coupler is employed to study the influence of the geometrical parameters on the performance of eddy current coupler, then the ranges and constraints of the design parameters are developed. The use of eddy current coupler can prevent the damage caused by the vibration or overload from the load side but bring a drop in the transmitted speed and additional moment of inertia. To make a minimum influence on the original drive system, eddy current coupler is designed to operate at the rated torque of the drive motor as well as with high efficiency and low moment of inertia. The temperature rise in the copper plate is also taken into account to avoid the irreversible demagnetization of the permanent magnets. The performance of the designed coupler is verified through 3-D finite element method (FEM).

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control Based on Radial Basis Function Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: There are two disadvantages in Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC): indeterminate parameters are included in Tracking - Differentiator (TD); and there are interferences between the parameters. For these, an Active Disturbance Rejection Control based on Radial Basis Function (RBF) Neural Network is proposed to solve the above two disadvantages for improving the algorithm. Nonlinear functions can be approached accurately by RBF Neural Network, that can be used to improve the TD. The simulation results show that the Active Disturbance Rejection Control based on Radial Basis Function (RBF) Neural Network's robustness is better, and Its anti-interference ability is stronger.

articleTitle: Electric vehicles charging and discharging control strategy based on independent DC micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The independent running DC micro-grid has the problems of small system capacity and poor stability, and the proposed vehicle-to-micro-grid (V2M) concept can effectively alleviate the above problems. In view of the space-time and uncertainty of the charging and discharging characteristics of electric vehicles, a charge and discharge control strategy based on variable power time division control is proposed in this paper. The strategy takes the system power difference as the base, and carries out reasonable charge and discharge control to the electric vehicle group according to the current state of the DC micro-grid, the load demand and the peak valley period, so as to support the power balance of the micro-grid system effectively, and realize the stable operation of the independent DC micro grid. Finally, the simulation model of electric vehicle charging and discharging is built by using Matlab/Simulink to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Binocular Camera Calibration Based on Three-dimensional Reconstruction Error
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a new high precision binocular camera calibration method. In the classical calibration method, the camera parameters are usually obtained by the optimization calculation of the re-projection error. However, for the system used for three-dimensional optical measurement, this error does not represent the result of three-dimensional reconstruction. In this method, a specially designed calibration board is photographed at multiple angles. (there is no strict requirement in the calibration process.), the intrinsic parameters of the two cameras are obtained by the image. Then, the rotation matrix and translation matrix between the two cameras are computed by the centroid distance increment matrix method. Thus the degree of coupling between the parameters is reduced. At the same time, the space intersection method is used to reconstruct the 3D coordinates of calibration points. Finally, the reconstruction error is calculated and minimized to optimize the calibration parameters. This error directly reflects the efficiency of 3D reconstruction and is more suitable for the quality evaluation of binocular camera calibration. Experiments show that this method is simple, accurate and significantly improves the accuracy.

articleTitle: An Active Equalization Circuit Based on the Share Bus for series Li-Ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An active cell balancing circuit based on the Share Bus for Li-ion batteries is proposed in this paper. The equalization circuit has the following advantages. Firstly, the Share Bus topology can achieve simultaneous equalization of all batteries, thereby leading to a high balancing speed. Secondly, the proposed circuit adopts zero-voltage control technology which can reduce the power loss of the MOSFET. Besides, the number of switches in the circuit is equal to the number of the battery cells. So the proposed circuit has a lower cost. An experiment was carried out with 12-cell batteries to verify the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Power Information Risk Security Based on Risk Matrix
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of information, power information security risk management has become more and more important. Based on the analysis of the eight information security risk factors, the author assess information security risk with the risk matrix method which conceives an assessment model processed by expert 2-dimension matrix, Borda sequence and analytical hierarchy process. An example application shows the total risk level and figure out the biggest risk factor. The research results illustrate the validity and rationality of the above model as well as it will be of much use in improving power information security risk management.

articleTitle: Frequency Measurement by FFT Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for frequency measurement by FFT IP core in FPGA. It can be used in 24GHz Doppler radar system. Currently, almost all the frequency measurement uses frequency counting by singlechip machine(SCM). This method is easy to be affected by noise and keystroke jitter. However, frequency measurement by FFT can easily avoid the effect of noise and jitter and obtain the results quickly and efficiently. Even it can obtain the data of two objects at the same time. This can improve the accuracy of blind area detection and avoid accidents effectively. The cost of the sources and price both are low to meet users' demand. It can be widely used in automotive electronics.

articleTitle: A Novel Binary Chaotic Cloud Flower Pollination Algorithm for Analog Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In analog fault diagnosis, support vector machine (SVM) classifier is a popular diagnosis technique. Before training the SVM classifier, feature extraction is an essential preprocessing step to enhance the identifiability of the fault samples. However, in the feature set, there exist the redundant and uncorrelated features, which have the inferior influence on the learning performance of the SVM classifier. Feature selection is to select the most representative feature subset to enhance the diagnosis accuracy. In addition, the penalty coefficient and kernel width parameter in SVM also impact the classification performance. Obviously, the selection of feature subset and SVM parameters can be considered as an optimization problem. Flower pollination algorithm (FPA) as a swarm intelligence optimization is derived from the pollination behavior of flowers. In this paper, we propose a novel binary version of FPA and then incorporate a cross search strategy based on chaos theory and cloud model into the novel BFPA to further enhance the solution quality, named BCCFPA. Moreover, different kinds of features are extracted by various wavelet basis functions based wavelet packet energy spectrum (wpes) and wavelet packet energy entropy (wpee) methods. The original feature set is built by combining these feature vectors. BCCFPA is used to simultaneously search the optimal feature subset and SVM parameters.
