The simulation experimental results prove that BCCFPA can effectively balance the diagnosis accuracy and the dimension of feature subset, and achieves the better diagnosis performance when compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Measurement of Capacitance Current of Neutral Point Non - grounding System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The fault of medium and low voltage distribution network is mostly single-phase grounding fault. This kind of system is often run by neutral ungrounded system. When the capacitance current is too large, it is easy to produce arc light overvoltage, which leads to the further expansion of fault. At present, Direct measurement, estimation and PT triangulation are used to measure the capacitance current, but the test process is complicated and the results are not accurate. This paper introduces the capacitance current measurement method based on the neutral point of the capacitor. Compared with the traditional method, this method is more simple and accurate.

articleTitle: Kinematics Ayalysis for a Heavy-load Redundant Manipulator Arm Based on Gradient Projection Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Inverse kinematics is quite an important issue for redundant manipulator arms. This paper presents the kinematics analysis including forward kinematics and inverse kinematics for a large-scale heavy-load redundant manipulator arm. Firstly, the overview of the heavy-load redundant manipulator arm which is developed for a multi-purpose remote maintenance system for tokamak is introduced. After that, the forward kinematics of the manipulator arm is analyzed using D-H method, and simulated in Matlab. Finally, the inverse kinematics of the manipulator arm is investigated by combining the gradient projection method and obstacle avoidance optimization in order to solve the redundancy of the manipulator arm. The work in this paper is the basis for path planning of redundant manipulator arms.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling of Energy Storage System Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the power system, the power load of users will show a large gap between peak and valley, which may leads to the imbalance between supply and demand of power system. In this paper, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize the battery energy storage system to reduce the impact of peak load on the power grid, and help the power grid to smooth the power load fluctuation, and reduce the cost of the users.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Band-Stop Filter Design Based on Single Defected Microstrip Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel curved line shape defected microstip structure (DMS) is proposed. The resonant frequencies of the proposed curved line shape DMS is simulated by using HFSS and can be adjusted by changing the length a. A miniaturized dual-band band-stop filter is presented by using the cascade structure of the proposed curved line shape DMSs. The total circuit is small. The simulation results of the proposed band-stop filter are obtained through HFSS. There are three reflection zeros located at about 4.08 GHz, 5.26GHz and 6.2 GHz, which can improve the band-stop filter's sharp rejection. The measurement results are consistent with simulation ones.

articleTitle: The Research on IOT Security Architecture and Its Key Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of scientific information technology, the emergence of the Internet of Things (IOT) promoted the information industry once again to a new stage of economic and technological development. From the perspective of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information security, this paper analyzed the current state of the IOT and the security threats, and then researched the security primary technologies of the IOT security architecture. IOT security architecture established the foundation for a reliable information security system for the IOT.

articleTitle: The research on customer classification of B2C platform based on k-means algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Unlike the traditional customer relationship management, e-commerce can not only retain transaction data, but also collect other customer information, such as browsing data, comments, and preferences. In order to solve the problem of B2C e-commerce customer classification, K-means algorithm was selected as the clustering classification method, and an improved RFM value model was proposed to add indicators that meet the e-commerce domain characteristics. The customer group in the B2C environment is well classified.

articleTitle: Light Propagation Prediction through Multimode Optical Fibers with a Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This work demonstrates a computational method for predicting the light propagation through a single multimode fiber using a deep neural network. The experiment for gathering training and testing data is performed with a digital micro-mirror device that enables the spatial light modulation. The modulated patterns on the device and the captured intensity-only images by the camera form the aligned data pairs. This sufficiently-trained deep neural network frame has very excellent performance for directly inferring the intensity-only output delivered though a multimode fiber. The model is validated by three standards: the mean squared error (MSE), the correlation coefficient (corr) and the structural similarity index (SSIM).

articleTitle: Research on Six Degrees of Freedom Magnetic Positioning Method Based on Homotopy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Electromagnetic positioning technology based on excitation coils can achieve rapid and high precision positioning in a short distance area. However, the efficiency and accuracy are low in a long distance area. In order to improve the efficiency of the long distance magnetic positioning, a magnetic positioning method based on homotopy algorithm is proposed. Three orthogonal coils are excited separately to generate the magnetic field, and a three-axis fluxgate sensor is mounted on the target object to measure the magnetic field. Then the homotopy algorithm is chosen to solve the nonlinear equations of the magnetic field. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by experiments. The algorithm runs no more than 1 second at a time and the maximum positioning error does not exceed 0.5 meters within four meters.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis Model of Power Customer Satisfaction Based on ANP
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Customer satisfaction which reflects the matching degree between customer expectation and experience, is an important index to evaluate the quality of customer service. In this paper, a multi-layer evaluation system based on RATER index is constructed by using the network Analytic Network Process (ANP), and a big data analysis model of customer satisfaction based on business data is proposed. The model is input with the actual business data. Real-time analysis of customer satisfaction can be achieved, and it can be used as an algorithm model to support the process of big data analysis. This model overcomes the problem that the modeling method is relatively simple in customer satisfaction evaluation. And it solves the problem that the original data usually comes from the questionnaire that can not reflect the change of customer satisfaction in real time. The practical example verifies the practicability and effectiveness of the proposed model in the evaluation of electric power service satisfaction.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Optimization of Distribution Network on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An improved genetic algorithm is presented for solving the problem of slow convergence speed and premature phenomenon using traditional genetic algorithm in this paper. Combined with the characteristics of reactive power optimization of power system, binary code, initial population, crossover, mutation and fitness function had been improved by the proposed algorithm. The property and accuracy with the IEEE14 and IEEE30 bus system are tested, the results show that the model and algorithm avoid effectively premature phenomenon and reduce the active power loss in the evolution.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimal Scheduling of a Hybrid Wind-Solar-Pumped Storage Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to stabilize the randomness, fluctuation, anti-peaking and intermittency of wind power and Photovoltaic power, a hybrid wind-solar-pumped storage power generation system is built, and it is added with the prediction of sudden output changes by wind and solar. The maximized economic benefit of the hybrid system is as the objective function. According to the characteristics of premature convergence and slow convergence of particle swarm optimization (PSO), an immune PSO (immune Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm is proposed, which dynamically adjusts the learning factors and inertia weight simultaneously. The algorithm performs asymmetric linear dynamic adjustment of the learning factors and inertial weight to enhance the global search ability in the early stage and the local search ability in the later stage, so that the global optimal solution can be obtained quickly. Finally, the validity of the model and the feasibility of the algorithm are verified by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Vortex Induced Vibration Analysis of 500kV Single-Core Optical Fiber Composed Submarine Power Cable Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Under the action of wave force, the vortex induced vibration will exist in submarine power cable exposed in the sea flow. In order to understand its change rule and master its working condition, the dynamic finite element model of a 500kV single-core fiber composed submarine power cable is established. The simulation calculation is carried out under the condition of 0.lm wave height, 1s cycle and Irn/s sea flow velocity. The spatial and temporal data of displacement, stress and strain along copper conductor, optical fiber unit and copper wire armor are obtained. The acceleration amplitude frequency curve of the optical fiber unit is calculated and drawn. It is found that the submarine power cables are vibrating at all layers under sea flow. The vibration energy of the optical unit is mainly concentrated in 3Hz, 11Hz and 30Hz. It can provide theoretical support for the realization of submarine power cable vortex induced vibration monitoring by using distributed optical fiber vibration sensing technology.

articleTitle: Load ratio optimization of Urban Power Grid Considering penetration of electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, with the transformation of energy use forms and the promotion of national policies, a large number of new loads, represented by electric vehicles, have gradually infiltrated into the urban power grid, which has brought a certain impact on the operation of the power grid, and the traditional grid planning lacks the adaptability to the impact of the scale of the electric vehicle load. Therefore, according to the load characteristics and the current development trend of electric vehicle, this paper analyzes its influence on the load capacity ratio of electric network. In addition, a kind of capacity load ratio optimization model which considers the overall economy of different voltage grades is put forward, and the influence of different electric vehicle permeability on the value of load ratio and transformer type selection is analyzed, thus the level of power grid planning is improved and the electric vehicle access demand is satisfied better.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic Feature Detection and Radius Calculation of Underground Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A method of automatic recognition and extraction of echo image of underground pipeline is provided. In this method, the edges of hyperbolic features are extracted by adaptive thresholding method, and the least squares fitting method is applied to the lower edge feature points to obtain the hyperbolic curve fitting formula. Finally, by calculating hyperbolic wave velocity and fitting hyperbolic formulas, we get the information of the location and radius of underground pipeline. Based on gprMax software with finite difference time-domain method, the underground pipelines with different radii are simulated to obtain the results of forward image. The proposed method is used to obtain the location and radius information of underground pipeline. The results show that the proposed method has high precision for the horizontal position and depth measurement of underground pipelines with different radii. And the method has high accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Eliminating Abnormal Big Data based on PSO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve detection rate and reduce missing detection rate and false detection rate of big data, an abnormal large data elimination method based on PSO-SVM is proposed. Big data is chosen as a set, proximity of which is measured, according to fuzzy sets in fuzzy theory to measure data' similarity degree. In order to determine redundant data and judge whether big data is abnormal, using support vector machine to train each particle and get fitness function through measuring the proximity between data by a constructed function, and then eliminating abnormal big data through the sliding window. Taking KDD99 big data as object, simulation experiment has higher detection rate and low false detection rate based on PSO-SVM method.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Subway BAS Intrusion Detection Expert System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The information security of urban rail transit system faces great challenges. As a subsystem of the subway, BAS is short for Building Automation System, which is used to monitor and manage subway equipment and environment, also facing the same problem. Based on the characteristics of BAS, this paper designed a targeted intrusion detection expert system. This paper focuses on the design of knowledge base and the inference engine of intrusion detection system based on expert system. This study laid the foundation for the research on information security of the entire rail transit system.

articleTitle: The Rearch of Pseudo-Random Signal Generator Based On FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of modern communication technology, often need pseudo-random signal to test the communication system. Through the studying of the generation principle of m pseudo-random sequence, taking 4-level pseudorandom signal as an example, this article proposes a method for generating pseudo-random signals based on FPGA, which can be online tested and has good transplantation. The method applies sampling theorem and shifting additivity of m sequence. This article gives the corresponding verilog HDL code for the producer of m sequence, uses quartus to generate RTL circuit, writes simulation code with verilog, simulates the circuit with modelsim. The experimental results show that the method of generating pseude-random signal introduced by this article is simple in structure, high reliability and easy to implement.

articleTitle: Content-Based Image Retrieval System Via Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Faced with the huge image data in the context of big data era, how to effectively manage, describe, and retrieve them has become a hotspot issue in academic circles. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end image retrieval system based on deep convolutional neural network and differential learning method. We first build an image matching dataset based on the gravitational field model, that is to add a similarity score label for each image in the dataset production stage. Then we train the improved deep learning model and verify the effectiveness of the algorithm on three common image matching dataset (i.e., Caltech-101, Holidays and Oxford Paris). Finally, the experimental results show that our improved deep learning model with differential learning method that used for image retrieval system has state-of-the-art image matching performance. The overall retrieval accuracy in Caltech-101, Holidays and Oxford Paris datasets are 88.5%, 94.1 % and 96.2%, respectively. As the number of returned images increases, the image retrieval accuracy of the system decreases slightly and eventually becomes stable at a high value. And the differential learning based retrieval method is superior to many traditional algorithms in terms of image matching accuracy and single image processing speed.

articleTitle: Prediction Model for Ship Traffic Flow Considering Periodic Fluctuation Factors
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve prediction accuracy of ship traffic flow, an improved linear growth model is developed to predict ship traffic flow, by taking into all periodic fluctuation factors, such as seasonal changes, climate impact, and so on, then the Bayesian estimation and prediction are used to solve the new model, and ship traffic flow is predicted using the historical data of ship traffic flow. A case is carried out to compare the prediction effect of the models, and results show that, compared with the linear growth model, the prediction results with the improved model are more in line with the actual situation of ship traffic flow; besides, the mean absolute error of monthly ship flow decrease 3.56%, and the standard deviation decrease 3.79<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. Therefore, it is effective to predict ship traffic flow.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Taylor Network Optimal Control in Plane Symmetrical Cruise Missile Flight for Attacking Static Targets
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The performance of cruise missile depends largely on its guidance and control system. Therefore, it is essential to study the guidance and control system of cruise missile so as to promote operational effectiveness of cruise missile. In this paper, a guidance and control system of plane symmetrical cruise missile is designed for attacking static targets. A novel method named MTN (multi-dimensional Taylor network) is introduced and the controller is designed based on MTN optimal control not requiring controlled object models. Finally, full channels simulations considering coupling among the channels are conducted to test the performance of MTN optimal controller compared to optimal PID and SMC (sliding mode control needing the precise missile mechanism model) controllers. The results show that system with MTN optimal controller has the highest hit accuracy and shortest strike time, which validates the effectiveness of MTN optimal controller.

articleTitle: An optimal control method for parallel variable speed hydraulic pumps used in High Magnetic Field Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper concentrates on a control method for the prediction of variable speed pumps working in parallel to keep them running close to the best efficiency point (BEP). First, theoretical models of parallel variable-frequency hydraulic pump characteristics were established. Then, we proposed an optimized control method that could perform on-line decision-making for the operating number and switch point of hydraulic pumps based on calculation and comparison of pump efficiency through continually monitoring parameters of parallel hydraulic pumps. The proposed method was applied to a water cooling system designed for steady high magnetic field facility with four high-pressure pumps that used differential pressure set point control strategy. The actual application of the proposed method demonstrates its superior performance over the original method by saving considerable power consumption while achieving the same task of high-purity water cooling circulation. The method is universal and simple for on-line implementation, which is suitable for parallel pumps in a variable flow system.

articleTitle: Power Factor Control Using Boost Type Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: AC-DC power factor correction (PFC) single-stage converters both PFC and power conversion are done at the same time using a single converter that regulates the output. While using Switch Mode Converters (SMRs) for conversion from AC to DC, it enhances harmonics of the fundamental frequency at the input source thus increases the total Harmonic Distortion (THD) at the input. In this situation, we lose more power than required for a specific Load. So we need to design such a control system for this converter which could help us reduce the THD at input. I have tried to simulate boost type power factor converter circuit in order to improve the input. Here I have applied average current mode control because of many advantages over other techniques such as high noise immunity and stable operation. Firstly I have simulated only single bridge rectifier without any converter to see the result and THD at input and then I have applied open loop converter with single bridge rectifier to see how it affects the input THD and finally I have applied a converter with current and voltage control loops so that to improve the input THD. A step change at Load end is applied and the result is displayed so that to show the response of the system to be stable.

articleTitle: Delay Analysis of Wireless Body Sensor Network Based on Congestion Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of biosensors and wireless technology, the early wearable medical devices have been far from meeting the demands of human, and the mobile medical care has recently gained the increasing attention. The wireless body sensor network (WBSN) has made a significant contribution to the non-invasive collection of human physiological signals. This paper aims at the collection of four vital signs of the human body in WBSN, different priorities are given to four vital signs and the queuing model of different priority data that collected at patient's wireless device (named PDA) is analyzed. Meanwhile, this paper notices that the problem of network congestion in WBSN, the network environment of data transmission is divided by the learning results from mote using learning automata. In order to control network congestion, dropping packets of PDA is guided by mote under different network environment and the system delay after dropping packets at PDA is analyzed. Results in this paper show that “learning” at mote can significantly reduce system delay.

articleTitle: A novel grid-based bidirectional local search algorithm for many-objective optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The balance between the convergence and diversity is the most important mission in evolutionary multiobjective optimization (EMO). Many studies pay attention to the convergence but neglect the diversity maintenance. In order to accomplish these two goals simultaneously, the proposed grid-based bidirectional local search algorithm (GrBLS) is capable of finding a set of solutions which have better convergence to the real Pareto optimal front as well as better distribution. The GrBLS uses grid-based framework to select the better individual in evolution generation. Through the different punishment degree in environmental selection process, the best solutions can be gotten from the previous population. Three state-of-the-art EMO algorithms are chosen to compare with GrBLS method by employing four classical performance indicators. The experimental results show that GrBLS method is able to obtain better spread of solutions and better convergence than the others algorithms. The results indicate that the excellent performance of the GrBLS method is suitable for handling multiobjective optimization problems.

articleTitle: Research on Live Working Robot Based on Weak Rigid Master-slave Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper studies the live working robots with weak rigid and large delay master-slave control algorithms, including the overall design, the study of mobile insulation platforms suitable for the field complex working conditions, the research of small working space robots working platforms, and the large delay based on weak rigidity, the man-machine operation interactive control strategy research, test verification, conclusions and other components. The mobile insulation platform adopts crawler-type walking mechanism and can be applied to most farmland or rugged roads, with one-button automatic leveling of the outriggers. The small working space robot operation platform can satisfy various working space environments. We research the weak rigid large-scale man-machine operation interactive control strategy to solve the long-delay teleoperation problem, and complete live tasks such as disconnecting and diverting lines, removing branches, and removing foreign materials.

articleTitle: An Error Correction Method for Code Cable Displacement Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To improve the precision of a multi-sensor composite piecewise displacement monitoring scheme whose background is the long stroke, high speed and heavy load operation condition of super deep mine hoist, analyzing the error reason of code cable displacement sensor, and aiming at the accumulated error and sawtooth error caused by vertical placement of code cable, an error correction method for code cable displacement sensor is proposed. The code cable displacement sensor is calibrated in sections by drawstring sensor respectively, and the error is corrected by looking-up table method. The results show that this method can effectively eliminate the accumulated error and sawtooth error of the code cable displacement sensor. When it is corrected., the error is kept within 15mm, which improves the measurement accuracy and system reliability of the coded cable displacement sensor, and further improves the container's accurate parking and safe operation.

articleTitle: Methods of differential fault attack on LBlock with analysis of probability
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new method of differential fault attack was proposed, which is based on the nibble-group differential diffusion property of the lightweight block cipher LBlock. Theoretical proof and experimental results both show that six fault injections in last three rounds are needed to recover the main key. On the basis of the statistical regularity of the S-box differential distribution, the probability of recovering round key was calculated. Then the expectation of number of fault injections when recovering main key K can be estimated, which is 8.35. Finally, experimental data verifies the correctness of the theoretical model.

articleTitle: Speaker Recognition based on Multimodal LSTM using Depth-Gate
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to effectively fuse the audio and visual features in the Speaker Recognition task, a Multimodal Long Short-Term Memory network with Depth-Gate is proposed. First, a multi-layer LSTM model is established for each type of individual feature, and the Depth-Gate is used to connect the memory cells between adjacent layers to enhance the correlation between the upper layer and lower layer, and improve the classification performance of the feature. At the same time, the correlation between models at each layer can be learned by sharing the weights which connect the output of hidden layer and each gate unit in different models. The experimental results show that this method can effectively fuse the audio features and visual features, and improves the Speaker Recognition rates. Moreover, this model is robust to distractors.

articleTitle: Investigations on A New Syntihetic Test of DC Vacuum Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Synthetic test is the conventional method which testing performance and reliability of circuit breaker. HVDC circuit breaker with rapid fault clearing is an important equipment for protecting DC transmission system. Vacuum circuit breaker based on commutation principle has the low resistance loss and good insulation performance, which can break DC short-circuit current. The equivalence of AC synthetic test can test AC circuit breaker breaking performance. However, the rapid development of DC circuit breaker is limited by the equivalent of synthetic experiment. This paper analyzed the breaking process of DC circuit breaker, refered to the basic principle of AC synthetic test and parameters analysis, present and simulate a new synthetic test circuit topology of DC circuit breaker, a transient recovery voltage add into the conventional DC breaking synthesis test circuit, make up for the opening final relay overvoltage is equivalent to the overvoltage of DC short-circuit break system. Theoretical analysis of synthetic experiment process and comparative the equivalent relationship parameters. Transient recovery voltage equivalent methods to further improve the effectiveness of the synthetic test, provide support for the breaking ability of DC circuit breaker test.

articleTitle: Aero-Engine Guide Vane Angle Regulator Iterative Learning Control Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aero-engine guide vane angle regulator digital electronic control system performance and reliability of the engine's normal work is very important. In order to obtain optimum engine performance, improve flight reliability, and to ensure the stability of the compressor work is proposed based on iterative learning PID controller, the algorithm uses iterative learning control for desired trajectory tracking control. The aero-engine guide vane control system model is created under AMESim software and the iterative learning controller model is builded in Matlab/Simulink. Simulation results show that the designed controller can achieve the guide vane angle actuator displacement regulator of rapid, accurate track, indicating that the controller design method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband High Gain Planar Spiral Antenna Design Based on Satellite Navigation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a wideband high gain planar spiral antenna, it can work in all the frequency points of four global satellite navigation systems(GPS, GLONASS, BEIDOU, GALILEO), which improves the compatibility between the navigation and positioning accuracy. Through the design of antenna radiation structure and metal reflection cavity structure, the bandwidth of antenna is effectively enlarged, and the circular polarization radiation performance of antenna at low frequency is greatly improved. In addition, the miniaturization of antenna profile height is realized by modifying the structure of the exponential feeding baron. The test results show that in the elevation 90°, the right-hand circularly polarized normal gain of the antenna in the frequency band from 1.1 to 2.7 GHz is greater than 5 dBi, the elevation angle 60° gain is greater than 2.3 dBi, the VSWR is less than 2.0, and the axial ratio is less than 3 dB, whice indicates that the antenna has excellent broadband circular polarization radiation performance and engineering application prospects.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Detection Network based on Improved Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the disadvantages of low quality and slow calculation speed in the current establishment of multi-sensor detection network algorithms, this paper introduces an improved bat algorithm to solve the optimal solution of the detection network. The basic bat algorithm was improved by K-means algorithm initialization, speed update using adaptive step size, reverse direction search and mutation operation, and an improved bat algorithm was obtained. Simulation experiments show that the improved algorithm has significantly improved the speed of calculation and optimization. In addition, by comparing the improved bat algorithm with the particle swarm optimization algorithm and bee colony algorithm, it is proved that the proposed algorithm is of higher quality and easier to solve. Get the optimal solution of the probe network.

articleTitle: Large-scale machinery monitoring system based on the visual reality
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As the key equipment in port machinery, Large-scale machinery's (like gantry crane) safe and reliable operation will significantly influence on the safety operation of production. However, the limitations of traditional sensor, the diversity of failure and the complexity of expert knowledge used for mechanical fault diagnosis bring big challenges to online health monitoring and fault diagnosis of gantry crane. Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) sensors have been successfully applied to the online health monitoring of larger-scale structures including bridges, dams, petrochemical equipment, etc. This paper implements the online health monitoring of gantry crane by employing FGB sensors to collect strain data of the key points in the steel structure of gantry crane. We have achieved the online monitoring the gantry crane under a virtual reality environment on the platform of Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF). Moreover, we have developed virtual reality system to study the establishing of 3D modeling and the dynamic monitoring of equipment. According the needs of users, this system could determine the health status of gantry cranes and foresee the security risks existing in the steel structures by stress analysis. In this way, the blind maintenance work can be reduced and the advanced predictive maintenance can combine with the technology of virtual reality to present a better monitoring result.

articleTitle: Investigations on Electromagnetic Operating Mechanism of DC Vacuum Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Breaking capacity of DC circuit breaker is one of the important technical indicator, breaking performance of operating mechanism restricting its development. DC vacuum circuit breaker based on the principle of force zero-cross in electric power system, short-circuit current can be effectively breaking circuit. Mult- breakers in series with excellent insulating capacity of short vacuum gap improve the ability to withstand voltage insulation. Therefore, short stroke and fast opening of operating mechanisms are need to design and research. Electromagnetic repulsion operating mechanism mainly includes repulsion opening part, permanent magnetic closing part, overtravel spring holding part and capacitor charging and discharging driving part. Through the modeling and simulation of electromagnetic field of electromagnetic repulsion operator, analysis the capacitor discharge current, Multi-function press machine and mechanical characteristic analyzer tester are used to test electromagnetic repulsion operator movement characteristics with stress and displacement. Test measured operating mechanism analysis the movement characteristics in different drive capacitance voltage, analysis movement speed and mechanical bounce in the security and whole clearance between break contact, which test data can satisfy the application of DC circuit breaker with rapid and reliablity.

articleTitle: Mechanical fault diagnosis method for OLTC based on MPE and K-means++ algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: On-load tap-changer (OLTC) is easy to fail because of the frequency switching operation. The vibration signals produced by the operation process show obvious nonlinear characteristics, but most of the existing methods of extracting OLTC running feature are based on the linear theory, and there are some limitations. In order to realize the mechanical fault diagnosis of OLTC under the nonlinear vibration signal, a kind of OLTC mechanical fault diagnosis method based on the multiscale permutation entropy (MPE) nonlinear analysis method is proposed. Firstly, the vibration signals are collected in the different mechanical faults of the OLTC in the laboratory. Secondly, the Cao's method is used to determine the MPE parameters and the MPE characteristic of the mechanical failure state of the OLTC is extracted. Finally, the K-means++ algorithm is used to identify the mechanical state of the OLTC and compares it with the clustering effect of the traditional K-means algorithm. The results show that Mechanical fault diagnosis method for OLTC based on MPE and K-means++ algorithm can effectively extract the mechanical fault characteristics of OLTC, and can correctly identify the OLTC mechanical fault, and its diagnosis effect is better than the traditional K-means algorithm, and the stability is high.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Ratio of Hydropower Unit Capacity on the Stability of Primary Frequency Regulation of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In actual work, the hydro generating units connected to the grid to meet the requirements of primary frequency regulation speed, often adjust the governor parameters bt and Td smaller to improve the speed performance, which makes the stability of the unit unable to be guaranteed. When the capacity of the hydroelectric generating unit is relatively small in the system, the system will not generally have any stability problems. However, when the capacity is relatively large, it may cause instability of the whole system. In order to study this problem, this paper established hydropower and thermal power unit interconnection model, draw the stability domain of the system when the hydropower units take different capacity proportion, and analyze the existence of control parameters (bt,Td) that satisfy the primary frequency regulation speed index, The calculation results show that there is no control parameter (bt,Td) in the stability domain that meets the primary frequency regulation speed index when the capacity of hydropower unit in the system exceeds 84.35%, which neither satisfy speed nor stability at the same time.

articleTitle: Analysis of Complaints in Power Services based on Grey Relational Analysis and Boston Matrix
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Reducing customer complaints is of great significance to the power companies on improving their own power services and enhancing their competitiveness in the consumer-oriented electricity market. Based on the data of the 95598 customer service center of a provincial power company in recent years, this paper uses grey relational analysis to calculate the grey sequence between each problem and the complaint, and obtains the relation between the complaint and the influencing factors from the angle of quantitative analysis. This paper constructs a complaint analysis model combined with Boston matrix and gives specific application examples. It is of great significance on reducing the incidence and effective prevention of power customer complaints by using data mining technology to explore the causes of customer complaints and propose corresponding solutions.

articleTitle: Research on Black Hat SEO Behaviour Measurement
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to quickly improve the ranking, black hat SEO came into being. Its necessary to investigate black hat SEO. The research is mainly divided into three functional modules: pre-filtering, page classification and content extraction module. We improve the edit distance algorithm to obtain black hat SEO URLs, and then new black hat SEO pages are discovered and detected, such as multi port, multi IP, static parasite and dynamic parasite. We provide an improved TF-IDF algorithm to extract tweaked black words from black hat web pages. After several rounds of expansion, 31257 contact information, 115845 black words and 588941 black hat SEO URLs were obtained. Finally, the contact information and domain distribution were measured.

articleTitle: Operation Expenditure Forecasting Model of Regional Power Grid Based on LS-SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The principle of “regulatory cost and reasonable returns” for transmission and distribution price has changed the profit model of the power grid enterprise, which puts forward a austere challenge on the operational management level and operation expenditure. The current operation expenditure management of power grid enterprise is relatively extensive. The operation expenditure is usually calculated by the asset scale and the empirically estimated proportional coefficient. This kind of management model has been unable to adapt to the new grid cost supervision environment. So, enhancing the forecasting accuracy of operation expenditure has become an urgent problem for power grid. Based on the analysis of the interaction of operation expenditure with multi-factors such as total electricity consumption, GDP, power consumption structure, effective asset value, variable capacity, and line length, operation expenditure forecasting model of regional power grid Based on LS-SVM algorithm is built in this paper. Finally, the operating data of a district power distribution company is selected as a sample to predict the operation expenditure in the future, which verifies the validity of the prediction model.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control of Interconnected Power System with Wind Power Based on Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Load frequency control is an important means to make interconnected power grid frequency and tie line power operate safely and steadily according to planned values. However, the research object of load frequency control is not only the traditional water and fire power system, but the new interconnected power system which is jointly involved by wind power and water and fire power units because Large-scale wind power is integrated into the power grid. The traditional load frequency control uses PI control, but for the volatility and randomness of the wind power, the effect of PI control on inhibition of disturbance is not obvious, easy to cause the frequency range and tie line power is limited. Therefore, this paper applies the two order active disturbance rejection control to the interconnected power grid with wind power, and analyses the advantages of PI control compared with disturbance rejection control when two conditions of fixed wind speed and wind speed fluctuation. It is concluded that active disturbance rejection control can quickly track the area control error of the system, and greatly reduce the effects of load disturbance and wind power fluctuation on the power grid frequency.

articleTitle: Combined Operation System of SVG and APF Parallel Bus under Unbalanced Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of excessive volume and system loss of parallel hybrid APF and reactive power compensation device under unbalanced grid, A kind of SVG and APF and DC bus joint operation system which can compensate reactive power, compensate grid imbalance and filter out the harmonic current of power grid under unbalanced power grid are proposed. In this system, the SVG is used to compensate reactive power and grid imbalance quickly, and APF compensates the specific harmonic of power grid and SVG. By reducing the volume of the capacitor through the DC bus, the total volume of the system is reduced; reducing the switching frequency of the SVG reduces system losses. On the basis of the analysis of the basic working principle of SVG and APF, the control method of the joint system is studied, and the feasibility of the combined system is verified by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Transmission Security Platform for Transportation Information based on BeiDou Navigation Satellite System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Applications of BeiDou Navigation system are in highly developing. However, the urgent insufficient security of navigation data causes it easily stolen and tampered in vehicle transport systems. An information encryption transmission based on PKI technology is a crucial tendency. In this paper, we analyze the feasibility of PKI applications for satellite navigation based transportation system and propose a model of secure information transmission platform (SITP). We also give a PKI key generation method and design a systematic scheme of a network and software system.

articleTitle: Estimation of primitive polynomial for m-sequence with finite sequence length
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a method of estimation of the primitive polynomial for m sequence is presented in radar systems under the condition that the received sequence length is limited. By using the iteration relation of shift register, a group of linear equations are constructed and the solution represents the coefficients of primitive polynomial. Simulations illustrated that the proposed method can applied in the scenario of short received sequence, and has better performance even there are errors in the received sequence.

articleTitle: Research on Load Balancing Method in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development and application of computer technology, cloud computing as a new computing model has become a hot topic in academic research. How to effectively use cluster resources and improve the overall performance of the system have become hot topics and problems in the field of cloud computing. And a reasonable method of load balance is an effective way to solve this problem. Based on the deep study of Shuffled Frog Leading Algorithm, this paper proposes a method of load balance based on improved Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm (ISFLA) in cloud computing. Finally, a simulation experiment of the load balance based on improved Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm was performed on CloudSim, a simulation platform for cloud computing. Through comparing with the experimental results of other intelligent optimization algorithms, it was found that ISFLA has a better load balance effect and it is feasible.

articleTitle: An Active Voltage Controller of SiC MOSFET for Reduced EMI Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: SiC (Silicon carbide) MOSFETs have significant performance improvements over Si devices. However, the high switching speeds caused sudden changes in current or voltage will generate high-frequency electromagnetic interference (EMI), which is considered to be a major source of interference for power converters. By shaping the switching transient into a Gaussian “S-shape”, EMI generation can be greatly suppressed. The active voltage control (AVC) has proved to be particularly effective in controlling high power IGBT's switching transient. However, a gate driver suitable for SiC MOSFET to force its switching transient to follow a pre-defined S-shape reference has not yet been proposed. In this paper, the AVC system for SiC MOSFETs are successfully designed, and the switching dynamic characteristics of SiC MOSFETs are defined with a smooth Gaussian waveform. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control system and the suppression effect of EMI are verified through simulations.

articleTitle: Benchmarking Deepsat Dataset with a Simple Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Image classification is very crucial for the information extraction and with the availability of high resolution and abundant data, traditional classifiers are not enough for such datasets. The solution is provided by Deep learning theory which allows for automated feature extraction method with an improved accuracy. Deep learning is a subset of machine learning and it has blossomed over the last decade because of its feature learning capability and its ability to generalize over unseen dataset. These techniques have been proven suitable in many fields such as biomedical, audio and video recognition, hand writing recognition and now it is also being used for the classification of aerial and satellite imagery. A simple Convolutional Neural Network is used for DeepSat dataset which gave overall accuracy of 99.97% for SAT-4, 99.98% for SAT-6. The results are at par and even surpassed some of the previous studies. Performance evaluation shows that the learning rate of 0.1 and batch size 250 provides with the best results for both SAT-6 and SAT-4. For a developing country like Pakistan, there is a dire need for a dataset similar to DeepSat which can then be used for various applications.

articleTitle: WSNs Node Localization Algorithm Based on Mobile Robot Assistance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Targeting node positioning of Wireless Sensor Networks(WSNs), a mobile-robots aided node positioning method is proposed. With strong calculation and motility of robots, and the transition from a traditional node-to-node communication and measurement to robot-node and node-node positioning, finally the mobile positioning is achieved. Taking the assistance of mobile robots and non-ideal Gaussian allocation noise caused by it into consideration, a modified Gaussian mixture Cubature Kalman Filter(GM-CKF) is put into practice and is used in the mixed node positioning model of mobile robots and wireless sensor network. The simulation result suggests that what we propose a co-operational positioning method of mobile robots and WSNs makes position estimation possible, and GM-CKF effectively increase the accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Defect Detection of PM Fibers Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Polarization-maintaining fiber is widely used in fiber optic gyro sensors. However, in the production process of the fiber coil, it is difficult to manually address the defect detection of polarization-maintaining fiber. Recognition of tiny cracks on the fiber with the diameter of 135 or 165 microns is a complex issue. In this paper, a method of defect detection used in splitting fiber process is proposed. First, it verified the more suitable algorithm of feature extraction for PM fibers through experiments. Next, Gabor filtering is used to extract features of minor defects. The united features which are composed of the HOG features of original image and the uniform LBP features of processed image are extracted. Finally, genetic algorithm is applied to optimize the parameters of SVM, and the optimized SVM with united features achieve PM fiber defect detection. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method can effectively identify defects on the surface of the PM fiber. The recognition rate for tiny defects reaches over 90%, and the recognition rate for serious defects reaches 99%.

articleTitle: A Fast Fusion Method for Multi-exposure Image in YUV Color Space
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Using multiple exposures fusion to obtain high dynamic images of very large dynamic scenes, the traditional multi-resolution fusion method based on RGB color space has some shortcomings, such as low efficiency and color shift. In this paper, a method of multi-exposure fusion in YUV color space is proposed. The multi-resolution fusion based on Laplacian pyramid is carried out on Y channel, and the contrast factor and color degree factor are introduced to construct the weight map of the fusion. The maximum value of UV channel is taken to avoid color weakening caused by weighted fusion of color components. Finally, an objective evaluation of the fusion algorithm is carried out through experiments. Compared with the multi-resolution fusion based on Laplacian pyramid in traditional RGB color space, the color obtained by this method is more abundant, and the fusion time is about one-third of the traditional method.

articleTitle: Application of UKF Alogrithm in Passive Localization and Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Depending on the information of DOA and TOA, passive location to a moving emitter can be realized by a fixed observer. In the location system, the state model is generally linear, but the measurement model is frequently nonlinear. With the help of extended Kalman filter (EKF), the state of the target can be estimated, and the track of it can be also traced. Unscented Kalman filter(UKF) is another method to solve the problem of nonlinear system. Deduction and simulation shows that, using EKF and UKF based on DOA and TOA information to locate and track the moving emitter, can be convergent with a high accuracy. Relatively, UKF is better than EKF.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Change Detection in Remote sensing Image Based on Image Fusion in Nonsubsampled Shearlet Transform Domain and fuzzy k-means clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the detection precision and shorten the detection time, a novel unsupervised change detection method based on image fusion in nonsubsampled shearlet transform(NSST)domain and fuzzy k-means clustering is proposed in this paper. Frost filter is used to reduce the noise of the experimental images. The proposed neighborhood ratio operator and the common log-ratio operator are used to obtain difference images. In order to utilize fully the complementary information of the neighborhood ratio and the ratio images to obtain a better difference image, a novel fusion strategy in NSST domain is proposed. Since there are still noise in the difference images, the image denoising method with adaptive Bayes threshold in the NSST domain is applied to the high frequency coefficients of the difference images to reduce the noise. And then the proposed fusion strategy is applied to the low frequency bands and the denoised high frequency bands for getting the fused difference image. The change detection map is obtained by clustering the fused difference images utilizing k-means algorithm into two disjoint classes: changed and unchanged. The experimental results clearly show that the proposed detection operator has better detection performance and shorter running time, compared with the other reported algorithms.

Author Keywords: Image fusion in nonsubsampled shearlet domain
Image denoising method with adaptive Bayes threshold

articleTitle: Blind Source Separation Based on Variational Bayesian Independent Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: While the traditional independent component analysis methods were used to separate speech signals, the inherent structural features of the speech signal and the interference of the noise in the hybrid system were not considered, since the observed signal and the known prior information were not fully utilized, the effect of the separation were not ideal. However, the advantages of ICA has been taken and the full use of the prior information of the hybrid system has been made in the algorithm of variational Bayesian independent component analysis (VBICA), the source signal under various noise conditions has been separated, the results indicated that the algorithm of VBICA was more advantageous than the traditional ICA algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition Method Based on EMG Signal and Design of Rehabilitation Training System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper studies a gesture recognition method based on the sensing of myoelectric signals, establishes a new type of myoelectric signal processing model, and completes the high-precision identification of several specific actions. We propose an assisted rehabilitation system based on this identification method, which can be used to assist therapists to easily supervise the training of patients with motor dysfunction. The system uses the wearable device's myoelectric signal sensing capabilities to capture the patient's exercise action, compare it to the correct motion model, quantify the amount of patient's training, share the patient's exercise data with the therapist to help them supervise the training progress in time.

articleTitle: Supervisory Control of On-load Tap-Changing Transformers in Xiamen Bipole VSC-HVDC Transmission Demonstration Project
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the framework of discrete-event systems, supervisory control of transformers in Xiamen bipole Voltage Source Converter based High Voltage Direct Current Transmission (VSC-HVDC) project is studied. An on-load tap-changing transformer is a typical discrete-event system, which its behavior is event-driven rather than time-driven and its states (the location of the tap) are discrete. In Xiamen bipole VSC-HVDC project, the on-load tap-changing transformer can be controlled either automatically or manually. For manually pattern, the operating are made by operator and do not need a controller. So, this paper discusses the automatically control pattern. This paper considers an on-load tap-changing transformer as a discrete-event system. The on-load tap-changing transformer and its specifications (control logics) are modeled as finite automata. By using TCT procedure, this paper synthesizes the supervisory controller (supervisor) and shown that the specifications are controllable and the closed loop system is nonblocking. Finally, we compare our supervisor with the controller in Xiamen bipole VSC-HVDC project. The comparison results show that the control logics of our supervisor are the same as the control logics of the controller in Xiamen bipole VSC-HVDC project.

articleTitle: Design of a Underactuated Robotic Hand with Three Articulated Fingers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An intelligent flexible hand with eight degrees of freedom is developed which reconfigures itself in real time to achieve a grasp with different shaped target objects. It has three articulated fingers, driven by four DC motors, which is a typical underactuated structure. Grasping action of each finger is independently controlled by a motor and the outer two symmetrical fingers centered on parallel joint axes around the entire palm can both be rotated synchronously 180 degrees by the fourth motor. The design of mechanical transmission, embedded development board, sensors and force sensor calibration are introduced in detail. All embedded development board, controller, sensors, motors and drivers are integrated inside the palm of the hand or on the surface of the fingers, which has the advantages of compact structure and easy operation. Use standard serial communication to send control commands, all valid commands are parsed in the controller, and the target objects can immediately be grasped. The research provides a design method for the underactuated robotic hand.

articleTitle: High- frequency Characteristics of Drain Current Noise of 40nm n-MOSFETs in Weak Inversion Region
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Bias non-conservation characteristics of high-frequency noise of 40nm n-MOSFETs are identified by measuring its drain current noise. Measurement results over a wide temperature range demonstrate the existence of thermal noise of 40nm n-MOSFETs in the weak and low middle inversion region, contrary to the predictions of suppressed shot noise model only suitable in the strong inversion and high middle inversion region. These new findings on the noise mechanisms of 40nm n-MOSFETs are very beneficial for its ultra low-voltage low-power RF application, such as noise analysis, circuit design and process technology evaluation.

articleTitle: Battery Equalization Circuit with Share Bus for Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, electric vehicles have become more and more popular. Lithium batteries are widely used in electric vehicles (EVs) because Lithium batteries have excellent performance. However, after several charge and discharge of a lithium battery, different monomers in series will have different performance. This paper proposes a equalization circuit based on the bidirectional DC-AC converter. The circuit topology of this paper has the advantages of high speed and high equalization efficiency, and it can transfer energy between non-adjacent batteries.

articleTitle: A Radar Target Tracking Method based on Coordinate Transformation KF
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the radar tracking data is converted from polar coordinates to Cartesian coordinates, the statistic characteristics of the observed noise are analyzed, the state and observation equation of radar tracking is established. The simulation effect shows that the Coordinate Transformation Kalman Filter converges faster and reduces the observed noise.

articleTitle: A T-S Fuzzy Model-Based Algorithm for Blood Glucose Control in Diabetic Patients
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with fuzzy model-based blood glucose control problem for diabetes patients. The glucose metabolism model used in this paper is expressed in the Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) form obtained by sector nonlinearity approach. Two different rates of basal exogenous insulin are considered to analysis and design T-S fuzzy controllers. It is shown that conditions for the solvability of the blood glucose controller design given here are written in the form of linear matrix inequality (LMI) which can be efficiently solved by convex optimization techniques. One simulation example is given to demonstrate the validity of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A network flow identification scheme based on Wavelet Transform and Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Because of the increasing number of untrusted flow identity problem, detecting correlated network flows is an important problem in the detection of stepping stone attacks as well as in compromising anonymity systems. More recent flow watermarking schemes can link flows, but are often impossible to achieve invisibility and robustness concurrently. In this paper, we propose an innovative connection correlation scheme based on Wavelet Transform and Chaos Theory capable of remaining invisibility to attackers. In our approach, the network traffic is divided into different bands of frequencies by wavelet decomposition. Then phase space reconstruction of low frequency signal and high frequency signal respectively, the average value of each row of the matrices are calculated, and the mean value sequences are obtained, Finally, the traffic characteristics are obtained by reconstructing using the wavelet, which will be used later to calculate similarity between sender and receiver based on Euclidean distance. Experimental results show that the scheme can resist packet insertions, network jitter and losses.

articleTitle: Design of GUI for Portable ECG monitoring system based on Qtopia Core
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The ECG monitor is an indispensable medical instrument for modern hospitals, communities and families. GUI development software Qtopia Core is used to design a human-friendly interface for ECG monitoring system with simple operation. This interface is integrated functions of gather, data process, show, analysis, storage, transmission, etc. Finally, the experiments verify the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Measurements of wave characteristics based on binocular vision and Zero-crossing method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The paper presented a new method to estimate wave parameters based on stereo (binocular) vision, such as wave heights and wave periods. Using binocular vision, wave transformation in near shore water can be measured in wave altitude. Stereo image pairs were acquired for 17 minutes and 2 seconds at interval of two times per second. The total measurement numbers are 2048 times. Wave vertical altitudes can be extracted from the datum according to binocular vision. By zero-crossing method, wave heights and wave periods can be estimated based on wave vertical altitudes. Experimental results have shown that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Moving Horizon Estimation and Attitude Optimization Algorithm for MEMS Gyroscope Array
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Silicon micro gyroscopes have been widely used in medium-low precision strap-down inertial navigation system (SINS). The output precision of silicon micro gyroscopes array can be improved by data fusion. Based on Kalman filtering for gyroscopes output, a Moving Horizon Estimation (MHE) algorithm was studied which made use of several former measurements. The optimized output estimation can be acquired by MHE. Based on single-sample rotation vector algorithm for SINS, an optimized three-sample attitude algorithm was designed. Experiments show that the noise variation after MHE with prediction horizon equaling 3 can be reduced to 2.1273s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>. Under conical motion condition, the optimized three-sample attitude algorithm can reduce the gyroscope drift effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Integrity Monitoring Method of Time-Frequency Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The stability and reliability of high-precision time-frequency signal is an important basis for modern navigation. In this paper, a signal integrity monitoring method has been studied to identify and monitor the performance and the integrity of signal, resolve the problem and provide the high-precision physical signal more stability and reliability. Based on the method, a high-precision time-frequency signal integrity monitoring system has been constructed using the UTC (NTSC) in National Time Service Center of Chinese Academy of Sciences. The system verifies the correctness and validity of the method which proposed. Moreover, the system based on this method is with strong stability and applicability, not only monitors longterm multi-channel signals, but also provides the foundation signal for other system.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization for the Main Dimension of Flywheel Motor Based on Torque Density
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The flywheel motor is one of the best ways to improve the power-to-weight ratio of the compression ignition heavy fuel aircraft piston engine (CIHFAPE). In this paper, the influence of stator split ratio, rotor split ratio, armature diameter and axial length on the torque density of flywheel motor is studied in detail. An optimization design method of flywheel motor based on torque density is proposed, which combined with analytical method and finite element method. The local optimum design is obtained by optimizing the stator split ratio and rotor split ratio, and the overall optimal design is obtained by optimized armature diameter and axial length. Under a limited conditions, the torque density of the flywheel motor designed by this method is 8.05N m / kg, and the rotational inertia is 0.11kg·m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The precision of the optimization design method is verified by FEM.

articleTitle: Optimal Energy-Efficient for OFDM-Based Cognitive Relay Networks with Sensing Errors
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the energy efficiency maximization problem in OFDM-based cognitive relay networks with incomplete spectrum sensing is investigated. Firstly, a secondary relay transmission system model is established where the interference limitation, the incompleteness of spectrum sensing, and the maximum transmit power are considered. The joint optimization energy efficient model of spectrum sensing and transmission problem is mixed-integer nonlinear programming problem in the NP problem, it is difficult to find the optimal solution directly. Therefore, the fractional programming is used to solve the problem to reduce the complexity of the algorithm by convex optimization. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Research of Special Instructions for Finite Field X Multiplications of Cryptographic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: High-performance and flexible finite field X multiplications special instructions targeted at cryptographic algorithms processing are proposed in this paper, in order to dispel the performance bottleneck of X multiplications realized by RISC and VLIW universal processors. Through analyzing the processing characteristics of X multiplications in different cryptographic algorithms, the proposed x<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup> multiplication instructions can support different processing data widths (8 bits, 16 bits, 32 bits, 64 bits, 128 bits), different k values (1~8), and instruction parallelism based on VLIW and operating several small data width at the same time are also designed with parallelism of 4, 2, 1 respectively. Furthermore, expanded X multiplication instructions are exploited to support the execution of each instruction forcefully too. The X multiplications special instructions designed can be used as ameliorative instructions for RISC and VLIW universal processors to advance the performance of cryptographic algorithms.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis for Tray Loader Machine of Power Battery Based on Fault Tree Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The fault diagnosis in the automated battery production process is not timely and inaccurate, which will bring huge economic losses to the manufacturing of the power battery. Tray loader section is not only a mechanical link but also an important process link for battery scale production, having a strong process beat requirements. Guaranteeing the correctness of the tray loader section can largely guarantee the correctness of the follow-up process of the automated production of power battery. But, the diagnostic efficiency is very low when the fault diagnosis method is applied to the loading section at this stage. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of the tray loader machine, this paper uses the fault tree analysis method to establish the fault tree model of the loading section. According to this model, a fault diagnosis system based on the fault tree is developed to automatically collect, automatic analysis and automatic diagnosis the data of the loading section. The system has the characteristics of fast diagnosis and high diagnostic accuracy, and can proposed effective solution.

articleTitle: A Strategy of Multipath Mitigation Based on Modified Double-Delta Phase Discriminator and TK
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Multipath interference is the most serious problem that causes GNSS receiver tracking error to be difficult to eliminate. In order to solve the problem of weak mitigation performance for short time delay multipath in traditional receiver, we construct a modified Double-Delta phase discriminator by adding a certain compensation factor in the traditional discriminator formula, which uses two sets of early-late correlators and a prompt correlator. In order to consider the general situation, we use the TK operator as detection module to construct a new multipath suppression strategy in combination with the modified Double-Delta phase discriminator, and put forward the implementation procedure of this algorithm. The results show that this strategy has a better mitigation performance to the short time in-phase delay multipath signals without affecting suppression performance to middle and long time delay multipath signals.

articleTitle: Foreground Dectection of Yaks of Deep Color Based on Gray Images
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Nowadays, foreground detection of digital images has been a heated topic in visual researches of computer graphics and has had great significance in a variety of areas in our society. Digital image foreground extraction is also called image cutout, the important part of computer image processing technology, is also the basis of graphic image processing algorithm. The foreground extraction of digital image refers to dividing an image into two parts of the scene region and the background region, and at the same time the foreground image is extracted form a new image. In this paper, yaks are extracted and displayed in yak images in the Three Rivers Source area of Qinghai province. Plenty of experiments show that the dark-colored yak foreground extraction algorithm in this paper has a good effect on yak foreground recognition. The results of this study can provide an algorithm basis for yak intelligent weight analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Method of Driver Distraction State Based on Mouth State
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Drivers' human factors have become one of the main factors in the occurrence of traffic accidents. Driver monitoring has become a research hotspot of current safe assisted driving technology, among which, mouth state recognition is one of the key technologies. Because the driver's degree of mouth opening in normal driving, talking and yawning has certain differences, according to this characteristic, this article uses the Fisher linear classifier to classify the mouth features, using BP neural network will be normal Driving, speaking and yawning are three different mental state outputs. And through the test results show that: the network can quickly and effectively identify the driver's mouth state.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparision of Influence Factors of Movie Box Office in China
