publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper selects thirteen indicators from three aspects to construct the index system of the factors affecting the box office of China movies. 645 movies with more than 10 million of the box office are used to analyze the importance of those influencing factors with the method of Correlation analysis and neural network. The results show that the most influential factors of movie box office are network attention and media attention, followed by film rewards, Internet word-of-mouth and IP influence.

articleTitle: Research on 12-pulse phase controlled rectifier for nuclear power generating stations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of nuclear power meets with china's strategy of green low-carbon energy, the DC operation power supply of nuclear power generating stations will be widely applied. In view of the demand for high-power, isolation and voltage regulated power supply and the harmonic pollution problem of 6-pulse phase controlled rectifier, a 12-pulse phase controlled rectifier charger suitable for nuclear power generating stations is proposed in combination with the advantages of the multiplex technology. The main circuit topology is presented, the working principle is elaborated, the key device parameters are designed, and 450kVA charger engineering prototype is developed. The experimental results that it can realize the power supply demand and show the effectiveness and feasibility of the design. It can provide some reference for the engineering application of nuclear power generating stations charger.

articleTitle: Coupling Analysis of AC Motors Based on Relative Gain Array
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Alternating current motors is important equipment for electromechanical energy conversion. It has strong electrical coupling. In this paper, the coupled model of AC induction motor is given and the transfer function of the system is calculated. Based on the analysis of the relative gain array, the coupling degree influenced by motor speed is obtained. Finally propose the strategy that using different decoupling control methods in different speed interval according to the value of relative gain. The simulation results show that with the increase of the motor speed, the degree of coupling will increase too. It is effective to use relative gain array to decide to take which decoupling strategy.

articleTitle: Browser/Server based Experimental Environment for Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper has proposed an implement method using browser and server framework to train the reinforcement learning based AI (Artificial Intelligence). By taking advantage of the WebSocket to transfer information during the AI learning, the browser is in charge of rendering the experimental environment by HTML5 and JavaScript, and the server is realized by c++ to train the policy gradient AI mode which feeds the output actions back to its input layer. With the proposed framework, the rendering environment and the training environment can be implemented independently to different runtime environments. Finally, the effectiveness of the B/S based AI learning model proposed in this paper is validated through the application of the game `Flappy Bird'.

articleTitle: Sensor-Target Assignment Strategy for Multi-Target Collaborative Tracking under Low Detection Probability
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 3rd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of sensor resource assignment in multi-target collaborative tracking under low detection probability, a strategy for sensor-target assignment is proposed. Firstly, in order to solve the problem that tracking precision of covariance assignment strategy is decreased due to serious data loss under low detection probability, the nearest sensor-target assignment strategy which gives priority consideration to detection probability is proposed. Secondly, in order to solve the problem that the sensor network has low node density and limited number of nodes for tracking under low detection probability, the nearest sensor-target assignment strategy for mobile sensor nodes is proposed by repositioning the mobile sensor nodes. Finally, in order to solve the problem that the nearest sensor-target assignment strategy could lead to low tracking precision and the covariance assignment strategy could lead to data loss, the nearest-covariance assignment strategy is proposed, which considers both the detection probability and tracking precision to repeated nodes. Simulation experiments are used to verify the validity of the proposed algorithms, which indicate that the algorithms can distinctly improve the target detection probability of sensor network as well as the precision and stability of target tracking.
